items.title: ヒズボラ、戦闘再開に備え再武装　イランが資金供与＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Laila Bassam　Maya Gebeily

[ベイルート ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Laila Bassam　Maya Gebeily

[ベイルート ２６日 ロイター] - レバノンの武装組織ヒズボラがイランから数千万ドルの資金供与を受け、イスラエルとの戦闘再開に備えて再武装を進めていると、レバノンの治安関係筋などが明らかにした。

それによると、ヒズボラは６月以降に戦闘が小康状態に入ったことを利用し、爆発物の調達やイスラエル軍陣地への攻撃用無人機（ドローン）の製造に注力しているという。

ヒズボラは２０２４年以降の２度の戦争で戦闘員数千人と多数の指導者を失い、保有兵器の多くが破壊された。イスラエル軍は南部の村々を占領し、レバノン国内では武装解除を求める政治的圧力が強まっている。

関係筋によると、ヒズボラは主要な戦闘で機能不全に陥った指揮統制体制の再建も進めているが、備蓄や戦闘部隊の整備はなお不十分だという。ヒズボラの広報部門は指揮統制体制の機能不全を否定し、占領への抵抗は正当な権利だと主張した。

米国とイランの暫定合意が崩壊した後も、レバノンでは全面的な戦闘は再開していないが、イスラエルは南部への攻撃を継続している。ヒズボラは米国とイランの対立激化による戦闘再燃を警戒する一方、新たな戦闘に関与するかは明言していない。

米国務省は、制裁などを通じてヒズボラによる資金調達への締め付けを続けると表明した。

items.title: SpaceX firma un acuerdo de US$40.000 millones con Apollo para financiar chips de IA
items.author: Carmen Arroyo
items.summary: El acuerdo se cerrará antes de que termine el año y se prevé que los arrendamientos comiencen en el primer semestre del año que viene.
items.body: Bloomberg — SpaceX ( SPCX ) ha firmado un contrato de arrendamiento financiero de equipos por valor de unos US$40.000 millones con Apollo Global Management Inc para adquirir los chips necesarios para impulsar sus ambiciones en materia de inteligencia artificial. Ver más: Anthropic presenta su solicitud de salida a bolsa y busca igualar o superar el récord de SpaceX La tasa de interés fija que pagará la empresa se determinará en el momento de la fijación de precios, lo cual aún no se ha producido, según indicó SpaceX en un comunicado presentado el lunes. Se prevé que el acuerdo se cierre antes de que finalice el año y que los arrendamientos comiencen en el primer semestre del próximo año. En una publicación en X durante el fin de semana, Elon Musk destacó el acuerdo para ayudar a financiar la adquisición de unidades de procesamiento gráfico de Nvidia Corp ( NVDA ). “Este arrendamiento diversifica nuestras fuentes de financiación y cubre una parte considerable de los fondos necesarios para llevar a cabo nuestros planes de crecimiento”, afirmó SpaceX en un comunicado el lunes, añadiendo que prevé “períodos de amortización inferiores a un año” para sus inversiones en inteligencia artificial. El acuerdo se produce tras una semana convulsa para las empresas de IA en los mercados de deuda, a medida que aumentaba la preocupación por el rápido gasto del sector y los limitados beneficios obtenidos hasta la fecha. Dado que los inversores exigen primas cada vez mayores para financiar la expansión de la IA, la volatilidad ha agitado las negociaciones sobre los precios de la deuda de SpaceX, que se está estructurando como bonos privados que emitirá una entidad fuera de balance. Gran parte de la inquietud de los inversores se ha centrado en las denominadas “neoclouds”, que venden potencia de cálculo de alta gama a empresas tecnológicas. Musk ha tratado de diferenciar a su empresa de esos negocios, haciendo hincapié en los ingresos de SpaceX procedentes de su negocio Starlink y de los lanzamientos de cohetes. SpaceX, que cuenta con calificación de grado de inversión otorgada por las tres principales agencias de calificación crediticia, ha visto cómo el precio de su propia deuda se desplomaba en las últimas semanas. Los swaps de incumplimiento crediticio vinculados a la empresa, que se utilizan para asegurarse contra pérdidas en su deuda, se dispararon la semana pasada hasta alcanzar un récord de 266 puntos básicos al cierre de la sesión del viernes, un nivel más propio de un prestatario con calificación de “basura”. Esa preocupación se atenuó ligeramente en las primeras operaciones del lunes, cuando los swaps de SpaceX cotizaban en torno a los 261 puntos básicos, según muestran los precios de ICE Data Services. Goldman Sachs Group Inc ( GS ) actuó como único agente estructurador de la operación, según el comunicado. También se comprometieron a participar como inversores principales fondos y cuentas gestionados por BlackRock Inc ( BLK ) y Goldman Sachs Asset Management, así como cuentas de capital asesoradas por KKR & Co ( KKR ). Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: 韓国ＧＤＰ、第3四半期は前期比1.0％増で予想上回る　半導体輸出好調
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２７日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）が２７日発表した第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は、季節調整済みで前期比１．０％増となった。伸び率は第２・四半期の０．６％から加速し、ロイターがまとめた市場予想の０．７％を上回った。半導体輸出の好調が成長を支えた。

世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームを背景に、韓国の１─９月の輸出額は８０００億ドルを突破し、過去最高だった２０２５年の年間輸出額を上回った。２６年は１兆ドルを超える見通しで、実現すれば米国、中国、ドイツに続き４カ国目となる。

韓国中銀は７月と８月に連続で利上げした後、先週は政策金利を据え置いた。ただ、経済成長率見通しを引き上げ、輸出の勢いについて引き続き楽観的な見方を示すなど、タカ派姿勢を堅持した。 

第３・四半期は半導体や機械、電気機器の需要を背景に輸出が２．３％増加した。輸入は２．４％増えた。

設備投資は半導体製造装置などの機械がけん引し、４．１％増加した。個人消費は０．２％減と、約４年ぶりに減少した。

ＧＤＰの前年同期比の伸び率は３．４％と、第２・四半期の３．７％から鈍化したものの、エコノミスト予想の３．０％を上回った。

items.title: Air Canada crews in some European cities sent to alternative locations due to civil unrest
items.author: Elianna Lev
items.summary: Air Canada flight crews who flew to several cities in Europe last week were relocated to secondary hotel locations due to civil unrest related to widespread protests, a source with knowledge on the ...
items.body: Air Canada flight crews who flew to several cities in Europe last week were relocated to secondary hotel locations due to civil unrest related to widespread protests, a source with knowledge on the situation confirmed with CTVNews.ca. Air Canada crews arriving in Paris, Nice, Lyon, Nantes and Milan between Oct. 23 and 25 were sent to different locations to avoid potential disruption of crew rest. The Air Canada Master Executive Council of the Air Line Pilots Association, Int’l (ALPA), said in an email to CTVNews.ca that they work closely with airline security teams and government contacts to monitor global threats and co-ordinate crew member safety during critical events. “With safety as our top priority, relocations are common practice in the industry whenever there is a potential safety concern or possibility for disruption to our rest,” the email said. It added that crews on layover are always told to follow the Canadian government’s travel advisory information. Air Canada spokesperson Sean Davidson did not confirm the location change, but said in an email with CTVNews.ca that safety is always the airline’s top priority. “As a global airline, we continuously monitor events worldwide, follow government guidance and conduct our own security assessments in consultation with industry partners,” he said in email. “When warranted, we may temporarily relocate crew accommodations closer to the airport to ensure the on-time operation of flights to Canada.” Protest movement spread across Europe Students in France began protesting school conditions last September. As the demonstrations grew in size, so did the issues that were being protested, including the cost of living. Protesters in Spain joined in shortly after, focusing on housing costs, along with Italy, Belgium, Albania, Austria, Greece, Ireland and Portugal. Over the weekend, more than 400,000 people across France took to the streets, and nearly 1,000 people were arrested. In Italy, hundreds of troops were sent in to monitor the protests in Rome, Milan and Turin, over the weekend. which were mostly peaceful. Many luxury boutiques in Milan’s fashion district including Omega, Tiffany and Gucci, boarded up their front windows to deter possible looters. With files from rom CTV News’ Daniel Otis and The Associated Press.

items.title: ドイツ銀行、ＡＩで一部企業融資の判断「数分」に短縮
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tom Sims　Hakan Ersen

[フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tom Sims　Hakan Ersen

[フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター] - ドイツ銀行は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の活用により、一部の中小企業向け融資の判断にかかる時間を数週間から数分へと短縮している。同行の技術部門トップ、マリージャンヌ・デベルダン氏がロイターのインタビューで語った。 

デベルダン氏によると、夏に稼働を開始したこの取り組みにより、多国籍企業向けの一部融資についても、判断に要する時間が数カ月から数週間に短縮された。

同氏はインタビューで「組織や法的な構造がそれほど複雑ではない比較的小規模な企業については、数週間から数分への短縮となっている」と述べた。

デベルダン氏は、同行のＡＩエージェントが顧客側のエージェントと直接やり取りする将来に向けた準備も進めていると説明した。

ＡＩ開発のペースが速すぎるのではないかというテクノロジー業界リーダーらの議論に、銀行業界も巻き込まれつつある。

デベルダン氏は「この議論を注意深く見守っている。こうした懸念には十分な根拠があり、当然ながら、サイバーリスクの管理が私の最優先課題だ」と述べた。

「こうした新技術や脅威から自行を守り続けるため、多くの経営資源と予算を投入している」と語った。

items.title: PM Carney says it’s time to move beyond Indian Act
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Mark Carney says he will instruct his ministers to work with First Nations to move Canada beyond the Indian Act, which could mean reforming it or abolishing it altogether.
items.body: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he will instruct his ministers to work with First Nations to move Canada beyond the Indian Act — which he said could mean reforming it or abolishing it altogether. Speaking to reporters after a meeting with First Nations chiefs and premiers in Ottawa today, Carney said the elimination of the Indian Act has been sought by many First Nations leaders, including Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew. Earlier in the day, Kinew told reporters during a break in the meeting that Canada needs a relationship between First Nations and the government “that reflects who Indigenous people are as Canadians.” Carney said “moving beyond” the Indian Act could involve abolition or reform. But he said it would only happen in partnership with First Nations leadership. “The suggestion of reforming, potentially abolishing and fully modernizing governance, is that a process, co-developed, needs to be put in place, and the federal government is open to that process,” Carney said. Carney said the idea of abolishing or modernizing the Indian Act was discussed openly in the room. “Not everybody, but other participants raised the desirability. So it’s already starting from the right place in that it’s not the federal government deciding something should be done. It’s responding to a request,” Carney said. “I think this was the spirit of this meeting — certainly the spirit I took — the ability to sit down together and develop that co-development, gives me hope that we can we can finally move forward from this.” The Indian Act has been in effect since 1876 to govern First Nations status in Canada. It has been amended several times to reflect changes in how status is conferred. Assembly of First Nations National Chief Cindy Woodhouse Nepinak said there are some protections in the act for First Nations, and First Nations should be able to decide how to move forward. “Look, that’s a question that was just posed today in the room among First Nations. Some First Nations; others would be very reserved,” Woodhouse Nepinak. “But there is, you know, a diversity of First Nations from coast to coast to coast, where in every province and territory in this beautiful country that we all share. And that question is going to be up to them to decide.” Kinew said he feels the Indian Act should be abolished altogether. He held up his First Nations status card, which he said identifies him as an “Indian within the meaning of the Indian Act.” “It’s time to abolish the Indian Act,” Kinew said. “It’s long overdue that we have a relationship with Indigenous Peoples in Canada that reflects who we are as Canadians today.” Carney and most of the premiers sat down with chiefs from the Assembly of First Nations in Ottawa for a discussion Woodhouse Nepinak said is intended to help build prosperity for coming generations. Monday’s closed-door meeting is the first such gathering since the Kelowna Accord talks of 2005, which brought premiers and then-prime minister Paul Martin together with Indigenous leaders to discuss ways to close the socioeconomic gaps in Indigenous communities. The Kelowna agreement was not implemented after the Conservative government under former prime minister Stephen Harper took office just a few months later. This meeting comes as Carney’s government works to speed up major project approvals and development — efforts some First Nations chiefs say threaten their rights. Jeronimo Kataquapit, who was protesting the major projects push outside the meeting venue in Ottawa, chided the federal government and the Assembly of First Nations over the lack of youth representation at the meeting. “These major projects cannot move forward without our free, prior and informed consent, and it’s the youth that stand to be the most impacted by the decisions made today by all leadership, both Indigenous and non-Indigenous alike,” Kataquapit said from the sidewalk in front of the Diefenbaker Building. Protester Katisha Paul, an advocate for youth and women, questioned the Assembly of First Nations’ mandate to negotiate on First Nations’ behalf. “I’m not in that room today but I can imagine and speculate that the voices of our ancestors are not being heard, they’re not being voiced and they’re not being amplified because many of those elected band council chiefs have lost their ways,” Paul said. Tensions between Ottawa and First Nations spiked soon after Carney was elected in 2025 when his government passed legislation to create a new office tasked with streamlining major project developments and approving projects within one year. First Nations leaders warned the compressed timelines would interfere with their rights and lead to court challenges. Provincial governments have enacted similar legislation. But tensions are boiling over for a number of other reasons as well, including the lands claim process in British Columbia, the newly announced Pacific Link pipeline project in Alberta and development of the mineral-rich Ring of Fire in Ontario. In many cases, it’s youth who are pushing back on First Nations leaders, the premiers and prime minister. Carney said Monday it’s “sobering” to consider that this is the first meeting to bring together federal, provincial and First Nations leaders in two decades. “Our task is twofold. First is to work together to create opportunities for all our peoples, while building a country that is stronger, more sovereign and more independent,” he said. “And secondly, our task is to live our values fully of a fair and inclusive Canada.” While some First Nations are opposed to Carney’s development agenda and those of the provinces, others are open to the idea of increasing economic activity in their territories. Nisga’a Nation President Eva Clayton told reporters ahead of the meeting she supports Carney’s plans and that she and other modern treaty holders are at the meeting to support Canada. By Alessia Passafiume and Kyle Duggan With files from Nick Murray

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［パリ　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［パリ　２６日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は２６日、１試合を行い、パリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）がホームでリヨンを２─０で下し、首位に浮上した。リヨンの中村敬斗は前節の退場による出場停止でベンチ入りしなかった。

ＰＳＧは後半２７分、途中出場のミカ・ゴツからパスを受けた同じく途中出場のセニー・マユルがペナルティーエリア手前からシュートを決めて先制。同３９分にはゴツがロングパスに抜け出し、追加点を奪った。

ＰＳＧは公式戦８連勝。８試合を終えて勝ち点１７とし、２位レンヌに１ポイント差をつけた。リヨンは同１４で５位。

items.title: South Korea's economy grows faster than expected in third quarter
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Korea's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter on booming chip exports, advance central bank estimates showed on Tuesday.
items.body:
South Korea's economy grew faster than expected in the third quarter on booming chip exports, advance central bank estimates showed on Tuesday.
Gross domestic product expanded 1.0% in the July-September quarter from the preceding three months, when it grew 0.6%. It was stronger than a median 0.7% increase tipped in a Reuters [USN:L6N46900E TEXT:"poll"] of economists.
Amid the global boom in AI investment, South Korea's exports topped [USN:L1N45N002 TEXT:"$800 billion"] in January to September, higher than last year's full-year record, and are on track to exceed $1 trillion this year, which will make South Korea the fourth country to reach the milestone, after the US, China and Germany.
The Bank of Korea kept [USN:L4N467041 TEXT:"interest rates"] unchanged last week, after back-to-back hikes in July and September, but maintained a hawkish stance by upgrading its economic growth forecasts and remaining upbeat about the country's export momentum.
In the third quarter, exports rose 2.3% on demand for semiconductors, machinery and electric equipment, while imports grew 2.4%.
Facilities investment jumped 4.1%, led by machinery such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Private consumption fell 0.2%, the first decline in nearly four years.
On a year-on-year basis, GDP grew 3.4%, after rising 3.7% in the quarter before, according to the Bank of Korea, also stronger than economists' expectations for a 3.0% increase.

items.title: 燃料高騰の追加負担、米消費者が世界最大　イラン戦争で＝調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - イラン戦争に伴う供給混乱で高騰している燃料価格の追加負担が世界で最も大きいのは米国の消費者であることが、２６日に公表された調査で分かった。

化石燃料からの脱却に向けた取り組みを支援するフィンランドの非営利団体、エネルギー・クリーンエア研究センター（ＣＲＥＡ）の調査によると、２月２８日のイラン戦争開始以降、燃料価格の上昇による米消費者の追加負担は平均４７１ドルに上り、世界平均の約６０ドルを大きく上回った。

ＣＲＥＡは、米消費者の負担が大きい理由として、燃費の悪い自家用車への依存、移動距離の長さ、電気自動車（ＥＶ）への移行が比較的遅いことを挙げた。

調査では、追加負担を算出するため、２０２６年１─２月の燃料価格と、それ以降の調査期間中の価格を比較した。

３月初めから１０月半ばまでの１６９カ国の燃料価格と消費量を調べたところ、カナダ、オーストラリア、ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）、ベルギーの消費者も大幅な追加負担を強いられていた。

この期間の燃料費の追加負担は世界全体で４６８０億ドルに上り、米国が１６００億ドル、中国が５４０億ドル、カナダが１７０億ドルだった。

トランプ米政権は燃料価格の上昇について、イランの核兵器保有を阻止するために消費者が支払う小さな代償だとし、戦争が終われば原油と燃料の価格は下落すると説明しているが、戦争は政権の想定より長期化している。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ２７日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - ＧＭＯインターネットグループは２６日夜、ＦＸ（外国為替証拠金取引）自動売買サービスに不正アクセスしたとみられる攻撃者から、顧客情報の公開とランサムウエア（身代金要求型ウイルス）攻撃を２７日正午に行うとの予告を受けていると発表した。

ＧＭＯは一部顧客の端末を預かり、調査・解析を進めており、ランサムウエアを含むマルウエア（悪意あるソフト）が実際仕掛けられているかどうかを含め、被害状況を確認して対処方法を見いだしたい考え。

攻撃者からの要求には応じない方針を改めて示し、顧客に対し、ウイルスチェックのフルスキャンや調査への協力などの対応を求めている。

熊谷正寿代表は自身のブログで、これまでに攻撃者から５０００万ドル（約８０億円）を暗号資産で支払うよう要求があったと明らかにしていた。読売新聞などの報道によると、攻撃者は日本語のサイトで、２７日正午までに１００万ドル（約１億６０００万円）を支払うよう要求しているという。

items.title: Thunder's Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace both headed for surgery
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder will be down two starters for the foreseeable future as both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are headed for surgery, general manager Sam Presti said Monday.
items.body:
The Oklahoma City Thunder will be down two starters for the foreseeable future as both Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are headed for surgery, general manager Sam Presti said Monday.
The Thunder revealed Williams suffered both a fractured fibula and a dislocated ankle, while Wallace has a torn labrum in his left shoulder.
Their return timelines are up in the air, with the possibility that both players will miss the rest of the season.
Williams suffered a gruesome injury to his left leg in the waning moments of the Thunder's 108-101 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday night. His ankle bent awkwardly as he landed after being fouled on a drive to the hoop.
Presti said Williams is in great spirits.
"He has an elite mindset," Presti said of Williams during a press conference. "It's what makes him a great player. It's what keeps him motivated, and it's why we all love him."
Wallace was hurt in the same game after running into a moving screen.
Williams was an All-Star and an All-NBA selection in 2024-25. He was limited to 33 regular-season games and five of Oklahoma City's 15 playoff games in 2025-26 due to wrist surgery recovery and multiple hamstring strains.
Wallace was named to the NBA All-Defense second team last season and started all three games so far this season before his injury, a promotion for Wallace after Luguentz Dort was traded to Atlanta in the offseason.
He signed a five-year, $139 million contract extension last week, while Williams was in the first season of a five-year max contract worth $239 million.
"Obviously, tough night last night," Presti said. "There's no way to paint that differently. We say within our walls all of the time that there's a difference between being positive and being optimistic. I'm not going to sit up here and say this is exactly where we want to be or this is how we'd like to have it. But at the same time, we're extremely optimistic about the recovery for both of the players. Most importantly, things could've been a lot worse."
--Field Level Media

items.title: ドアダッシュ、食品宅配インスタカート買収へ最終交渉　28日合意も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Echo Wang　Milana Vinn

［２６日　ロイター］ - 米料理宅配大手ドアダッシュが食料品宅配企業インスタカートの買収に向けて最終交渉を進めていることが分かった。インスタカートを１７０億ドル程度と評価する見通しだ。事情に詳しい情報筋が２６日、ロイターに明らかにした。

早ければ２８日にも最終合意に至る可能性があるが、買収成立が確実な情勢ではないと説明している。米配車サービス大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズはインスタカートの買収交渉を進められていないという。

２３日時点で時価総額が約１３０億ドルだったインスタカートの株価は、通常取引で約８％上昇した。ドアダッシュの株価は約６％下落した。

料理宅配業界は新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）によるオンライン注文のブームが下火になった後、人件費高騰や配達員の規制強化、競争激化に直面している。ドアダッシュはインスタカートを買収する場合、顧客基盤や小売業との提携関係を獲得でき、自社の広範な配達網や顧客基盤との組み合わせが可能になる。

インスタカートはロイターへのコメントを差し控えた。ウーバーとドアダッシュはコメント要請に回答していない。

成長戦略コンサルティング会社マニフェスト・グロース・アーキテクツ共同創業者のニック・スミス氏は「戦略的に見れば、ドアダッシュの料理配達網とインスタカートの食料品分野での専門性は補完し合える強みのため、ドアダッシュの方がインスタカートにとってより自然な組み合わせだと思える」とコメントした。

これとは別にインスタカートは２６日に規制当局への提出書類で、スマートショッピングカート事業「ケイパーカート」を２７年第２・四半期末までに段階的に終了すると発表。これに伴い５５００万―８０００万ドルの税引き前費用が発生すると見込んでいる。

料理宅配業界ではドアダッシュがデリバルーの買収に踏み切り、ウーバーはポストメイツやデリバリー・ヒーローを買収すると発表していた。

items.title: アンソロピック向けに630億ドル、米銀など　ブロードコム半導体購入
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - バンク・オブ・アメリカ、ブラックストーン、シティ、モルガン・スタンレーは、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発のアンソロピック向けにブロードコムのＡＩ半導体やネットワーク機器を購入するため６３０億ドルの資金を提供する。

各社が２６日発表したところによると、今回の取引は新たに設立する特別目的事業体（ＳＰＶ）を通じて行う。ＳＰＶがブロードコムのＡＩアクセラレーターやネットワーク機器を購入し、アンソロピックにリースする。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ、シティ、モルガン・スタンレーが第１順位の融資を手配し、ブラックストーンが第２順位融資のコミット分を提供する。 

ブロードコムは優先債権者に「残存価値サポート」を提供し、実質的に保証を与える。資産価値が下落した場合に第１順位の債務額に相当する金額まで損失を吸収することに同意している。ただ、発表ではこの債務の規模は明らかにされていない。 

各社によると、納入は２０２７年に始まる見通し。ブロードコムが関与する、既に発表済みの戦略的なコンピューティング能力に関する契約の一環となる。

アポロとブラックストーンはブロードコムとの従来の契約に基づき、アンソロピックのＡＩコンピューティング能力拡大に向けた３５０億ドルの資金供給に合意していた。

今回の取引は、ＡＩコンピューティング需要の高まりを支えるのに必要なインフラの資金調達において、銀行やオルタナティブ運用会社の役割が拡大していることを浮き彫りにしている。

アンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開した。書類では巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになり、開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ロンドン　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ロンドン　２６日　ロイター］ - ヒーリー英財務相が２８日、２１歳以上の最低賃金を３．９％引き上げて時給約１３．２０ポンド（１７．６３ドル）とする計画を発表する見通しだと、英紙タイムズが２６日報じた。予算案に盛り込まれた場合、２０２７年に発効する。現在の時給は１２．７１ポンド。

１８－２０歳の最低賃金も３．９％引き上げ、現在の１０．８５ポンドから約１１．２７ポンド程度にするとした。財務省は報道についてのコメントを差し控えた。

英国の最低賃金は、平均賃金（中央値）に占める割合として先進国の中で最も高い水準の１つ。歴代政権は最低賃金を平均賃金（中央値）の３分の２まで上げるよう取り組んできた。

一方、アナリストや経営者の一部は、若年労働者の賃金水準が失業率上昇の原因の一部になっていると指摘している。

政府の諮問機関である低賃金委員会は今年４月、平均賃金の上昇見通しを踏まえて２７年の最低賃金を約３．７％引き上げて時給１３．１８ポンドに設定する必要性があると助言していた。

items.title: China's lab-grown diamond makers target AI, chip sectors for next wave of growth
items.author: Amy Lv, Casey Hall
items.creator: Amy Lv, Casey Hall
items.summary: Around 70% of the 2 million carats of lab-grown diamonds produced annually at Feng Canjun's factory currently go into jewellery.
items.body:
Around 70% of the 2 million carats of lab-grown diamonds produced annually at Feng Canjun's factory currently go into jewellery.
But the entrepreneur is betting that the future of China's synthetic diamond industry lies in supplying advanced materials for semiconductors, AI servers and other high-tech applications.
"I am looking to raise the share of my products used in functional materials to more than 50% by 2030 while reducing the share going to the jewellery sector to a maximum of 30%," Feng said.
China's lab-grown diamond producers, which account for around half of the world's supply, are looking beyond gemstones as competition intensifies and prices come under pressure.
The shift could give the industry greater strategic significance in the US-China technology rivalry. If synthetic diamonds become more widely used in semiconductors and thermal management in AI infrastructure, China's production dominance could emerge as another supply-chain vulnerability for the US.
"The transition is now the defining structural story in the diamond industry and one with direct implications for global technology supply chains," said Manan Goenka, engagement manager at Ken Research, a consultancy.
Companies and analysts say demand from sectors including chips, thermal management and quantum technology could become the industry's next major growth engine, with synthetic diamonds prized for properties that can improve the performance of advanced electronics and computing systems.
The move comes as AI drives a surge in demand for data centre capacity. The International Energy Agency said in a 2025 report that data centre electricity consumption is projected to more than double by 2030 to about 945 terawatt-hours, roughly equivalent to Japan's annual power consumption, with AI being the main driver.
THE AI OPPORTUNITY Thermal management is viewed by analysts as a nearer-term opportunity, while the use of diamonds as a semiconductor material is further away from widespread commercial adoption. Chip applications also require much higher purity and tighter manufacturing standards than diamonds used in cutting and drilling tools.
But interest from some of the world's biggest technology companies points to the potential for chip applications to become a new source of demand as AI computing generates increasing amounts of heat.
Chinese media have reported that Huawei and TSMC (2330.TW) are exploring synthetic diamonds for chip cooling, while Lenovo (0992.HK) has launched a consumer laptop in China that it says uses a diamond-copper cooling material.
In June, Intel (INTC.O) CEO Lip-Bu Tan said he personally invested in Diamond Foundry, a lab-grown diamond maker developing chip-grade diamond wafers.
Huawei, Lenovo and Intel did not respond to requests for comment. TSMC declined to comment.
Some Chinese producers are beginning to invest in anticipation of demand. Henan Liliang Diamond (301071.SZ) plans to redirect 1 billion yuan ($149.18 million) in funds originally raised to expand gem-grade diamond production to a new functional-diamond project, according to a June filing.
In April, diamond-copper cooling modules developed by Chinese researchers improved heat transfer from chip modules by 80% and raised chip performance by 10%, according to the Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology & Engineering.
Wider adoption could reshape the market for thermal-management materials that are used to stop chips from overheating. Germany's Henkel (HNKG.DE) , US chemical firm Dow (DOW.N) and Japan's Shin-Etsu Chemical (4063.T) sell products used to dissipate heat from chips. Diamond heat spreaders could compete with some existing materials if adopted widely in AI chips and data centres.
Henkel, Dow and Shin-Etsu did not respond to requests for comment.
Related diamond-enabled products are also being explored outside China. In June, De Beers' synthetic-diamond and advanced-materials business Element Six and Japan's Orbray said they had produced 3-inch single-crystal diamond wafers and were preparing 2-inch wafers for production in Oregon.
The Spanish government [USN:L8N3X10SU TEXT:"is investing"] €753 million ($868 million) in a Diamond Foundry plant in Trujillo that will make synthetic diamond wafers. If completed, it would be Europe's first large-scale producer of diamond substrates, a material for semiconductor manufacturing.
In early October, Frore Systems, a US thermal-management company, unveiled LiquidJet Diamond, a multi-stage coldplate with an integrated diamond spreader.
"The scope and potential in the technology and industrial sectors could be significantly above the retail diamond jewellery business, which itself is approximately $100 billion a year," said independent diamond consultant Robert Bouquet.
DIAMOND MACHINE Feng's Jiaruifu factory is one of hundreds of lab-grown producers clustered in the central province of Henan, which accounts for 80% of China's synthetic diamond output.
Lab-grown diamonds are made in machines that replicate the high-temperature, high-pressure conditions under which natural diamonds form. They are physically identical to mined diamonds.
One machine in Feng's factory can produce 120 carats of rough diamonds in six days, shortening a process that takes billions of years naturally.
Feng has 550 such machines, each costing about 3 million yuan and weighing more than 100 tons. They have enabled him to increase annual output tenfold since launching the business in 2019, to 2 million carats in 2025, equivalent to about 9% of De Beers' production last year.
Beijing has already moved to incorporate the technology into its export control regime, placing related machinery and key components under restrictions in 2024. It added more synthetic diamond products to its list in 2025, though implementation was postponed for a year under a US-China deal reached last October.
"The broader implication is that synthetic diamonds could increasingly become part of the strategic trade-policy conversation surrounding semiconductors, rare earths and advanced manufacturing," said Goenka.
China's rapid expansion of lab-grown diamond production has helped drive down prices, increasing pressure on producers to find higher-value applications.
Gross profit margins are 30% to 40% for gem-grade diamonds compared with about 50% for industrial diamonds, according to Feng. Rather than increasing output further, he plans to shift more production towards higher-value industrial uses.
While the commercial potential of synthetic diamonds in advanced industrial applications remains uncertain and risks contributing to another bout of Chinese industrial overcapacity, producers remain optimistic.
"It will be a billion- or even trillion-yuan market, and we are strategically expanding into next-generation applications to replace traditional ones," Feng said.
($1 = 6.6997 Chinese yuan)

LONDON, Oct 26 : Harry Kane completed his long quest for football's highest individual honour on Monday, with the Bayern Munich and England striker winning the Ballon d'Or after a record-breaking season that cemented his status as one of the game's greatest goalscorers.
Kane is the first Englishman to win the prestigious award in 25 years, after Michael Owen won it in 2001.
"Wow, wow, wow!" Kane said after taking the stage. "I am almost speechless. Being here in London has made it extra special. Made it a good omen for me tonight. Thank you to everyone who voted for me. I can imagine it was tough this year.
"Some world-class players in the room tonight. Congratulations to all the winners and nominees tonight and impressive showing determination and hard work can really achieve."

Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas won the Ballon d'Or Feminin for the third time.
Kane's move to Bayern in 2023 brought the team trophies that had long eluded him. In 2025-26, he coupled that success with goalscoring numbers that made him the leading Ballon d'Or candidate.
The England captain produced his most prolific campaign, scoring 61 goals in 51 games for Bayern across all competitions as the German side completed a domestic league and cup double.
By the end of the season, Kane had established himself as Europe's leading goalscorer.
His influence stretched far beyond club football.
He scored six goals at the World Cup and led England to the semi-finals, combining his clinical finishing with the leadership and composure that have defined his international career.
The award represents the culmination of a remarkable journey. Few players have experienced a career arc quite like Kane's, and he thanked all of his career coaches in his emotional speech, plus Tottenham Hotspur and his wife Kate.
Once struggling to establish himself at Spurs as a youngster, being sent out on numerous loans, he developed into one of the most complete centre forwards of his generation, capable of scoring every type of goal while also functioning as a playmaker.
"It's about the journey," Kane said. "Anything is possible, work hard when nobody is watching.
"For any young boy or girl wanting to achieve their dreams, anything is possible. I wasn't the kid who went straight to the top. I had to experience the downs. I had to find my way to be the very best right now."
CONSISTENCY
The Ballon d'Or has often rewarded players whose success was built on flair and spectacle, but Kane's triumph is a tribute to consistency, intelligence and productivity on an exceptional scale.
Week after week, he delivered. Match after match, he decided contests. There were no prolonged slumps and few quiet nights.
His numbers were almost impossible to ignore.
Kane finished the campaign with 73 goals for club and country, a total rarely seen in the modern era. More importantly, those goals arrived in moments of genuine significance, helping Bayern collect trophies and driving England deep into the biggest tournament in the sport.
The competition for this year's award was fierce. Kylian Mbappe broke World Cup scoring records. Lamine Yamal helped Spain to World Cup glory. Yet voters ultimately chose Kane, whose excellence lasted the entire season.
Mbappe finished second, followed by Lamine, Rodri and Lionel Messi.
At 33, Kane has finally claimed the game's highest individual honour, adding a Ballon d'Or to a legacy that already places him among football's greatest strikers as England's all-time leading marksman and their record World Cup scorer.
Putellas was presented with the women's award after winning the treble with Barcelona in the 2025-26 campaign, in addition to the Spanish Super Cup. She moved to Women's Super League side London City Lionesses in July after 14 years at Barca.
Spain and Barcelona players won the young talent awards, Lamine picking up his third trophy and Vicky Lopez taking home the women's award for the second successive year.
Spain coach Luis de la Fuente was named men's coach of the year, while Barcelona's Pere Romeu won the women's coaching award.
The men's goalkeeper award went to Unai Simon of Spain and Athletic Bilbao, while Cata Coll of Spain and Barcelona won the women's award.
Paris St Germain won the men's club of the year award, while Barcelona picked up the women's honours. Kane won the men's striker of the year prize, while Charlyn Corral was named top women's striker.
Arsenal and England winger Bukayo Saka was presented with the Socrates Award for humanitarian work.

Source: Reuters

items.title: PL, partido de Flávio Bolsonaro, reconhece resultado da eleição que deu vitória a Lula
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O PL, partido do candidato derrotado no último domingo na eleição presidencial, senador Flávio Bolsonaro, anunciou nesta segunda-feira que reconhece o resultado das urnas que deu a vitória ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
items.body:
O PL, partido do candidato derrotado no último domingo na eleição presidencial, senador Flávio Bolsonaro, anunciou nesta segunda-feira que reconhece o resultado das urnas que deu a vitória ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
"Reconhecemos o resultado presidencial, proclamado pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), mas entendemos que os questionamentos levantados precisam ser devidamente esclarecidos dentro de um debate político equilibrado e democrático", diz a legenda em nota divulgada no Instagram.
O partido também afirmou que a ampliação de gastos públicos com benefícios sociais às vésperas da votação "levanta questionamentos sobre os efeitos dessas medidas em um processo eleitoral justo, além de possíveis consequências econômicas para o país".
Mais cedo, Flávio anunciou que pedirá a cassação da chapa do presidente reeleito por abuso de poder político e econômico.

items.title: ¿Cuánto gana Lamine Yamal? El sueldo y la fortuna del ganador del trofeo Kopa en el Balón de Oro 2026¿Cuánto gana Lamine Yamal? El sueldo y la fortuna del ganador del ...
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: El español se consolida como una gran estrella juvenil al recibir el galardón que lo reconoce como el mejor jugador menor de 21 años.
items.body: Lamine Yamal se consolidó como el astro juvenil del fútbol mundial al recibir el lunes el trofeo Kopa al mejor jugador joven durante la gala del Balón de Oro 2026. Es el tercer año consecutivo en que la estrella del Barcelona recibe el reconocimiento otorgado a un jugador menor de 21 años. Con solo 19 años, Yamal además se encontraba entre los nominados al máximo premio junto a otros ídolos como Lionel Messi, Erling Haaland y Kylian Mbappé. El premio reconoce también a las figuras más destacadas de la rama femenil. El trofeo Kopa 2026 consolida al español como una de las grandes promesas de la escena global del fútbol, en la que también destaca por el sueldo millonario y la fortuna que ha generado en solo un par de años. De acuerdo con Be In Sports , Yamal tiene un sueldo anual bruto de €31,25 millones de euros en el club Barcelona, donde figura en la cima de los mejores pagados del equipo. La cifra lo coloca a la par de el Rodri, según el medio. “Este empate en la cima refleja cómo el equipo valora por igual la incorporación de una figura consagrada, al estilo de los galácticos, y la irrupción precoz de un talento generacional formado en casa”, señaló el medio. En 2025, Yamal firmó un contrato de larga duración que se extiende hasta junio de 2031 y que incluyó una cláusula de rescisión de US$1.140 millones (1.000 millones de euros), según Athlon Sports. Dicho medio también estimó su fortuna hasta octubre 2026 en US$55 millones. La cifra contempla el reciente ascenso del mediocampista como una estrella publicitaria que ha sido fichada por marcas como Adidas, OPPO, Powerade o American Eagle (AE). AE incluso convirtió a Yamal en su primer embajador global y juntos lanzaron una colección inspirada en el estilo personal del futbolista. Yamal además ha capitalizado su estilo y lo ha llevado al terreno del lujo. Hace unas semanas, el deportista acaparó los reflectores cuando llegó a una concentración de la Selección de España luciendo un reloj Richard Mille cuyo costo se estima en €240.000 y un bolso Chanel que puede alcanzar hasta los €10.000.

items.author: Raylí Luján
items.summary: Bloomberg Línea — Estados Unidos considera que Venezuela debe reemplazar su infraestructura electoral antes de celebrar nuevas elecciones, mientras mantiene negociaciones con el Gobierno interino de ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Estados Unidos considera que Venezuela debe reemplazar su infraestructura electoral antes de celebrar nuevas elecciones, mientras mantiene negociaciones con el Gobierno interino de Delcy Rodríguez sobre las condiciones de la transición política. Así lo afirmó este lunes el secretario de Estado estadounidense, Marco Rubio, quien también confirmó que Washington negoció con Caracas garantías para el regreso de María Corina Machado al país. Ver más: El chavismo responde al regreso de María Corina Machado con diálogo y advertencias Rubio sostuvo que el sistema electoral venezolano fue diseñado durante el Gobierno de Nicolás Maduro para manipular los resultados y que, por tanto, debe ser sustituido rápidamente para que puedan celebrarse comicios válidos. Las declaraciones se producen un día después del regreso de Machado a Venezuela, tras casi diez meses fuera del país, y en medio de las conversaciones impulsadas por Washington entre el Gobierno interino y sectores de la oposición. “Creo que estamos logrando avances reales en ese sentido”, dijo Rubio al referirse a las reformas institucionales en curso. “Pero si alguien intenta descarrilar ese proceso, le está haciendo un gran daño a Venezuela”, añadió durante una conversación telefónica con periodistas. Un alto funcionario del Departamento de Estado también dijo que Estados Unidos espera que las negociaciones permitan instalar un nuevo Tribunal Supremo de Justicia antes de finalizar 2026 y renovar el Consejo Nacional Electoral poco después. La hoja de ruta de Washington aunque no establece una fecha exacta para las nuevas elecciones, sí deja claro que tras la renovación de estos dos organismos, comenzaría un plazo de seis meses para celebrar una elección presidencial. Los nuevos miembros del ente electoral serían seleccionados por un comité de expertos mediante un proceso similar al previsto para el sistema judicial, aunque no necesitarían la aprobación de la Asamblea Nacional, de acuerdo a lo declarado por el funcionario, citado por Bloomberg. La renovación de las instituciones electorales es uno de los principales asuntos pendientes en las conversaciones políticas respaldadas por Washington. El proceso contempla cambios en el Poder Judicial y en el organismo encargado de organizar los comicios, antes de avanzar hacia una nueva convocatoria electoral. Las últimas elecciones presidenciales venezolanas se celebraron el 28 de julio de 2024. El Consejo Nacional Electoral proclamó la reelección de Maduro, pero no publicó los resultados desglosados por mesa, mientras que la oposición denunció fraude y defendió la victoria de Edmundo González Urrutia. Ver más: María Corina Machado regresa a Venezuela entre las diferencias de Washington y la presión por elecciones La reforma del sistema electoral adquiere relevancia en un contexto en el que todavía no existe un calendario oficial para nuevas elecciones. Machado ha defendido la celebración de comicios en 2027, mientras que Washington no ha establecido públicamente una fecha concreta. Las negociaciones actuales se desarrollan entre el Gobierno interino y representantes de un sector opositor encabezado por Dinorah Figuera. El movimiento Vente Venezuela, liderado por Machado, no está representado directamente en esa mesa de diálogo. En la misma conversación telefónica con periodistas, Rubio confirmó que Estados Unidos negoció semanas atrás con las autoridades interinas venezolanas para garantizar que Machado pudiera regresar al país sin sufrir represalias. “Hace semanas, y me refiero a muchas semanas, hablamos con las autoridades interinas y les dijimos que nuestra expectativa era que ella, como venezolana, pudiera regresar a su país”, afirmó. El secretario de Estado aseguró que Caracas aceptó la petición e incluso autorizó que Machado pudiera aterrizar directamente en un aeropuerto venezolano. “Nos dijeron que podía aterrizar en el aeropuerto si quería. Y nosotros se lo comunicamos a su equipo”, señaló. Delcy Rodríguez había sostenido más temprano que Machado pudo haber evitado el “espectáculo político” y utilizado, al igual que otros beneficiados por la ley de amnistía, las estructuras de aeropuertos. También indicó que esperaba que Machado mostrara “arrepentimiento, remordimiento, rectificación y pueda aportar algo al país”. Rubio explicó que la única ocasión en la que personalmente desaconsejó el regreso de la dirigente fue inmediatamente después de los terremotos del 24 de junio, cuando Washington priorizaba las operaciones de emergencia y la entrada de ayuda humanitaria. El funcionario también insistió en que Estados Unidos mantiene una capacidad considerable de presión sobre Caracas mediante las sanciones económicas y las licencias que permiten determinadas operaciones comerciales y financieras. Ver más: María Corina Machado se encuentra en Venezuela tras meses de exilio “Venezuela sigue siendo un país y una economía que funcionan bajo sanciones. Continúa fuertemente sancionada”, advirtió. Rubio agregó que no permitirá que el proceso político se prolongue indefinidamente y defendió el cumplimiento de los compromisos asumidos por las autoridades interinas. Las declaraciones sitúan la reforma de las instituciones electorales entre las prioridades de Washington para avanzar hacia nuevas elecciones, aunque todavía no hay una fecha definida ni un acuerdo público sobre el calendario completo de la transición.

items.title: Ravens coach hopeful QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) will play vs. Bills
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Baltimore Ravens coach Jesse Minter is optimistic that star quarterback Lamar Jackson will return from an ankle injury to play against the host Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
items.body:
Baltimore Ravens coach Jesse Minter is optimistic that star quarterback Lamar Jackson will return from an ankle injury to play against the host Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
Jackson has missed the past three games due to the high left ankle sprain sustained in the second quarter of a victory over the Tennessee Titans on Oct. 4.
"I think he was able to get in a little bit of work obviously towards the end of last week," Minter told reporters Monday. "And so I think he'll be in a decent spot, but we'll know a lot more on Wednesday."
The two-time NFL MVP was listed as questionable Friday for Baltimore's game against the Cincinnati Bengals, then ruled out one day later. The Ravens went on to lose 35-13.
CBS Sports said on its game broadcast that Jackson sustained a setback on Saturday and that was why he was scratched. Minter seemed to take exception to the suggestion.
"So look, if he's able to play -- that's healthy enough to play, and play the way that obviously we feel like he needs to play -- then he will play," Minter said.
The Ravens played a dominant first half against Cincinnati when they controlled the ball for over 22 minutes and led 13-0. But the Bengals steamrolled Baltimore in the second half with five straight touchdown drives.
Tyler "Snoop" Huntley passed for a career-best 298 yards against Cincinnati in his third straight start. Still, Baltimore hasn't scored a single point in the second halves of the past two games and is averaging 17.7 points in Huntley's three starts.
Minter didn't want to cite the absence of Jackson as the issue.
"Lamar's 1 of 1, right? Two-time MVP, obviously a high-caliber player, but I just don't like the built-in excuse of why things are going a certain way," Minter said. "So while we know the caliber of player Lamar is and the numbers when he's out there versus when he's not, we understand all that. That's why he's who he is and why he's won the awards that he's won, but we can still operate better in those times where we don't have him for sure."
--Field Level Media

items.title: ブラジル財務相、来年の基礎的収支黒字目標引き上げ方針　市場混乱に「介入」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター］ - ブラジルのドゥリガン財務相は２６日、地元メディアのインタビューで、政府が来年の実質的な基礎的財政収支（プライマリーバランス）黒字目標を引き上げる方針を明らかにした。ただ具体的な数値は示さなかった。

２５日に行われた大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ大統領が再選を収め、２６日の市場では財政悪化懸念から同国株・通貨に大規模な売りが出た。

ドゥリガン氏は、政策当局者に対して基礎的財政収支目標の中央値を正式な目標とすることを義務付ける法案を政府として年内に議会へ提出する考えを打ち出した。

また、国債市場取引の「合理性を確保する」ため介入したと述べた。予定していた国債入札を中止するとともに、臨時の国債買い戻しオペを実施した。

「短期、中期、長期のいずれの期間においても財政の安定性に関する議論に立ち戻り、目標中央値の達成を正式に追求するとともに、来年の黒字見通しを引き上げる」と述べた。

ブラジルは現在、来年の財政目標として基礎的財政収支を国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比０．５％の黒字とし、上下それぞれ０．２５ポイントの許容幅を設けている。もっとも現行の財政ルールでは、財政目標の達成状況を評価する際に一部歳出を計算から除外できる仕組みとなっており、裁判所命令に基づく政府債務の支払いの一部も除外対象に含まれる。

政府は８月時点で、来年の実質的な基礎的財政収支をＧＤＰ比０．１％の黒字と見込んでいた。実現すれば、２０２２年以来初の財政黒字となる。

投資家やエコノミストの間では、義務的支出の急増を踏まえると、この財政健全化のペースは不十分との見方が多い。こうした懸念を背景に、投資家はブラジル国債の保有に対し、より高いリスクプレミアムを要求している。

ブラジルの財政健全性を示す主要指標の政府総債務残高は、ルラ氏の現政権発足以降ＧＤＰ比で１０ポイント超上昇し、８２．９％に達している。

items.title: Trump administration loses push to block California votes from alleged noncitizens
items.author: Luc Cohen, Jan Wolfe
items.creator: Luc Cohen, Jan Wolfe
items.summary: A US appeals court on Monday ruled against President Donald Trump's administration in a major voting dispute ahead of the midterm elections, denying a request to block California from counting mail ballots from people on a list of more than 20,000 registered voters the federal government alleges are likely noncitizens.
items.body:
A US appeals court on Monday ruled against President Donald Trump's administration in a major voting dispute ahead of the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], denying a request to block California from counting mail ballots from people on a list of more than 20,000 registered voters the federal government alleges are likely noncitizens.
The 2-1 decision by the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals marked the latest setback in Trump's efforts to assert a greater federal role in overseeing elections in the run-up to the November 3 midterms in which his fellow Republicans are fighting to retain control of Congress.
The majority decision said the Justice Department had failed to give a lower court judge an adequate opportunity to consider the case, and therefore it would be premature for the appeals court to weigh in. The lower court judge has scheduled a hearing on Tuesday in the case.
Circuit Judge Gabriel Sanchez, one of the two judges in the majority, wrote in a concurring opinion that the federal government "asks the federal court to dictate to a state legislature a matter squarely within the state's traditional domain, upending the state's policies in this regard and inviting disorder and confusion for voters and election officials alike."
The lawsuit was an escalation in the Trump administration's pressure on state election officials over alleged noncitizen voting and a rare intervention by the Justice Department in the voting process weeks before an election.
The California lawsuit was the first time the Trump administration sought to prevent a state from counting votes, though it did not indicate how many of the 20,000 people on its list had actually submitted a mail ballot.
Justice Department officials said on October 19 that the 20,000 people included 28 who had been criminally charged with illegally voting.
California is the most populous US state and a Democratic stronghold. It has more seats in the House of Representatives — 52 — than any other state. Democrats are seeking to regain control of the House from Trump's fellow Republicans in the midterms.
Trump has made California a focal point of his sweeping immigration crackdown since returning to the White House, accusing it of undermining public safety through its "sanctuary state" policies that limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Trump has long asserted that California's immigration policies have facilitated voter fraud.
All available evidence indicates that ineligible voting, including noncitizen voting, is exceedingly rare. A Reuters investigation published in July found just 129 cases in which noncitizens were federally charged with voting illegally; many appeared to stem from voter confusion or administrative errors, rather than intentional fraud.
The Justice Department filed its [USN:SPN45000O TEXT:"lawsuit"] on October 15 in federal court in Los Angeles. The lawsuit asked a federal judge to order California to separate any ballots it received from people on the administration's list from the rest of the ballots, and not to count them until it had verified that the people who cast the ballots were citizens.
The Justice Department filed an emergency motion with the 9th Circuit to expedite the case.
California says the state's safeguards against noncitizen voting are robust, and asserted in a court filing that the Justice Department's assertions relied on "suspect data."
"At best, this litigation is a reckless political stunt," lawyers for California Secretary of State Shirley Weber said in an October 20 court filing. "At worst, it threatens to disenfranchise thousands of Californians this election."
Voting rights activists have expressed concern that the Trump administration's methods for scrutinizing state voter lists to identify noncitizens risk wrongly flagging naturalized US citizens for removal from the rolls.
The Justice Department has told election officials in all 50 states that they could face criminal prosecution if they knowingly allowed noncitizens to remain on their rolls or [USN:L1N46212B TEXT:"cast ballots"]. It has sued 30 states and Washington, DC, for refusing to provide complete voter rolls including voters' sensitive personal data, but has lost 26 of those cases so far without winning one.
"Today’s ruling is a positive development and a welcome speed bump to Trump’s disgusting attacks on the Constitution and our country’s democracy," said California Attorney General Rob Bonta, a Democrat.

items.title: ロシアがキーウ攻撃、1人死亡　地下鉄駅や医療施設に被害＝市長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - ウクライナの首都キーウで２６日、ロシア軍のミサイル攻撃により少なくとも１人が死亡し、地下鉄駅や医療施設が損傷した。クリチコ市長が明らかにした。 

クリチコ氏は通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で、暫定情報によるとスーパーマーケット付近で１人が死亡したと述べた。また、市内各地で７人が負傷したと語った。

地下鉄駅のすぐそばでも攻撃があったと述べた。非公式のテレグラムチャンネルに投稿された写真には、駅や路面電車の被害の様子が写っていた。

クリチコ氏によると、爆発により医療施設２カ所の窓ガラスが割れた。また、着弾現場の一つに急行した救急隊の隊員１人が攻撃を受けたという。

ロイターの記者によると、市内では相次いで爆発が起きた。ドニプロ川東岸の地区では停電が発生したという。

ロシア政府は、民間人を標的にしていることを否定している。

items.title: Spurs embrace goal of progress as they host winless Kings
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Every season is a new one and each game is an opportunity to learn and improve, even for a San Antonio team that returned its top 10 players from its run to the NBA Finals last year.
items.body:
Every season is a new one and each game is an opportunity to learn and improve, even for a San Antonio team that returned its top 10 players from its run to the NBA Finals last year.
The Spurs host the winless Sacramento Kings on Tuesday, three nights after earning -- but not celebrating -- their initial victory of the season.
The Spurs head home after a 122-106 win over the short-handed Mavericks in Dallas on Saturday, with Victor Wembanyama scoring a team-high 23 points and grabbing seven rebounds.
The Spurs led by just three points beginning the final period but swamped Dallas down the stretch, building as much as a 23-point lead and cruising to the finish line. Dylan Harper added 22 points, De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle scored 19 apiece, Julian Champagnie hit for 12 off the bench and Devin Vassell tallied 11 points for San Antonio.
While it's hard to say the Spurs "righted the ship" after losing their first two games to Oklahoma City and Houston, respectively, Wembanyama admitted this campaign's start feels different than last year. San Antonio surprised most pundits by winning the Western Conference in 2026.
"It's a different sort of challenge, but I guess it's like everything," Wembanyama explained. "The best, or maybe the only, way to learn is to go through it. I don't know if frustrating is the word, but I would say I'm experiencing, you know, learning how to navigate it."
Spurs coach Mitch Johnson refused to allow his team to celebrate the win.
"We've played three games, and we've got stretches of the games where we're getting our butts kicked," Johnson said. "There's a lot of things we can control and we've got to be better at that."
"If you were in the locker room you would have thought we lost the game," Fox added.
The Kings were forecast to be near the bottom of the West standings in the preseason and have done little to dispel that prediction, losing their first three contests of the year while allowing at least 121 points in each game.
Sacramento's most recent setback was a 123-112 home loss to Memphis on Sunday, in which the Kings surrendered an 11-0 run to the visiting Grizzlies with 5:28 left and never recovered.
"I have to be better for them," Kings coach Doug Christie said after Sunday's loss. "This isn't on them. I'll take this."
Zach LaVine's 37 points led all scorers while rookie guard Darius Acuff Jr. had 22 points and a game-high seven assists. Domantas Sabonis added 15 points and 15 rebounds, while Precious Achiuwa posted 12 points and 10 rebounds for the Kings, whose defensive struggles have overshadowed individual offensive performances.
"If we're not a defensive team, we still have to figure out how to get stops," LaVine said. "We have talented offensive players. I'm not worried about that."
Acuff has attempted 73 field goals, the most by any player through his first three NBA games in the past 50 years, but has made just 24 (32.9%).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Bottoms Says Georgia Needs Pause on New Data Centers
items.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms, Georgia's Democratic gubernatorial candidate, in a pre-recorded interview, says she wants to pause new data center construction while the state examines the industry's impact on the electric grid, consumer costs, public health and water supplies. Bottoms says the pause could last from one month to six months or longer and says the state should determine whether Georgia needs additional data centers and how to allow future development responsibly. Bottoms says Georgia should expand Medicaid, arguing that 300,000 people lack health insurance coverage because the state has not done so and that nine rural hospitals have closed. Bottoms says she supports responsible, lawful immigration enforcement, but opposes tactics she thinks are disruptive to communities and local law enforcement. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（26日）株反発　ユーロと円下落　原油6カ月ぶり高値圏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜為替＞ 中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統領選の決選投票で現職のルラ大統領が再選を果たしたことを受け、ブラジルレアルは急落した。 

ユーロは先週、フランス国債の売りにより同国の債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に押し上げられたことで、下押し圧力を受けていた。ただ、この日のフランス国債価格は上昇。格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いたことで、社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ。

ただ、ソシエテ・ジェネラルの外為戦略責任者、キット・ジュークス氏は「ユーロを巡る根本的な問題は変わっておらず、スプレッドは縮小している」と指摘。「成長見通しが良好ではなく、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、ユーロは現時点でなお脆弱だ」と語った。  

この日の北海ブレント先物は軟

＜為替＞ 中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統領選の決選投票で現職のルラ大統領が再選を果たしたことを受け、ブラジルレアルは急落した。 

ユーロは先週、フランス国債の売りにより同国の債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に押し上げられたことで、下押し圧力を受けていた。ただ、この日のフランス国債価格は上昇。格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いたことで、社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ。

ただ、ソシエテ・ジェネラルの外為戦略責任者、キット・ジュークス氏は「ユーロを巡る根本的な問題は変わっておらず、スプレッドは縮小している」と指摘。「成長見通しが良好ではなく、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、ユーロは現時点でなお脆弱だ」と語った。  

この日の北海ブレント先物は軟化したものの、依然として約６カ月ぶりの高値付近にとどまった。

市場の注目は、今週予定される主要中銀の金融政策発表に集まる。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀はいずれも金利を据え置くと見込まれている。ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）とカナダの中銀は利上げすると予想されている。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３１％高の１０２となった。前出のジュークス氏は「ドルは予想ほど堅調ではなく、いくらか逆風もあるが、米経済指標はかなり底堅い」と述べた。 

円は対ドルで０．４３％安の１ドル＝１５７．４６円。

ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１７９ドル。対円では０．３１％高の１７６．０４円となった。

ブラジルレアルは対ドルで８．５％安の１ドル＝５．４レアル。ブラジル大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り、史上初となる通算４期目の大統領職を担うことになった。ボルソナロ氏は第１回投票では首位に立ったが、決選投票では４００万票超の差で敗れた。最高裁が２５日に投票時間を２時間延長する判断を下したことを理由に、選挙結果の無効を求める意向を示した。

ゴールドマン・サックスのテレサ・アルベス氏率いるアナリストチームは投資家向けリポートで、「選挙結果を巡る争いが長引くリスクは市場心理に悪影響を及ぼすが、より根本的には、過去数週間で大幅な財政緩和が実施されたことを踏まえると、レアルなどの現地資産には一段と大きな財政プレミアムが反映されるべきだと考える」と指摘した。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　１０年債利回りがおおむね横ばいで推移した。市場では２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）のほか、週内の一連の大手ＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業の決算発表が注目されている。

今回のＦＯＭＣでは金利据え置きが決定されるとの見方が大勢。ただ、インフレ警戒感が根強い中、利上げ休止が長期間続くとも予想されていない。ＴＤ証券の米金利戦略責任者、ゲンナディー・ゴールドバーグ氏は「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は景気を損なうことなく、段階的な利上げを続けたいと考えている。それが最大の焦点で、１２月の次回会合で追加利上げを決定すると予想している」と指摘。ただ「ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長は（今回のＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見で）今後の見通しについて多くを示唆するとは予想していない」と述べた。

ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。経済指標が強弱まちまちとなっていることなどを受け、今回のＦＯＭＣでの利上げ観測は後退しており、市場データによると今回の会合で金利据え置きが決定される確率は約９０％。１２月の会合で追加利上げが実施される確率は約８０％と見込まれている。

この日はＡＩ開発の米アンソロピックが米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開。これを受けＡＩ関連株が買われ、米株式市場全体も上昇した。今週は、マイクロソフト、アルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コムなどが相次いで四半期決算を発表。ＡＩを巡る動向が引き続き市場の焦点になると見られている。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは４．９８８％と前営業日比横ばい。

３０年債利回りは１．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の５．３０％。

２年債利回りは３．２ｂｐ上昇の４．７１４％。２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２７．２ｂｐ。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請がＡＩ関連株への投資家心理を押し上げた。前週まで週足で続落していたＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は、下落に歯止めをかけた。

アンソロピックは２６日、米国でのＩＰＯ申請書類を公開した。巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになり、開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

今週は２８日の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策決定、２９日の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）およびインフレ指標のほか、週を通じて多数の企業決算発表が予定されている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種構成企業の３分の１超が今週決算を発表する。ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）のアルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムも含まれ、巨額のＡＩ投資が成長につながっているかどうかが注目される。 

ＲＷＡウェルス・パートナーズの最高投資責任者、ＪＰ・パワーズ氏は「きょうはアンソロピックの開示が全てで、相場は再びやや楽観的な方向に傾いていると言える。ただ、開示内容は多岐にわたる。実際に上場する際、投資家にどの程度好意的に受け止められるかが注目される」と述べた。

その上で「各材料が同じ方向を示さなければ、相場が振り回されるリスクがある。きょうは少し楽観的だが、今週の他の発表を受けて何が起きるかは分からない」との見方を示した。

ＡＩブームの最大の恩恵を受ける分野の一つとみられている半導体関連銘柄が相場上昇を後押しした。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％上昇したが、月初来では依然として１２．２％下落している。

メタは１．９％下落。ＡＩ向けデータセンターやクラウドコンピューティングの拡充などに伴う巨額の費用を賄うため、最大９５０億ドルの資本調達を実施する計画を発表した。

ＡＩ関連の取引は今月、借り入れコストの上昇を受けて債務で賄う支出の正当化が難しくなりかねないとの懸念から圧力にさらされてきた。

ただ、アンソロピックのＩＰＯ申請が投資家心理を支え、コアウィーブを含むネオクラウド企業は序盤の下げから切り返した。

その他のＡＩ関連企業も好調で、光学部品メーカーのルメンタムが約８％、コヒレントが約６％、それぞれ上昇した。

超大型株とグロース（成長）株も大半が上昇。テスラは５．２％急伸し、終値で３カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。バークレイズが投資判断を「イコールウエート」から「オーバーウエート」に引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３６対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０９対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６７億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格が６カ月ぶり高値付近から下落し、インフレ懸念が和らいだことを背景に反発した。スポット金は０．６％高の１オンス＝４０２０．６０ドルとなり、１２月物の米金先物は０．８％高の１オンス＝４０３８．４０ドルで取引を終えた。前週末に７月２０日以来の安値を付けていたが、原油安や安値拾いの買いが支援材料となった。 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策決定会合を控え、今週は様子見ムードが強い。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 北海ブレント先物が下落して取引を終えた。中東での戦闘が和らぐとの期待が広がった。ただ、主要産油国サウジアラビアや海上輸送への攻撃が続いているため、投資家は警戒を緩めていない。価格は約６カ月ぶりの高値近くにとどまった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．９１ドル（０．８％）安の１バレル＝１１５．８１ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．５１ドル（１．４６％）安の１０１．７６ドル。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

ＡＩブームの最大の恩恵を受ける分野の一つとみられている半導体関連銘柄が相場上昇を後押しした。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％上昇したが、月初来では依然として１２．２％下落している。

メタは１．９％下落。ＡＩ向けデータセンターやクラウドコンピューティングの拡充などに伴う巨額の費用を賄うため、最大９５０億ドルの資本調達を実施する計画を発表した。

ＡＩ関連の取引は今月、借り入れコストの上昇を受けて債務で賄う支出の正当化が難しくなりかねないとの懸念から圧力にさらされてきた。

ただ、アンソロピックのＩＰＯ申請が投資家心理を支え、コアウィーブを含むネオクラウド企業は序盤の下げから切り返した。

その他のＡＩ関連企業も好調で、光学部品メーカーのルメンタムが約８％、コヒレントが約６％、それぞれ上昇した。

超大型株とグロース（成長）株も大半が上昇。テスラは５．２％急伸し、終値で３カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。バークレイズが投資判断を「イコールウエート」から「オーバーウエート」に引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３６対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０９対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６７億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。 

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格が６カ月ぶり高値付近から下落し、インフレ懸念が和らいだことを背景に反発した。スポット金は０．６％高の１オンス＝４０２０．６０ドルとなり、１２月物の米金先物は０．８％高の１オンス＝４０３８．４０ドルで取引を終えた。前週末に７月２０日以来の安値を付けていたが、原油安や安値拾いの買いが支援材料となった。 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策決定会合を控え、今週は様子見ムードが強い。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 北海ブレント先物が下落して取引を終えた。中東での戦闘が和らぐとの期待が広がった。ただ、主要産油国サウジアラビアや海上輸送への攻撃が続いているため、投資家は警戒を緩めていない。価格は約６カ月ぶりの高値近くにとどまった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．９１ドル（０．８％）安の１バレル＝１１５．８１ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．５１ドル（１．４６％）安の１０１．７６ドル。

FAST

MADRID, Oct 26 : Spain on Monday unveiled a more flexible version of its proposed decree governing data centers after a wave of project announcements in the country, according to officials at the energy ministry.
• The revised proposal raises the threshold for the rules to apply, extends the time frame for developers to demonstrate renewable-energy commitments and introduces a transition period for meeting clean-power targets.
• The initial proposal said that rules would apply to facilities with more than 1 megawatt of power capacity. That threshold has now been increased to more than 10 MW.
• Originally, every new megawatt of energy used had to be matched by a new megawatt of renewable energy installed in the 18 months before the facility starts operation. Now, the time frame has been extended to 36 months before the start of operation, and there is no time limit for solar energy.

• The latest proposal maintains that renewable energy would have to cover at least 80 per cent of data centers' energy supply for every hour of operation. The new proposal offers an alternative: a transition period of up to five years to reach that threshold under several conditions.
• With abundant renewable energy and large swaths of empty land, Spain has emerged as one of the hottest hubs in Europe, attracting projects tied to artificial intelligence infrastructure worth tens of billions of euros.

items.title: Aprovação de Trump sobe para 32% antes das eleições de meio de mandato, mostra pesquisa Reuters Ipsos
items.author: Jason Lange
items.creator: Jason Lange
items.summary: O índice de aprovação pública do presidente Donald Trump subiu ligeiramente para 32%, um ponto percentual acima de sua mínima histórica registrada uma semana antes, às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato dos EUA, marcadas para 3 de novembro, que decidirão qual partido controlará o Congresso, de acordo com uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos encerrada nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
O índice de aprovação pública do presidente Donald Trump subiu ligeiramente para 32%, um ponto percentual acima de sua mínima histórica registrada uma semana antes, às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato dos EUA, marcadas para 3 de novembro, que decidirão qual partido controlará o Congresso, de acordo com uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos encerrada nesta segunda-feira.
Os pares republicanos de Trump estão lutando para manter a maioria do partido na Câmara dos Deputados e no Senado.
A pesquisa de cinco dias, realizada em todo o país, também mostrou que os eleitores registrados preferiam amplamente os democratas aos republicanos, por 47% a 36%, quando questionados sobre em qual partido votariam na chamada “votação genérica”. Cerca de 11% afirmaram não saber em quem votariam se a eleição ocorresse hoje.
Essa diferença de 11 pontos percentuais entre democratas e republicanos foi 1 ponto percentual menor do que na pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos encerrada em 19 de outubro. A pesquisa encerrada nesta segunda-feira também perguntou aos eleitores indecisos para qual partido estavam inclinados. Levando em conta suas respostas, a disputa nacional parecia um pouco mais acirrada, com os democratas liderando por 9 pontos percentuais, 50% contra 41%.
Para os republicanos, perder o controle de qualquer uma das Casas do Congresso poderia complicar a agenda de Trump nos últimos dois anos de seu segundo mandato como presidente.
As pesquisas de votação genérica são pesquisas nacionais que oferecem uma visão geral sobre qual partido os entrevistados gostariam de ver no comando do Congresso. Embora essas pesquisas ofereçam uma visão do sentimento público nacional, elas não captam as nuances das disputas Estado a Estado e distrito a distrito que determinam o controle do Senado e da Câmara, disputas nas quais os republicanos detêm algumas vantagens estruturais.
A pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos, realizada online, reuniu respostas de 1.679 adultos norte-americanos, incluindo 1.280 eleitores registrados, e teve uma margem de erro de 2 pontos percentuais para todos os adultos e de 3 pontos para os eleitores registrados.

items.title: Inquérito da ONU afirma que Israel continuou genocídio em Gaza após trégua
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israel continuou cometendo genocídio em Gaza após o cessar-fogo mediado pelos Estados Unidos, em outubro passado, afirmou uma comissão da ONU em um relatório publicado nesta segunda-feira, considerado por Israel como parte de uma “campanha de desinformação”.
items.body:
Israel continuou cometendo genocídio em Gaza após o cessar-fogo mediado pelos Estados Unidos, em outubro passado, afirmou uma comissão da ONU em um relatório publicado nesta segunda-feira, considerado por Israel como parte de uma “campanha de desinformação”.
O relatório da Comissão Internacional Independente de Inquérito da ONU sobre o Território Palestino Ocupado, incluindo Jerusalém Oriental, e Israel examinou as violações contra crianças palestinas do início da guerra entre Israel e o Hamas, em 7 de outubro de 2023, até setembro deste ano.
O relatório afirma que as autoridades israelenses continuaram cometendo “atos genocidas com a intenção genocida de destruir, no todo ou em parte, os palestinos em Gaza”, e que a situação também continuou se deteriorando na Cisjordânia ocupada.
Outro relatório da comissão, divulgado em setembro do ano passado, concluiu que Israel havia cometido genocídio em Gaza e que autoridades israelenses de alto escalão, incluindo o primeiro-ministro, Benjamin Netanyahu, incitaram esses atos -- acusações que Israel considerou escandalosas.
A missão israelense em Genebra afirmou que o último relatório faz parte de uma campanha de desinformação para demonizar o Estado de Israel.
“A tentativa de destruir o Estado judeu... continua até hoje por meio de esforços de atores como a Comissão de Inquérito da ONU para minar a legitimidade de Israel e negar seu direito fundamental de existir e se defender”, afirmou o embaixador Daniel Meron em comunicado.
MUNIÇÃO PESADA A comissão constatou que as forças israelenses continuaram usando munições pesadas, drones, quadricópteros, artilharia e tiros de atiradores em áreas densamente povoadas durante o cessar-fogo em Gaza.
Segundo a comissão, a “Linha Amarela” -- apresentada como uma demarcação temporária do cessar-fogo -- está se estendendo cada vez mais para dentro de Gaza, tornando-se uma fronteira de fato, o que, segundo o relatório, reflete a expansão do controle territorial de Israel sobre Gaza.
Autoridades palestinas afirmam que mais de 74.000 pessoas foram mortas no ataque de Israel a Gaza, iniciado após combatentes liderados pelo Hamas matarem cerca de 1.200 pessoas no sul de Israel em 7 de outubro de 2023.
Em seu relatório ao Conselho de Segurança da ONU, a comissão afirmou que a situação na Cisjordânia também se deteriorou drasticamente, com o número de palestinos mortos em ataques aéreos aumentando de seis entre 2008 e 6 de outubro de 2023 para 254 entre 7 de outubro de 2023 e 30 de setembro de 2026.
O presidente da comissão, Srinivasan Muralidhar, afirmou que o assassinato intencional de civis palestinos e a destruição de residências na Cisjordânia fazem parte de uma estratégia mais ampla para exterminar e deslocar os palestinos.
Operações militares desde janeiro de 2025 levaram ao maior deslocamento de palestinos na Cisjordânia desde 1967, com 34.176 palestinos ainda deslocados em agosto de 2026, segundo o relatório.
A comissão também criticou a Autoridade Palestina, afirmando que ela havia perseguido palestinos que expressavam opiniões divergentes e que jornalistas e defensores dos direitos humanos haviam sido mortos e feridos.

items.title: Brasileña Gerdau reporta un beneficio de 1.520 millones de reales en el tercer trimestre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Gerdau anunció el lunes que obtuvo un beneficio neto ajustado de 1.520 millones de reales en el tercer trimestre, lo que supone un aumento del 39,7% interanual, según el balance presentado al mercado.
items.body:
Gerdau (GGBR4.SA) anunció el lunes que obtuvo un beneficio neto ajustado de 1.520 millones de reales en el tercer trimestre, lo que supone un aumento del 39,7% interanual, según el balance presentado al mercado.
La empresa registró un resultado operativo, medido por el beneficio antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciación y amortización (EBITDA) ajustado, de 3.770 millones de reales, lo que supone un crecimiento del 37,8% en comparación con el mismo periodo del año anterior.
Los analistas esperaban, de media, que Gerdau anunciara un beneficio neto de 1.770 millones de reales, con un Ebitda de 3.700 millones de reales, según datos recopilados por LSEG.
La empresa registró ventas de acero de 2,91 millones de toneladas entre julio y finales de septiembre, un 5,6% menos que el año anterior. La facturación neta creció un 3,9% a 18.700 millones de reales, frente a la previsión media del mercado de 18.600 millones de reales.
Las operaciones de Gerdau en Norteamérica, principal fuente de flujo de caja de la empresa, registraron un crecimiento del 60% en el EBITDA ajustado del periodo a 2.900 millones de reales, lo que equivale al 76,4% del resultado operativo total del grupo. El margen pasó del 19,8% de hace un año al 27,7%.
Por su parte, en Brasil, la empresa registró una caída del 2,8% en el EBITDA ajustado con respecto al tercer trimestre del año pasado a 741 millones de reales, mientras que el margen pasó del 9,9% al 10,7%.

items.title: Raiders streaking wrong way, will stick with Kirk Cousins at QB
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A four-game losing streak will not force the Raiders to make a change at quarterback.
items.body:
A four-game losing streak will not force the Raiders to make a change at quarterback.
Head coach Klint Kubiak cleared the air on Monday with a strong commitment to keeping Kirk Cousins as the starter despite Las Vegas losing for the fourth consecutive week on Sunday, 35-21, to the Rams.
Kubiak opened the door to speculation when he said Sunday night in response to a question about No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza getting into the lineup that the Raiders would "look at everything."
The tune changed Monday
"(Cousins) is playing at a very high level, and he's got to continue to do that for us to win," Kubiak said. "We got to keep helping all the areas around him. Excited for him to go play against the Jets."
After a 3-0 start, the Raiders have been plagued by familiar issues. But Cousins is first in the NFL with 16 TD passes and ranks third in the league with 1,877 passing yards.
"I think at this point, we're thinking about everything," Kubiak said Sunday night. "How to fix our problems, how to fix our issues in the red zone, in the third quarter. Personnel, scheme, we've got to talk about all of it."
Cousins completed 26 of 44 passes for 295 yards and two touchdowns Sunday and his performance wasn't entirely detrimental to the Raiders. Las Vegas was 3-of-14 on third downs and scored a touchdown on one of five trips to the red zone.
"It's really the same every day that it was in March or April," Cousins said when asked about ceding the position to Mendoza. "Nothing changes in the sense that, if I'm not the best option, then I don't want to be out there either. The first OTA, if that had become apparent, I would have been the first one to say, ‘Yeah, you can't play me.'
"So nothing changes. The organization will do what they feel is best. I feel that Fernando's done a great job and has a bright future ahead, and I'm going to try to go out there and play as well as I possibly can, help us win, and give him a great example to learn from until he does go out there eventually."
Mendoza has completed 6 of 8 passes for 48 yards, all in mop up duty at New England on Oct. 11.
Drafted first overall in April, Mendoza was the Heisman Trophy winner and led Indiana to the national championship in 2025. But he's been QB2 most of his stint in Las Vegas.
Kubiak and general manager John Spytek made it clear Cousins, 38, would begin the 2026 season as the Raiders' starter.
Not executing in the red zone was the main issue that left Kubiak miffed on Sunday.
"It comes down to we have to make plays down there when we have our one-on-one opportunities," Kubiak said. "Got to make the throws, got to make the catches. Didn't happen."
--Field Level Media

items.body:
An Illinois man was charged on Monday with sending threatening letters to at least four US lawmakers, with the mailings containing a white granular powder that did not have any hazardous substances.
The FBI said in a court filing the man, Matthew G. Unglesbee, admitted to sending the letters, telling agents he sent them after reading stories about other suspicious mailings sent to state election officials and lawmakers' offices ahead of the November 3 midterm elections. Unglesbee told the FBI he did not send the earlier letters.
A lawyer for Unglesbee could not immediately be identified.

items.title: Mayulu, Godts send PSG top with win over Olympique Lyonnais
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Substitutes Senny Mayulu and Mika Godts scored superb second-half goals as Paris St Germain moved to the top of Ligue 1 with a hard-fought 2-0 home win over Olympique Lyonnais on Monday.
items.body:
Substitutes Senny Mayulu and Mika Godts scored superb second-half goals as Paris St Germain moved to the top of Ligue 1 with a hard-fought 2-0 home win over Olympique Lyonnais on Monday.
PSG have 17 points from eight games, one more than second-placed Rennes, while Lyon are in fifth with 14 points, having missed the chance to top the table themselves.
PSG have now won their last eight games in all competitions and fifth in Ligue 1, showing ominous form.
The fixture was played on the same evening as the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London, where PSG had a record 10 players nominated for various awards.
Mayulu struck 18 minutes from the end as he was fed on the edge of the box by Godts, took a touch and drilled his shot low into the left-hand corner of the net.
It was a first goal since April for the 20-year-old, and a timely one as PSG struggled to break down their stubborn visitors.
Godts made sure of the points with his first goal for the club since his arrival from Ajax Amsterdam this season as he latched onto a long pass and fired home from the edge of the box.
Home goalkeeper Matvey Safonov was far busier than his counterpart in the first half as he made a stunning save to deny Julien Duranville.
PSG fans paid tribute to midfielder Khvicha Kvaratskhelia before the match as he undergoes surgery in Qatar for a rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament in his knee.

items.title: トランプ氏支持率32％、過去最低から小幅上昇　中間選挙控え＝世論調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jason Lange

[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスの最新の世論調査で、１１月３日の中間選挙を控え、トランプ米大統領の支持率が３２％と、１週間前に記録した過去最低水準の３１％から１％ポイント上昇した。

「ジェネリック・バロット（一般投票意向）」に関する項目の
items.body:
Jason Lange

[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスの最新の世論調査で、１１月３日の中間選挙を控え、トランプ米大統領の支持率が３２％と、１週間前に記録した過去最低水準の３１％から１％ポイント上昇した。

「ジェネリック・バロット（一般投票意向）」に関する項目の 「きょう議会選挙が行われるとしたらどちらの党の候補に投票するか」との質問では、登録有権者の４７％が民主党、３６％が共和党と回答し、民主党のリードは１１％ポイントとなった。誰に投票するか分からないとの回答は約１１％だった。

１０月１９日終了の前回調査では、民主党のリードは今回の選挙サイクルで最大となる１２％ポイントまで拡大していた。

今回の調査では、どちらに投票するかまだ決めていない有権者に対し、どちらの政党に傾いているか追加で質問した。これらの回答を考慮すると、全国的に見た両党の差はやや縮まり、共和党（４１％）に対する民主党（５０％）のリードは９％ポイントとなった。

実際にどれだけの有権者が投票に行くかは不透明だ。投票する可能性が最も高いとみられる有権者の間でも、民主党（５３％）が共和党（４４％）を９％ポイントリードした。

議会の主導権争いでは、インフレに対する有権者の見方が鍵となっているもようだ。トランプ氏が２月にイランへの軍事攻撃を命じて以降、ガソリン価格が上昇しインフレが急加速した。調査では、有権者の約７３％が生活費について状況が悪化していると回答した。

戦争開始前のロイター／イプソス調査では、米経済のかじ取り役として有権者が民主党よりも共和党を支持していた。今回の調査では、経済政策で民主党の方が優れているとした有権者は３７％で、共和党を選んだ３３％を上回った。

投票への意欲も民主党支持者の方が高いことが示された。中間選挙への投票に非常に意欲的だと回答した割合は、民主党支持者が４６％だったのに対し、共和党支持者は３０％だった。

調査は２６日まで５日間にわたりオンラインで実施され、米国の成人１６７９人（うち登録有権者１２８０人）から回答を得た。誤差は回答者全体でプラスマイナス２％ポイント、登録有権者でプラスマイナス３％ポイント。
