items.title: Trump campaigns in unexpectedly competitive Mississippi
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt
items.summary: President Donald Trump headed on Monday to deeply Republican Mississippi where an unexpectedly competitive US Senate race has given Democrats a rare opening ahead of next week's congressional elections.
items.body:
President Donald Trump headed on Monday to deeply Republican Mississippi where an unexpectedly competitive US Senate race has given Democrats a rare opening ahead of next week's congressional elections.
Trump, a Republican, has been visiting normally safe Republican states as part of a final blitz ahead of the November 3 vote, with party strategists telling Reuters they are on edge about races from Alaska to South Carolina.
Trump is expected to visit Texas, Ohio, South Carolina, Florida and Iowa in the final days of the campaign. The president was due to start speaking at 6 p.m. CDT (2300 GMT).
All 435 seats in the US House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 Senate seats are on the ballot, with public opinion polls suggesting the Democrats will regain control of the House and have a chance to retake the Senate.
A Republican victory would preserve Republican control of Congress, which Trump has enjoyed since returning to the White House after the 2024 election, while a Democratic victory could impede the president and trigger congressional investigations into his administration.
LAST DEMOCRAT ELECTED SENATOR IN MISSISSIPPI 44 YEARS AGO Democrats last won a Senate seat in Mississippi in 1982. Trump carried the state by nearly 23 percentage points in 2024, and he won the northeastern Mississippi county he was set to visit on Monday by 68 percentage points.
But several election analysts no longer regard US Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith’s reelection as a sure bet. The Trump-endorsed Republican faces Democrat Scott Colom, a district attorney from the Columbus area, and independent Ty Pinkins, a military veteran and attorney who previously ran statewide as a Democrat.
Senate Majority PAC announced a $1.2 million ad campaign in support of Colom last week, and Democrats have dispatched big-name figures from former Vice President Kamala Harris to former presidential primary candidate Pete Buttigieg to campaign alongside the Democratic candidate.
Colom said he would attend Monday’s Trump rally to talk to voters about their concerns.
Mikel Bolden, executive director of the Mississippi Democratic Party, said in an emailed statement that Trump’s policies had “created real uncertainty around healthcare, food assistance, economic stability, and voting rights.”
Democrats are contesting all three Republican-held House seats in Mississippi, but none is viewed as a likely pickup opportunity. A fourth seat, represented by US Representative Bennie Thompson in a heavily Black district, is considered safe for the Democrats.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Stephen Nellis　Aditya Soni

[サンフランシスコ ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:

[サンフランシスコ ２６日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２６日、２３日に発売した同社初の折り畳み式スマートフォンｉＰｈｏｎｅ「Ｄｕｏ（デュオ）」の一部で画面に不具合が生じていることを認め、対象端末を交換すると発表した。

週末には、ｉＰｈｏｎｅ　Ｄｕｏの折り畳み部分に当たる中央のヒンジに沿って、内側の画面にひびや線が生じた様子が交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿された。

アップルは２６日に不具合を認め、対象端末では問題が早期に現れる傾向があると説明した。

不具合の原因についてはコメントしなかった。

電子機器の分解調査報告や修理手順を公開するｉＦｉｘｉｔ（アイフィックスイット）は、分解映像や特許、コンピューター断層撮影（ＣＴ）の画像を使い、デュオのヒンジの３次元シミュレーションを作成し、報告された破損箇所と比較した。その結果、報告された破損は、中央の支持バー付近で画面の下を通るディスプレーケーブルのすぐ下に集中していたという。端末を折り畳む際に、このバーが画面に干渉しない位置まで下がらず、「報告された破損箇所の近くの狭い範囲に応力が集中している」可能性があると説明した。

アップルはｉＦｉｘｉｔの調査結果について、直ちにコメントしなかった。

items.title: US judge pauses discovery on NY Times' retaliation claim against EEOC
items.author: Daniel Wiessner
items.creator: Daniel Wiessner
items.summary: A US magistrate judge in Manhattan on Monday paused evidence gathering on the New York Times' claim that the US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission violated the newspaper's constitutional rights by suing it for passing over a white man for a top editorial role.
items.body:
A US magistrate judge in Manhattan on Monday paused evidence gathering on [USN:L6N43C12L TEXT:"the New York Times' claim"] that the US Equal Employment Opportunity Commission violated the newspaper's constitutional rights by suing it for passing over a white man for a top editorial role.
US Magistrate Judge Robyn Tarnofsky said it made sense to pause discovery until the court decides the EEOC's motion to dismiss the Times' counterclaims
The EEOC [USN:L6N41I0ZK TEXT:"sued in May"], accusing the Times of race and sex discrimination in pursuit of its diversity goals
The Times' countersuit says the newspaper was targeted for coverage critical of President Donald Trump's administration
Discovery in the EEOC's underlying lawsuit can proceed, Tarnofsky said
The Times argued that it would be inefficient to stay discovery on its claim but not those made by the commission, since they involve overlapping facts
But Tarnofsky said the EEOC made "substantial arguments" in defense of its lawsuit that should be decided first
The case is part of a [USN:L8N42O1L3 TEXT:"broader crackdown"] on diversity, equity and inclusion policies in the private sector, government and education
The case is EEOC v. The New York Times Company, US District Court for the Southern District of New York, No. 1:26-cv-03704.
For the EEOC: Benjamin North and Carl Chang
For the New York Times: Theodore Boutrous of Gibson Dunn & Crutcher; and Evandro Gigante and Atoyia Harris of Proskauer Rose
For Bryant Rousseau: Daniel Vitagliano of Consovoy McCarthy
Read more:
[USN:L6N41I0ZK TEXT:"New York Times sued by US employment agency over diversity, hiring"]
[USN:L6N43C12L TEXT:"New York Times countersues US employment agency over DEI lawsuit"]

items.title: Ex-FBI chief Comey faces third prosecution attempt by Trump Justice Department
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Justice Department is attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey for a third time, the latest case accusing him of sharing sensitive national security information in 2016, according to court documents made public on Monday.
items.body:
The US Justice Department is attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey for a third time, the latest case accusing him of sharing sensitive national security information in 2016, according to court documents made public on Monday.
The case was revealed in a court document known as a "criminal information" that the Justice Department said it filed to stop the 10-year statute of limitations on the offense from expiring earlier this month.
The document filed in Washington federal court charges Comey with transmitting and conspiring to transmit national defense information. It alleges he shared classified information with a reporter from the New York Times in October 2016.
Comey said in a video on Instagram that "they're back again" and referenced the Justice Department, but did not provide further details. "I'm still innocent," he added. Comey's lawyers have already asked a judge to dismiss the case, arguing it is legally improper.
The new case adds to the legal fights facing Comey, whom the Justice Department has already charged twice, accusing him of lying to Congress about media leaks and threatening President Donald Trump in a social media post. A judge dismissed the false statements case, while the threats case remains pending.
Comey's lawyer, Patrick Fitzgerald, said in a statement that the document "purports to charge Mr. Comey with crimes that he did not commit." The criminal information was filed on October 5, but was unsealed on Monday at the request of Comey's lawyers.
A Justice Department spokesperson described the maneuver to halt the statute of limitations as a "widely recognized practice in federal court."
"This is an ongoing criminal investigation, and we will not comment further," the spokesperson said in a statement.

items.title: Popularidad de Trump repunta desde mínimo histórico a un 32% antes de elecciones: Reuters e Ipsos
items.author: Jason Lange
items.creator: Jason Lange
items.summary: El índice de popularidad del presidente Donald Trump subió ligeramente, a un 32%, un punto porcentual más que el mínimo histórico de la semana anterior, en vísperas de las elecciones legislativas del 3 de noviembre, que decidirán qué partido controlará el Congreso de Estados Unidos, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos que concluyó el lunes.
items.body:
El índice de popularidad del presidente Donald Trump subió ligeramente, a un 32%, un punto porcentual más que el mínimo histórico de la semana anterior, en vísperas de las elecciones legislativas del 3 de noviembre, que decidirán qué partido controlará el Congreso de Estados Unidos, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos que concluyó el lunes.
Los compañeros republicanos de Trump luchan por mantener la mayoría en la Cámara de Representantes y en el Senado.
La encuesta, de cinco días y de alcance nacional, también reveló que los votantes registrados se decantaban mayoritariamente por los demócratas frente a los republicanos, con un 47% frente a un 36%, cuando se les preguntaba por qué partido votarían en lo que se conoce como una pregunta de "voto genérico". Alrededor del 11% dijo que no sabía a quién votaría si los comicios fueran hoy.
La diferencia de 11 puntos porcentuales entre demócratas y republicanos era 1 punto porcentual menor que en una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos del 19 de octubre.
La encuesta que concluyó el lunes preguntó además a los votantes indecisos hacia qué partido se inclinaban. Teniendo en cuenta sus respuestas, la contienda nacional parecía algo más reñida, con los demócratas a la cabeza por 9 puntos porcentuales, un 50% frente a un 41%.
Para los republicanos, perder el control de cualquiera de las dos cámaras podría complicar la agenda de Trump en los dos últimos años de su segundo mandato como presidente.
La encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos, realizada por internet, recabó las respuestas de 1.679 adultos estadounidenses, incluidos 1.280 votantes inscritos, y tuvo un margen de error de 2 puntos porcentuales para el conjunto de los adultos y de 3 puntos para los votantes inscritos.

items.body:
Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) held preliminary discussions with private equity firms earlier this year about going private, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The music label's management held preliminary talks with private equity firms including Apollo Global Management (APO.N) , TPG (TPG.O) and Blackstone (BX.N) , according to the report
Talks have not progressed and Universal has not started a sale process, the report said, adding that the company's board is aware of the discussions
Universal, Apollo Global Management, TPG and Blackstone did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment
The report comes [USN:L4N4261LR TEXT:"months after"] Universal's board unanimously rejected an unsolicited takeover proposal from Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Capital Management (PSHP.L)

items.body:

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-米・カナダ、鉄鋼・自動車関税の緩和協議　中間選挙前の合意も＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Promit Mukherjee　David Shepardson

[オタワ／ワシントン　２６日　 ロイター] -
items.body:
Promit Mukherjee　David Shepardson

[オタワ／ワシントン　２６日　 ロイター] - 米国とカナダは、８月に貿易交渉が決裂して悪化した両国関係の修復を図る中、カナダ産の鉄鋼製品と自動車に対する米国の関税措置を緩和することで合意を目指して協議を進めている。米国側２人、カナダ側４人の関係筋が明らかにした。

焦点になっているのは米通商法２３２条に基づく関税で、カナダ産鉄鋼に対する最大５０％の関税や、自動車に対する２５％の関税などの軽減措置が協議されているという。

最新の世論調査によると、トランプ米大統領の支持率はわずか３２％にとどまり、共和党は１１月３日の中間選挙で議会の多数派を失う恐れがある。カナダからの輸入品に対する関税はトランプ氏にとって政治的な重荷となっており、国境沿いの州の共和党候補者からはカナダとの貿易戦争の終結を求める声が上がっている。

交渉内容について説明を受けたカナダ政府関係筋の一人は、鉄鋼・自動車関税を巡る合意が米国の中間選挙前に成立する可能性があると述べた。米国側関係筋によると、トランプ政権はカナダに一段の譲歩を求めている。

関係筋によると、２３２条関税は米商務省が所管しているため、交渉は米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）ではなく、ラトニック商務長官が担っている。カナダのルブラン対米貿易担当相はラトニック氏とこのところ定期的に連絡を取り合っているという。

ルブラン氏の報道官は「カナダは幅広い優先課題について米国と建設的な協議を続けている」とし、「カナダの利益を尊重し、双方にとってより有益な貿易関係の構築に向けて、建設的かつ誠実に取り組む用意がある」と述べた。

ＵＳＴＲ当局者によると、ＵＳＴＲもここ数日、カナダと合意の全体的な枠組みやその他全ての貿易問題について連絡を取り合っている。

ホワイトハウスと米商務省は現時点でコメント要請に応じていない。

カナダのカーニー首相は、米国との協議が「やや活発化した」と述べ、カナダ政府の立場は変わっていないと説明した。

記者団に「何らかの進展があったとすれば、米国がわれわれの立場に近づいているためだ」と語ったが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

カナダの業界関係筋は、合意が早期に成立する可能性があるものの、必ずしも包括的な内容にはならないと指摘。「実現するなら早いだろう。ただ、そもそも合意に至るとしても、対象を絞ったものになるとみている」と述べた。

トランプ氏は２３日、一部のカナダ産農林業製品に対する５０％関税を撤廃する大統領令に署名。中間選挙で厳しい再選戦を戦っているメイン州選出のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（共和党）が同州の企業や農家に影響を及ぼしている関税問題への対応をホワイトハウスに求めたことを受けたもので、ホワイトハウスは合板、一部の紙製品、特定の機械や冷却設備、梱包用の木箱や容器などが関税撤廃の対象になると説明している。

items.title: Trading Day: AI light, Brazil flight
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: Stocks mostly rose on Monday, lifted by renewed optimism around AI as Anthropic filed for a US IPO and as investors awaited more 'Big Tech' earnings later this week. Weaker oil prices also support risk appetite.
items.body:
Stocks mostly [USN:L3N46C0HP TEXT:"rose "]on Monday, lifted by renewed optimism around AI as [USN:L4N469179 TEXT:"Anthropic"] filed for a US IPO and as investors awaited more 'Big Tech' earnings later this week. Weaker oil prices also support risk appetite.
The big exception, however, was [USN:L6N46C02Y TEXT:"Brazil"], where financial assets [USN:L6N46C031 TEXT:"plunged"] following left-wing incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's shock win in Sunday's presidential election.
In [USN:L6N4690ZG TEXT:"my column today"], I look at whether 'stagflation' pressures may be building in the US. A deflating artificial intelligence bubble puts downward pressure on Wall Street and wider economic growth, but the revival of oil and energy prices is putting upward pressure on inflation. It's a tricky one for investors, and the Fed.
Today's Key Reads
[USN:L6N46C031 TEXT:"Brazil stocks, real tumble as Lula win ends bullish run "]
[USN:L4N45L0EZ TEXT:"Anthropic's IPO filing shows explosive growth, risks and staggering costs"]
[USN:L3N46C0RK TEXT:"Meta eyes record $95 billion equity raise to fund AI expansion "]
[USN:L4N4601U6 TEXT:"In China, the AI bubble has already burst "]
[USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"Fed to hit pause on rate hikes, but maybe not for long "]
Today's Key Market Moves
STOCKS: Brazil -14%. Asia mixed, [USN:L6N46C0HN TEXT:"Europe"] and [USN:L6N46C0N2 TEXT:"UK"] up around 0.8%. Wall Street higher: Nasdaq +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.7%, Dow +0.3%.
SECTORS/SHARES: Seven sectors on the S&P 500 rise, four fall. Tech +1.5%, comms services -1.4%. Tesla (TSLA.O) +5%, [USN:L6N46C15D TEXT:"DoorDash"] (DASH.O) -6%.
FX: Brazilian real -8.5%, biggest fall since devaluation in 1999. Philippine peso sinks to record low near 64.00/$. US dollar index edges higher.
BONDS: Brazil buys back bonds, cancels auctions. US 2-year auction is ok — foreign demand dips, domestic demand surges.
COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L3N46B061 TEXT:"Oil"] slips — Brent -0.8%, WTI -1.5%. [USN:L3N46C002 TEXT:"Gold"] +0.5% back above $4,000/oz.

Today's Talking Points:
AI funding blitz
If investors were showing signs of AI fatigue in recent weeks, they're hiding it well as this week gets underway. On Monday, [USN:L6N46C0UF TEXT:"Anthropic"] filed for a US IPO, [USN:L3N46C0RK TEXT:"Meta"] (META.O) announced plans for a $95 billion equity raise, and [USN:L3N46C0WU TEXT:"SpaceX"] (SPCX.O) said it has struck a $40 billion deal with Apollo Global Management for AI chip funding. The Anthropic IPO could value the company at a record-breaking $1.5 trillion or more, and Meta's capital raise would also be a record.
The eye-popping sums needed to fund the AI buildout have begun to suck some of the air out of the AI bubble, but that was shrugged off on Monday, at least temporarily — tech and AI stocks fueled a solid rebound on Wall Street. Competition for investor capital is heating up.
Brazil
Politically, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's surprise election victory on Sunday was truly [USN:L6N46C02Y TEXT:"historic"]: never before had a candidate won the decisive second-round vote after losing the first. It also means a record-setting fourth term for Lula, who turns 81 on Tuesday. Unsurprisingly, given the historic significance of Lula's comeback, there was a reaction across Brazilian markets.
Few doubt the scale of Brazil's fiscal and economic [USN:L1N468127 TEXT:"challenges"], but Monday's collapse in Brazilian assets is likely to reverse, to some degree. Part of the selloff was because investors were caught so flat-footed. As late as Sunday, prediction markets were pointing to an 80% chance of a win for Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. But Lula's scope to push through an agenda that investors fear will be [USN:L6N46B06R TEXT:"limited"], due to Bolsonaro's backing in Congress.
Central bank bonanza
This week is one of the busiest in years for policymaking in the world's developed economies, with half of the G10 central banks set to decide interest rates. Monetary authorities in New Zealand and Canada are widely expected to hike by 25 basis points, while those in the US, euro zone and Japan are expected to keep them on hold but signal possible increases in December.
The common enemy is inflation, which is already too sticky in many countries. Oil and global energy prices remain elevated as war continues to choke Middle East supply routes, and the worry for policymakers is this bleeds into core inflation and becomes embedded in inflation expectations. But if the AI bubble deflates, growth, consumer confidence and investor sentiment could deflate too, putting policymakers in an even tighter bind.
What could move markets tomorrow?
Japan services producer price inflation (September)
South Korea GDP (Q3, advance)
US Treasury sells $70 billion of 5-year notes at auction
US durable goods (September)
Corporate earnings, including Visa (V.N) , Coca-Cola (KO.N) , Boeing (BA.N) , Seagate Technology (STX.O) , HSBC (HSBA.L) , Novartis (NOVN.S)

items.title: Trump approval rises from record low to 32% ahead of midterm election, Reuters Ipsos poll finds
items.author: Jason Lange
items.creator: Jason Lange
items.summary: The president's public approval rating was 32%, up one percentage point from last week's record low, ahead of midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump 's public approval rating inched higher to 32%, up a percentage point from last week's record low, ahead of the November 3 midterm elections that will decide which party controls Congress, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday.
Trump's fellow Republicans are fighting to retain the party's majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate.
The five-day nationwide poll also showed that registered voters broadly favored Democrats over Republicans by 47% to 36% when asked which party they would pick for Congress in what is known as a "generic ballot" question. Some 11% said they did not know who they would vote for if the election were held today.
That gap of 11 percentage points between Democrats and Republicans was 1 percentage point tighter than in a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on October 19. The latest poll additionally asked undecided voters which party they were leaning toward. Factoring in their responses, the national race appeared somewhat tighter, with Democrats leading by 9 percentage points, 50% to 41%.
For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his second term as president.
Generic ballot polls are national polls that provide an overall view of which party poll respondents would like to see in charge in Congress. While these polls provide a view of national public sentiment, they do not capture the nuances of the state-by-state and district-by-district contests that determine control of the Senate and House, contests in which Republicans hold some structural advantages.
STEEP SENATE CLIMB FOR DEMOCRATS Political analysts generally see the Democrats having a good chance of winning control of the House, but think they face a steeper climb to win the Senate.
It remains to be seen how many voters will actually cast ballots. The voters who appeared most likely to vote still favored Democrats over Republicans by 9 points, 53% to 44%.
The fight for Congress has appeared to turn on views around inflation, which has surged since Trump ordered military strikes on Iran in February that sent gasoline prices higher. Some 73% of voters in the poll said their cost of living was heading in the wrong direction.
Prior to the start of the war, Reuters/Ipsos polls showed voters preferring Republicans over Democrats as the better stewards of the US economy. The latest poll showed 37% of voters said Democrats have a better approach on the economy, compared to 33% who picked Republicans on the issue.
The poll also suggested Democratic voters were more excited about voting, with 46% of Democrats saying they were very enthusiastic about the midterms, compared to 30% of Republicans who said the same.
The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online, gathered responses from 1,679 US adults, including 1,280 registered voters, and had a margin of error of 2 percentage points for all adults and 3 points for registered voters.

items.title: Apple afirma que sustituirá los iPhone Duo que presenten problemas en la pantalla
items.author: Stephen Nellis, Aditya Soni
items.creator: Stephen Nellis, Aditya Soni
items.summary: Pocos días después de lanzar su primer iPhone plegable, Apple reconoció el lunes que algunos de los dispositivos presentan problemas en la pantalla y afirmó que los sustituirá.
items.body:
Pocos días después de lanzar su primer iPhone plegable, Apple (AAPL.O) reconoció el lunes que algunos de los dispositivos presentan problemas en la pantalla y afirmó que los sustituirá.
Apple comenzó a distribuir el iPhone Duo la semana pasada, y los clientes de todo el mundo hicieron fila para conseguir uno de los escasos ejemplares disponibles, ya que los pedidos iniciales por internet se agotaron en cuestión de minutos.
Los analistas han señalado que es probable que Apple se enfrente a problemas de suministro, ya que el iPhone Duo es complejo de fabricar.
Durante el fin de semana aparecieron publicaciones en redes sociales en las que se veía el iPhone Duo con grietas y líneas en la pantalla interior, a lo largo de la bisagra central por donde se pliega el dispositivo.
Apple reconoció los problemas el lunes, señalando que las unidades afectadas suelen presentar el problema rápidamente.
"Somos conscientes de un problema que afecta a la pantalla interior de un pequeño número de unidades del iPhone Duo", declaró Apple en un comunicado. "Si los usuarios experimentan problemas con la pantalla de su iPhone Duo, deben ponerse en contacto con AppleCare para solicitar una sustitución".
Apple no hizo comentarios sobre cuál podría ser la causa del problema.

items.title: Rahimi on target as Al-Ain stay perfect in Asian Champions League
items.author: Michael Church
items.creator: Michael Church
items.summary: Al-Ain continued their perfect start to the western league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite on Monday with a 2-1 win over Tractor FC from Iran as title holders Al-Ahli secured a late 2-1 victory over 10-man Al-Gharafa.
items.body:
Al-Ain continued their perfect start to the western league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite on Monday with a 2-1 win over Tractor FC from Iran as title holders Al-Ahli secured a late 2-1 victory over 10-man Al-Gharafa.
Al-Ain, winners of the trophy in 2024, picked up their third win in a row as Houssine Rahimi scored his fifth goal in three matches with 20 minutes remaining at the Hazza bin Zayed Stadium.
"This competition is important and we need to collect points early on," said the Moroccan forward. "That is what we managed to do in these three matches we have played, earning nine points. This is very important for us."
Ramy Rabia's strike from distance in the 21st minute had put Al-Ain in front but Tibor Halilovic curled home Tractor's equaliser 10 minutes into the second half before Rahimi hit the winner.
Al-Ahli made a positive start in Jeddah against their Qatari visitors when Ivan Toney gave the defending champions a fourth-minute lead only to see Florinel Coman level eight minutes into the second half.
Seydou Sano's sending-off for a second bookable offence with 13 minutes remaining left Al-Gharafa short-handed and Al-Ahli took advantage with Matheus Goncalves hitting the winner four minutes from time.
"We know that our primary focus isn't just being at the top of the table," said Goncalves.
"We have to qualify, and qualify well, so that afterwards we can take advantage of our home matches and get the job done at home."
Julian Quinones scored in the 84th minute with a heavily deflected effort to earn Al-Qadsiah a 1-1 draw with Qatar's Al-Sadd, who took the lead through Akram Afif's stunning strike from distance 10 minutes earlier.
Iraq's Air Force Club picked up their first win of the campaign when Saad Abdul Ameer pounced in the 70th minute to seal a 1-0 victory in Basra over Pakhtakor from Uzbekistan.
The match involving Saudi Pro League champions Al-Nassr and Al-Wasl from the United Arab Emirates was postponed.
The first eight finishers in the league phase in west and east Asia will advance to the knockout rounds, with the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final to be played on a centralised basis in Saudi Arabia in April and May.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ対ドルで下落、主要中銀会合控え　ブラジルレアル急落
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２６日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、中央銀行の金融決定会合を控え、原油価格が高止まりする中、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。２５日に行われたブラジル大統領選の決選投票で現職のルラ大統領が再選を果たしたことを受け、ブラジルレアルは急落した。 

ユーロは先週、フランス国債の売りにより同国の債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に押し上げられたことで、下押し圧力を受けていた。ただ、この日のフランス国債価格は上昇。格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いたことで、社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ。

ただ、ソシエテ・ジェネラルの外為戦略責任者、キット・ジュークス氏は「ユーロを巡る根本的な問題は変わっておらず、スプレッドは縮小している」と指摘。「成長見通しが良好ではなく、エネルギー価格も高止まりしているため、ユーロは現時点でなお脆弱だ」と語った。  

この日の北海ブレント先物は軟化したものの、依然として約６カ月ぶりの高値付近にとどまった。

市場の注目は、今週予定される主要中銀の金融政策発表に集まる。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀はいずれも金利を据え置くと見込まれている。ニュージーランド（ＮＺ）とカナダの中銀は利上げすると予想されている。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３１％高の１０２となった。前出のジュークス氏は「ドルは予想ほど堅調ではなく、いくらか逆風もあるが、米経済指標はかなり底堅い」と述べた。 

円は対ドルで０．４３％安の１ドル＝１５７．４６円。

ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１７９ドル。対円では０．３１％高の１７６．０４円となった。

ブラジルレアルは対ドルで８．５％安の１ドル＝５．４レアル。ブラジル大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り、史上初となる通算４期目の大統領職を担うことになった。ボルソナロ氏は第１回投票では首位に立ったが、決選投票では４００万票超の差で敗れた。最高裁が２５日に投票時間を２時間延長する判断を下したことを理由に、選挙結果の無効を求める意向を示した。

ゴールドマン・サックスのテレサ・アルベス氏率いるアナリストチームは投資家向けリポートで、「選挙結果を巡る争いが長引くリスクは市場心理に悪影響を及ぼすが、より根本的には、過去数週間で大幅な財政緩和が実施されたことを踏まえると、レアルなどの現地資産には一段と大きな財政プレミアムが反映されるべきだと考える」と指摘した。

items.title: Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo units showing screen problems
items.author: Stephen Nellis, Aditya Soni
items.creator: Stephen Nellis, Aditya Soni
items.summary: Days after launching its first folding iPhone, Apple acknowledged on Monday that some of the devices exhibit display problems and said it will replace them.
items.body:
Days after launching its first folding iPhone, Apple (AAPL.O) acknowledged on Monday that some of the devices exhibit display problems and said it will replace them.
Apple started shipping the iPhone Duo last week, with customers around the world [USN:L1N468153 TEXT:"lining up for tight inventory"] after initial online orders sold out in minutes. Analysts have said Apple is likely to face supply constraints because the iPhone Duo, which unfolds like a passport booklet, is complex to manufacture.
Over the weekend, social media posts showed the iPhone Duo with cracks and lines in the inner display along the central hinge where the iPhone Duo folds.
Apple acknowledged the problems on Monday, saying affected units tend to show the problem quickly.
"We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units," Apple said in a statement. "If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement."
Apple did not comment on what might cause the issue.
iFixit, a firm that publishes teardown reports of electronic devices along with guides on how to repair them, said it used teardown footage, patents and CT scans to construct a 3D simulation of the iPhone Duo hinge that it compared with the reported damage locations.
iFixit said its simulations found the reported damage clustered just below where a display cable runs under the screen near a central support bar. That bar might be failing to drop out of the screen's way as the phone is folded, "creating a small stress hotspot near the reported break location," the company said .
Apple did not immediately comment on iFixit's findings, which also concluded that the iPhone Duo is the most repairable foldable phone that it has tested.
Francisco Jeronimo, a vice president at market research firm IDC, said Apple's quick replacement offer was the "right first step" in responding to the problems.
"We all remember when Samsung experienced problems with the original Galaxy Fold in 2019, but it also showed that a fast and transparent response can contain the damage to a category," Jeronimo said.

Apple says it will replace iPhone Duo units showing screen problems

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 26 : Days after launching its first folding iPhone, Apple acknowledged on Monday that some of the devices exhibit display problems and said it will replace them.
Apple started shipping the iPhone Duo last week, with customers around the world lining up for tight inventory after initial online orders sold out in minutes. Analysts have said Apple is likely to face supply constraints because the iPhone Duo, which unfolds like a passport booklet, is complex to manufacture.
Over the weekend, social media posts showed the iPhone Duo with cracks and lines in the inner display along the central hinge where the iPhone Duo folds. 
Apple acknowledged the problems on Monday, saying affected units tend to show the problem quickly.

"We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units," Apple said in a statement. "If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement."
Apple did not comment on what might cause the issue. 
iFixit, a firm that publishes teardown reports of electronic devices along with guides on how to repair them, said it used teardown footage, patents and CT scans to construct a 3D simulation of the iPhone Duo hinge that it compared with the reported damage locations.
iFixit said its simulations found the reported damage clustered just below where a display cable runs under the screen near a central support bar. That bar might be failing to drop out of the screen's way as the phone is folded, "creating a small stress hotspot near the reported break location," the company said.
Apple did not immediately comment on iFixit's findings, which also concluded that the iPhone Duo is the most repairable foldable phone that it has tested.  
Francisco Jeronimo, a vice president at market research firm IDC, said Apple's quick replacement offer was the "right first step" in responding to the problems.
"We all remember when Samsung experienced problems with the original Galaxy Fold in 2019, but it also showed that a fast and transparent response can contain the damage to a category," Jeronimo said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Meghan Roach steps down as Roots CEO after go-private deal closes
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Roots Corp. says Meghan Roach has stepped down as president and chief executive as its go-private transaction with Marquee Brands has closed.
items.body: TORONTO — Roots Corp. says Meghan Roach has stepped down as president and chief executive as its go-private transaction with Marquee Brands has closed. Roach has been in the CEO role since 2020 after first joining the company as interim chief financial officer in 2019.  The company says in a news release she will continue to serve in an advisory role to ensure a smooth leadership transition. The go-private transaction was announced in August at a price of $4.10 per share and passed a shareholder vote earlier this month with more than 99 per cent support. The company says Roots shares are now expected to be delisted “shortly” from the Toronto Stock Exchange.    Marquee Brands also manages the Martha Stewart, Laura Ashley and Roberto Cavalli labels and intends to expand Roots to other markets like Korea, India and Mexico. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 26, 2026.

items.title: Flavio Bolsonaro says Brazil federal police asked for his passports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Monday that the country's federal police had requested that he turn in his passports following a visit to his imprisoned father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.
items.body:
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Monday that the country's federal police had requested that he turn in his passports following a visit to his imprisoned father, former President Jair Bolsonaro.
The senator, who was defeated on Sunday by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a runoff vote, said he intended to comply with the request, denying he planned to flee the country after the election.
The younger Bolsonaro claimed, without providing evidence, that the police request was based on a ruling from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Brazil's top court and federal police did not immediately reply to comment requests.
"I was ordered right on the street to hand over my passports, and I'm also prohibited from leaving the country," Bolsonaro said in a social media video.
He added Moraes' ruling was based on remarks from his younger brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, who said on a podcast last week that Flavio should leave the country if he lost the runoff election to Lula.
Lula won a historic fourth term in Sunday's election in a surprise result that defied polls. Bolsonaro refused to accept defeat and said he would ask for the result to be annulled.

items.title: GRANOS La soja en Chicago cae a mínimo de dos meses por la depreciación del real brasileño
items.author: P.J. Huffstutter
items.creator: P.J. Huffstutter
items.summary: Los futuros de la soja en la Bolsa de Comercio de Chicago cayeron más de un 2% el lunes, afectados por la presión cambiaria y la entrada al mercado de la oferta procedente de una cosecha récord en Estados Unidos, según analistas.
items.body:
Los futuros de la soja en la Bolsa de Comercio de Chicago cayeron más de un 2% el lunes, afectados por la presión cambiaria y la entrada al mercado de la oferta procedente de una cosecha récord en Estados Unidos, según analistas.
El real brasileño se debilitó alrededor de un 12% frente al dólar estadounidense en las operaciones al contado durante el comienzo de la jornada bursátil del lunes, tras la reelección del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, que borró el optimismo de inversores que se habían entusiasmado con el triunfo de su rival de derecha en la primera ronda de votación.
Los operadores señalaron que el resultado fue particularmente bajista para los futuros de la soja estadounidense, como han demostrado esfuerzos previos de Lula por impulsar las compras chinas de la oleaginosa brasileña.
La debilidad del real también afectó las expectativas para la demanda de exportaciones de soja estadounidense, ya que una moneda local más barata puede abaratar las exportaciones brasileñas para los compradores internacionales, otorgándoles una ventaja competitiva sobre la oferta estadounidense.
"Sin duda, las elecciones fueron una sorpresa, y eso está relacionado con la presión a la baja sobre la moneda y, como consecuencia, sobre los precios de la soja", dijo Jack Scoville, vicepresidente y analista de mercado de The Price Futures Group en Chicago.
"La magnitud del movimiento en el precio de la soja se debe a eso, y también ha tenido cierta repercusión en el maíz", agregó.
Todo esto llega en un momento crucial para los exportadores estadounidenses, ya que los agricultores están en plena cosecha de lo que se prevé será una abundante producción de maíz y de soja.
Al comienzo de la sesión de negociación, el contrato de soja más activo de la CBOT en base continua cayó a 12,2750 dólares por bushel, el precio más bajo desde el 25 de agosto. La soja cerró con una baja de 15,25 centavos, a 12,4125 dólares por bushel.
Los futuros del trigo bajaron tras las nuevas propuestas para reabrir el transporte marítimo de grano en el mar Negro.
La agencia de noticias Interfax informó el lunes que Rusia estaba revisando varias propuestas para garantizar el transporte seguro de grano a través del mar Negro y que estaba en contacto con Turquía sobre el asunto, citando al viceministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso, Alexander Alimov.
El maíz en Chicago cerró con una baja de 1 centavo, a 4,55 dólares por bushel, tras haber alcanzado previamente el precio más bajo desde el 10 de julio. El trigo cerró con una baja de 9 centavos, a 6,16 dólares por bushel, después de haber caído previamente a 6,125 dólares por bushel, el precio más bajo del contrato desde el 9 de julio.

items.body:
El Tesoro brasileño recompró unos 7.700 millones de reales en bonos indexados a la inflación, lo que elevó el importe de su intervención del lunes a unos 14.800 millones de reales (2.980 millones de dólares), en una jornada de desplome de los mercados brasileños tras la sorprendente reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
El Ministerio de Hacienda recompró 271.000 de los denominados bonos NTN-B con vencimiento en 2030, 1 millón con vencimiento en 2035 y unos 487.000 con vencimiento en 2050, según un comunicado.
El Tesoro además canceló las subastas convencionales de bonos del Estado indexados a la inflación y de tipo fijo previstas para el martes y el jueves.

items.title: Wall St banks, Blackstone line up $63 billion to finance Broadcom AI chips for Anthropic
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bank of America , Blackstone , Citi and Morgan Stanley will provide $63 billion in financing to buy Broadcom's AI chips and networking gear for Anthropic, in one of the largest debt deals tied to the AI buildout.
items.body:
Bank of America (BAC.N) , Blackstone (BX.N) , Citi (C.N) and Morgan Stanley (MS.N) will provide $63 billion in financing to buy Broadcom's AI chips and networking gear for Anthropic, in one of the largest debt deals tied to the AI buildout.
Rising AI demand is driving massive investment in computing infrastructure as technology companies race to secure capacity for increasingly complex workloads.
The transaction will be carried out through a newly formed special purpose vehicle that will purchase Broadcom's (AVGO.O) AI accelerators and networking equipment and lease them to the Claude maker, the companies said on Monday.
Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien financing, while Blackstone will provide the committed portion of the second-lien financing.
Broadcom is providing "residual value support" to senior debt lenders, effectively providing a guarantee to them in the financing structure, agreeing to absorb potential declines in the value of the assets up to an amount equal to the first-lien debt, although the release did not disclose the size of this debt.
Deliveries are expected to begin in 2027 as part of a previously announced strategic compute capacity agreement involving Broadcom, the companies said.
Apollo and Blackstone had agreed to finance a $35 billion expansion of Anthropic's AI computing capacity under a [USN:L6N42H0VT TEXT:"prior agreement"] with Broadcom.
The latest deal highlights the growing role of banks and alternative asset managers in financing the infrastructure needed to support rising demand for AI computing capacity.
[USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"Anthropic"] filed for a potentially record-breaking IPO on Monday, even as disclosures of steep losses and security concerns threatened to test investor appetite for the AI heavyweight.

The size of the first lien loans or senior debt is about $43.5 billion, according to two sources familiar with the matter, or 69 per cent of total financing.
Blackstone will provide the committed portion of the second-lien financing - which ranks below senior debt - while Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien financing, the statement said.

The release did not disclose the breakdown of the loans, while Broadcom did not respond to a request for comment.
Rising AI demand is driving massive investment in computing infrastructure as technology companies race to secure capacity for increasingly complex workloads.
The transaction will be carried out through a newly formed special purpose vehicle that will purchase Broadcom's AI accelerators and networking equipment and lease them to the Claude maker, the companies said on Monday.
Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien financing. 
Deliveries are expected to begin in 2027 as part of a previously announced strategic compute capacity agreement involving Broadcom, the companies said.
Apollo and Blackstone had agreed to finance a $35 billion expansion of Anthropic's AI computing capacity under a prior agreement with Broadcom. Broadcom's backstop in that deal was up to $29 billion, it said in a filing.
While Moody's described Broadcom as one of the strongest large technology companies, it warned that the risk would increase if multiple transactions were undertaken over a short period to meet the sizable funding needs of frontier AI labs.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter sido intimado pela PF a entregar passaportes
items.author: Ricardo Brito
items.creator: Ricardo Brito
items.summary: Candidato derrotado no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) afirmou em vídeo público nesta segunda-feira que foi intimado pela Polícia Federal a entregar seu passaporte no âmbito de uma investigação contra ele que tramita no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF).
items.body:
Candidato derrotado no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) afirmou em vídeo público nesta segunda-feira que foi intimado pela Polícia Federal a entregar seu passaporte no âmbito de uma investigação contra ele que tramita no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF).
"Vou entregar os meus passaportes e me defender dessa aberração, que é uma clara tentativa de me intimidar. Mas ninguém vai me calar", afirmou o senador no vídeo postado em suas redes sociais e também distribuído por sua assessoria.
Segundo Flávio Bolsonaro, a ordem de apreensão do passaporte foi determinada pelo ministro do STF Alexandre de Moraes, e foi assinada logo após o resultado da eleição presidencial de domingo, em que foi derrotado pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Ele afirmou que a ordem teria como fundamento comentário feito em 23 de outubro pelo irmão dele Eduardo Bolsonaro, que está nos EUA, afirmando que Flávio deveria deixar o país em caso de derrota.
O senador disse que foi abordado pela PF na saída de uma visita feita mais cedo ao seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que cumpre prisão domiciliar em Brasília após ter sido condenado por tentativa de golpe de Estado.
Procurada, a Polícia Federal e o Supremo não responderam de imediato a pedido de comentário.
Uma fonte da PF disse que o senador foi intimado na manhã desta segunda a entregar os passaportes comum e diplomático em 24 horas, e que a decisão do ministro Alexandre de Moraes também prevê a proibição de deixar o Brasil e também de se comunicar com o advogado Willer Tomaz.
Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado em três inquéritos no Supremo. O primeiro deles, sob relatoria de Moraes, apura suspeitas de lavagem de dinheiro e supostas irregularidades em relação a "bets" e envolvem Tomaz, que também é amigo do parlamentar.
Outro inquérito, também relatado por Moraes, apura suposta calúnia de Flávio contra Lula em postagem na qual ele associou o presidente a crimes como tráfico de drogas, apoio a terroristas, fraude eleitoral e lavagem de dinheiro.
O senador ainda é investigado em um terceiro inquérito, relatado pelo ministro André Mendonça, que diz respeito ao financiamento do filme sobre o pai de Flávio pelo banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, com suspeitas de desvio de recursos.

items.title: Magic PG Jalen Suggs (bruised knee) out at least 2 weeks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Orlando Magic point guard Jalen Suggs will sit out at least two weeks after sustaining a mild bone bruise in his right knee during Orlando's victory over the New York Knicks on Sunday.
items.body:
Orlando Magic point guard Jalen Suggs will sit out at least two weeks after sustaining a mild bone bruise in his right knee during Orlando's victory over the New York Knicks on Sunday.
There was no structural damage to the knee, according to the team. Suggs will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Suggs was injured in a noncontact play in which he went up for a layup and his right knee appeared to buckle. He fell to the floor and was eventually helped off with 2:09 remaining in Orlando's 111-102 road win.
Suggs, 25, is averaging 8.0 points, 5.7 assists, 5.0 rebounds and 2.0 steals in three games this season. He is shooting just 35.7% from the field and has made 1 of 9 3-point attempts.
Suggs has been injury-prone since being the No. 5 selection in the 2021 NBA Draft out of Gonzaga.
His 57 appearances (56 starts) last season were the second-most of his career behind 75 starts in 2023-24. He averaged 13.8 points, 5.5 assists, 3.9 rebounds and 1.8 steals last season.
For his career, Suggs is averaging 12.6 points, 3.8 assists, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 steals. He has made 460 3-pointers but is hitting them at just a 33% clip.
The Magic are also without forward Paolo Banchero (ankle), who will reportedly be sidelined at least one month. He was injured during the third quarter of the Magic's 115-93 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Reeleição de Lula aumenta incertezas fiscais e pode dificultar estabilização da dívida pública, diz Fitch
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A agência de classificação de risco Fitch Ratings avaliou nesta segunda-feira que a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva eleva as incertezas fiscais no país, o que pode dificultar uma estabilização duradoura da dívida pública em relação ao Produto Interno Bruto (PIB).
items.body:
A agência de classificação de risco Fitch Ratings avaliou nesta segunda-feira que a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva eleva as incertezas fiscais no país, o que pode dificultar uma estabilização duradoura da dívida pública em relação ao Produto Interno Bruto (PIB).
Em nota, a Fitch afirmou que não está claro se Lula manterá, em seu quarto mandato, a agenda de maiores gastos sociais, financiados por receitas maiores, ponderando que o perfil crescentemente independente e de centro-direita do Congresso Nacional pode ser um obstáculo ao avanço de medidas nessa linha.
“A Fitch acompanhará a composição da equipe econômica e as primeiras sinalizações do presidente Lula e de sua equipe sobre ajustes fiscais.”
A agência destacou que, na reta final da campanha eleitoral, Lula adotou uma série de medidas para ampliar gastos sociais que podem entrar em conflito com sua promessa de cumprir o arcabouço fiscal vigente.
"Com a vitória de Lula e a pouca clareza sobre seus planos de ajuste, o cenário-base da Fitch prevê apenas uma consolidação fiscal gradual, o que seria insuficiente para estabilizar a relação dívida/PIB, a menos que uma reação adversa do mercado force um ajuste mais acentuado", disse a agência.

items.title: JetBlue seeks to reassure investors as losses deepen
items.author: Doyinsola Oladipo, Nandan Mandayam
items.creator: Doyinsola Oladipo, Nandan Mandayam
items.summary: JetBlue Airways sought to reassure investors about its financial health on Monday despite posting a bigger-than-expected quarterly loss, as a sharp selloff in its bonds and mounting restructuring concerns cast a shadow over the airline's turnaround.
items.body:
JetBlue Airways (JBLU.O) sought to reassure investors about its financial health on Monday despite posting a bigger-than-expected quarterly loss, as a sharp selloff in its bonds and mounting restructuring concerns cast a shadow over the airline's turnaround.
JetBlue's shares jumped 11% in volatile trading after the bell, recovering some losses after they closed down nearly 10% following a report that the airline's creditors were working with restructuring advisers amid a bond selloff.
Even as management insists its liquidity is sufficient to satisfy the company's needs for at least the next 12 months, shares have fallen 48% year to date, while short interest in the stock is now at 26%.
JetBlue's TrueBlue senior secured note, a bond backed by the airline's loyalty program, came under heavy selling pressure this month, with the price halving to about $47 and yields surging to distressed levels above 30%.
The carrier raised its full-year forecast for seat revenue growth to 13.5% to 14.5%, from its earlier range of 10% to 12.5%. It attributed the improved outlook to higher fares and its expansion in Fort Lauderdale, but acknowledged ongoing challenges from surging fuel costs and operating losses.
JetBlue said it was able to recover 87% of its fuel costs in the third quarter as fares rose across the industry with no meaningful decline in passenger volume.
US airlines have relied on fare hikes, ancillary fees and capacity controls to boost revenue, as they grapple with volatile fuel prices that make it harder to forecast costs and earnings.
JetBlue said it paid about $3.91 per gallon of fuel in the July-September quarter, up 57% from a year ago, and slightly below the $3.96-a-gallon rate it had forecast last month. Unit revenue, a measure of pricing power, rose just 18.4%, lagging the spike in fuel costs.
The airline posted an adjusted loss of 60 cents per share for the three months to September 30, compared with a 40-cent loss in the year-ago period. Analysts expected a loss of 55 cents per share, according to data compiled by LSEG.
CASH WOES JetBlue ended the third quarter with $2.2 billion in liquidity, including a $600 million undrawn credit facility, and about $7 billion in unencumbered assets — $2.8 billion of which are aircraft and engines, following updated appraisals.
However, cash and cash equivalents fell to $1.26 billion from $1.66 billion at mid-year, and total cash and investments have dropped by about $850 million, or a third, since December.
Total debt declined to $8.39 billion from $8.5 billion in the prior quarter, but the company continues to burn cash at an accelerating pace.
JetBlue used $273 million more cash than it generated from operations in the first nine months of 2026 — nearly twice the $143 million cash burn in the same period last year. This shrinking cushion leaves the airline with less room to maneuver as it faces ongoing losses and upcoming debt maturities, increasing pressure to raise additional funds if the trend continues.
Still, the airline reiterated its target of at least $1 in earnings per share and positive free cash flow in 2028.
It expects operating margin to further improve in the fourth quarter, even with the price of fuel being 85% higher year over year.

items.title: トランプ氏、ブラジル選挙「不正」と主張　ボルソナロ氏の党は結果承認
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Oliver Griffin

[２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Oliver Griffin

[２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、現職のルラ大統領が勝利したブラジルの大統領選決選投票について、不正が行われたように見えると述べた。敗北したフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員の主張を支持する発言となった。具体的な証拠は示していない。ただ、ボルソナロ氏が所属する政党は、選挙結果を認めた。

ブラジルの選挙裁判所は２５日に行われた大統領選の決選投票で、左派のルラ氏が右派のボルソナロ氏を破り、再選を果たしたと発表。ボルソナロ氏は最高裁が２５日に投票時間を２時間延長する判断を下したことを理由に選挙結果の無効を求める意向を示しており、敗北を認めていない。

しかし、ボルソナロ氏が所属する自由党は２６日遅く、バルデマル・コスタネト党首が署名した声明で、決選投票の結果を認めると表明した。

コスタネト氏は「大統領選の結果を認める」とした上で、「提起された問題については適切に解明する必要があると考えている」と述べた。 

ボルソナロ氏は党の声明発表後、公に発言していない。

トランプ氏は投票前にボルソナロ氏への支持を表明していなかった。ただ、ロイターは米国務省当局者らがボルソナロ家の権力復帰に向けた取り組みを主導していたと報じている。 

トランプ氏は記者団に対し「私はどちらの側にも立っていないが、またしても不正選挙だったように見える」とし、「選挙は結果に疑義が生じてはならない。私には非常にひどい状況に見える」と語った。

ボルソナロ氏はルラ氏に４００万票余りの差で敗れており、この明白な結果を覆すのは困難とみられる。インスペルのペドロ・ブルゴス教授が選挙記録を分析したところ、最高裁が命じた２時間の延長時間中に投じられた票は３万５０００票未満で、全体の約０．０３％だった。

トランプ氏は「選挙も、その集計方法も、非常に問題があるように見えた。投票時間の延長は非常に奇妙だった」と述べた。

ブラジルのアルキミン副大統領はテレビインタビューで同国の選挙制度を擁護。トランプ氏の発言は「完全に間違い」で「根拠がない」と述べた。

フラビオ・ボルソナロ氏の父親、ジャイル・ボルソナロ前ブラジル大統領はトランプ氏と緊密な関係にあった。トランプ政権は中南米各国で相次ぐ右派勢力の選挙勝利を歓迎している。

items.title: US consumers paying the most for fuel price spikes from Iran war, study says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US consumers are paying more than anyone in the world for the jump in fuel prices caused by supply disruptions resulting from the US war on Iran, including the virtual shutting and then blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, a study said on Monday.
items.body:
US consumers are paying more than anyone in the world for the jump in fuel prices caused by supply disruptions resulting from the US war on Iran, including the virtual shutting and then blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, a study said on Monday.
US consumers have paid an average of $471 more for higher fuel prices since the Iran war started on February 28, said the study by Finland-based nonprofit group Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air, which supports efforts to move off fossil fuels. That compares to an average of about $60 more for people around the world.
US consumers are paying more due to reliance on less efficient private vehicles, longer distance travel and a relatively slow transition to electric vehicles, CREA said.
To calculate the costs, the study compared fuel prices in January and February this year to what they were during the rest of the year.
Consumers in Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Belgium have also paid a lot more, according to the study which looked at fuel prices and consumption in 169 countries from the beginning of March to mid-October.
The world has paid an additional $468 billion for fuel during that time, with the US paying $160 billion, China $54 billion and Canada $17 billion.
The administration of US President Donald Trump says higher fuel prices are a small cost for consumers to pay to stop Iran from getting nuclear weapons and that oil and fuel prices will fall when the war ends. The war has lasted longer than the administration predicted.

items.title: Notícia sobre viagem de Flávio aos EUA é anterior às eleições
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Uma notícia da emissora TVT sobre uma viagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aos Estados Unidos é de maio, mas posts têm compartilhado o conteúdo fora de contexto para insinuar que ele deixou o país após perder a eleição deste domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
items.body:
Uma notícia da emissora TVT sobre uma viagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aos Estados Unidos é de maio, mas posts têm compartilhado o conteúdo fora de contexto para insinuar que ele deixou o país após perder a eleição deste domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
"Após a intensa disputa eleitoral deste domingo, uma pergunta chama a atenção: Flávio Bolsonaro já embarcou para os Estados Unidos e não concedeu entrevistas?", diz a legenda de uma postagem no Instagram , que reproduz o vídeo sem informar que é antigo.
A TVT exibiu a notícia exibida nos posts em 25 de maio deste ano, na véspera de um encontro de Flávio com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, na Casa Branca.
No fim da tarde desta segunda-feira, o senador publicou um vídeo dizendo que pela manhã foi visitar seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que está em prisão domiciliar em Brasília e foi intimado por agentes da Polícia Federal a entregar seu passaporte.
"Eu nunca pensei em sair do país. Eu vou entregar os meus passaportes", disse Flávio.
Em setembro , a Reuters já havia desmentido posts que usavam o mesmo vídeo da TVT para alegar que o senador havia ido para os EUA após o levantamento de sigilos de investigações sobre o Banco Master.
VEREDICTO Enganoso. A notícia da TVT antecede o segundo turno das eleições. Por enquanto, não há registros de que Flávio tenha viajado aos EUA após o pleito.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro dice que la Policía Federal de Brasil le pidió su pasaporte
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro dijo el lunes que la policía federal le había solicitado que entregara su pasaporte tras visitar a su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, que se encuentra en prisión.
items.body:
El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro dijo el lunes que la policía federal le había solicitado que entregara su pasaporte tras visitar a su padre, el expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, que se encuentra en prisión.
El senador, que fue derrotado el domingo por el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en la segunda vuelta, dijo que tenía intención de cumplir con la petición y negó que haya previsto huir del país tras las elecciones.
Flávio Bolsonaro dijo, sin aportar pruebas, que la solicitud de la policía se basaba en un fallo del magistrado del Tribunal Supremo Alexandre de Moraes. El máximo tribunal de Brasil y la policía federal no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
"Me ordenaron allí mismo, en la calle, que entregara mis pasaportes, y además tengo prohibido salir del país", dijo Bolsonaro en un vídeo publicado en las redes sociales.
El senador añadió que el fallo de Moraes se basaba en unas declaraciones de su hermano menor, Eduardo Bolsonaro, quien comentó en un podcast la semana pasada que Flávio debería abandonar el país si perdía la segunda vuelta electoral frente a Lula.
Lula logró un histórico cuarto mandato en las elecciones del domingo, con un resultado sorprendente que desafió las encuestas. Bolsonaro se negó a aceptar la derrota y dijo que solicitaría la anulación del resultado.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv kills one, injures 10, hits educational institution, metro station
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Russian missile attack on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Monday killed at least one person and injured 10, including students at a dormitory, officials said.
items.body:
A Russian missile attack on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Monday killed at least one person and injured 10, including students at a dormitory, officials said.
The late-evening attack hit an educational institution, residences, an underground station and medical facilities.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, writing on Telegram, said one person had been killed near a supermarket. Ukraine's state rescue services said a body was found by a heavily damaged apartment building.
Klitschko put the number of injured at 10, many of them outside a student dormitory at the State Trade and Economics University on the east side of the Dnipro River. Nine people were being treated in hospital, with three in serious condition.
President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, also writing on Telegram, gave no precise figures for dead and injured.
"For the moment, the number of people is not exactly known," Zelenskiy said. "But, unfortunately, there are casualties. There are injured. Rescue operations are continuing."
He repeated his call to eliminate delays in securing air defence arms quickly to counter Russian air attacks.
"It is precisely in such conditions, when the threat is constant, when strikes can happen at any moment and on cities and villages, that artificial delays in air defence for Ukraine are helping terror," he said.
Earlier in the day, Zelenskiy said Ukraine [USN:L5N46C0Z6 TEXT:"had been waiting"] for US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth to sign off on critical missile supplies.
"In particular, we have been waiting for nearly a month for Mr Hegseth to sign off on missiles for Patriots and NASAMS. I instructed our team to raise this with the American side once again," the president said on X.
Unofficial Telegram channels posted pictures of damage to an underground station and a tram.
Klitschko said explosions shattered windows at two medical facilities. He said two members of an emergency crew had been injured after rushing to the scene of one strike.
Reuters witnesses said a series of explosions jolted the city. They said power had been cut in districts on the east side of the Dnipro River.
Moscow has long denied that it targets civilians.

items.title: Leinster's Furlong cited over alleged genital grabbing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match at the weekend.
items.body:
Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match at the weekend.
Coombes alleged during the game on Saturday that his testicles had been grabbed, but an immediate television review ordered by referee Andrew Brace was inconclusive, with no evidence of the incident.
However, since the incident was noted in the referee's report, it can be reviewed by the citing commissioner Peter Ferguson.
"Leinster Rugby's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for an incident that occurred in the 37th minute of the United Rugby Championship Round 4 fixture at the Aviva Stadium against Munster Rugby on Saturday, 24 October," a statement from the URC said on Monday.
"The Citing Commissioner in charge has made a complaint about an act of foul play by the Player (Tadhg Furlong No. 3) against opponent Gavin Coombes (No. 8).
"The Player has been cited under Law 9.27 – A player must not do anything that is against the spirit of good sportsmanship, including but not limited to grabbing, twisting or squeezing the genitals.
"Arrangements for the disciplinary process are currently in progress and will be announced in due course."
Coombes has been backed in his allegation by Munster coach Clayton McMillan.
"All I know is that I back our players 100% – that if they make an allegation like that, they wouldn't do it lightly – and that's not the sort of person Gavin is, so we'll see where that goes," McMillan said.
Furlong faces the possibility of a lengthy ban if found guilty. The 33-year-old is a British & Irish Lion and key member of the Ireland team, approaching 100 test caps. He is in the squad for November's Nations Championship fixtures, and a ban would be a blow to his personal reputation as well as to the Irish team.
Leinster head coach Leo Cullen said: "Obviously, once that accusation is made, it becomes a serious matter for the citing commissioner. So my comment is not going to help in any way here. But from what I've seen, I can't see anything."
In the URC last season, Bulls hooker Jan-Hendrik Wessels was handed a nine-week suspension for grabbing the testicles of Connacht's Josh Murphy.

items.title: Ações fecham em alta, com pedido de IPO da Anthropic impulsionando papéis do setor de IA
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: As ações nos EUA fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, com o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq saindo de quedas semanais consecutivas, já que o pedido de abertura de capital da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar o otimismo em relação aos papéis ligados à IA, em uma semana repleta de diversos catalisadores de mercado.
items.body:
As ações nos EUA fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, com o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq saindo de quedas semanais consecutivas, já que o pedido de abertura de capital da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar o otimismo em relação aos papéis ligados à IA, em uma semana repleta de diversos catalisadores de mercado.
A Anthropic divulgou perdas acentuadas e um crescimento vertiginoso da receita em seu pedido de oferta pública inicial nos EUA, expondo sua ambição de construir sistemas de IA capazes de remodelar a economia global, apesar dos altos custos de desenvolvimento da tecnologia.
O laboratório de IA segue em frente com seus planos de abertura de capital, mesmo com a desaceleração do calendário de IPOs do outono — antes bastante movimentado —, já que a recente volatilidade do mercado levou as empresas a adiar suas ofertas.
O pedido da Anthropic surge em um momento em que os investidores analisam cada vez mais o retorno potencial dos gastos maciços com IA e no início de uma semana agitada. Estão previstos a declaração de política monetária do Federal Reserve na quarta-feira, dados sobre crescimento econômico e inflação na quinta-feira e uma série de relatórios de resultados corporativos ao longo da semana.
Mais de um terço das empresas do S&P 500 devem divulgar seus resultados financeiros esta semana, incluindo as gigantes da tecnologia Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) e Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , cujos resultados serão analisados em busca de sinais de que os vultosos investimentos em IA estejam se traduzindo em crescimento.
“Hoje o foco está todo no pedido da Anthropic, então estamos de volta a uma postura um pouco mais otimista, eu diria. Mas há muita coisa nesse pedido. Será interessante ver como as coisas serão recebidas quando elas realmente forem listadas”, disse JP Powers, diretor de investimentos da RWA Wealth Partners, em Boston.
“O risco é talvez um pouco de oscilação se as coisas não estiverem todas indo na mesma direção. Um pouco de otimismo hoje, mas quem sabe o que vai acontecer com alguns desses outros lançamentos nesta semana”, disse ele.
O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,28%, para 52.361,58 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançou 0,70%, para 7.676,77 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) teve alta de 0,83%, para 26.169,38 pontos.
Empresas do setor de chips e relacionadas a chips, amplamente consideradas como algumas das maiores beneficiárias do boom da IA, ajudaram a impulsionar os ganhos. O índice Philadelphia de chips (.SOX) subiu 2,8% no dia, mas ainda apresenta queda de 12,2% no mês.
As ações da Meta fecharam em queda de 1,9% depois que a empresa de mídia social anunciou que planeja levantar até US$95 bilhões em capital para financiar sua expansão relacionada à IA em data centers, capacidade de computação em nuvem e outras infraestruturas.
O setor de IA tem enfrentado pressões neste mês em meio a preocupações de que os gastos financiados por dívida possam se tornar mais difíceis de justificar diante do aumento dos custos de empréstimos.
O pedido de registro da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar o otimismo, no entanto, já que empresas de “neocloud”, incluindo a CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , recuperaram as perdas anteriores.
Outras empresas ligadas à IA, incluindo as fabricantes de produtos fotônicos Lumentum (LITE.O) e Coherent (COHR.N) , estiveram entre as ações com melhor desempenho do S&P 500. A Lumentum e a Coherent subiram cerca de 8% e 6%, respectivamente. O índice de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) liderou os ganhos entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500, subindo 1,5%.
As ações de megacap e de crescimento também apresentaram, em sua maioria, alta. A Tesla (TSLA.O) subiu 5,2%, fechando em seu nível mais alto em mais de três meses, depois que o Barclays elevou sua recomendação para a ação de “neutro” para “acima da média do mercado”.
Os mercados estão precificando apenas 12,7% de chance de um aumento nas taxas pelo Fed na quarta-feira, de acordo com o CME FedWatch. Mas, com as pressões inflacionárias não mostrando sinais de abrandamento, os participantes do mercado não acreditam que o banco central permanecerá com as taxas inalteradas por muito tempo.
Os investidores também se preparam para as eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro, que decidirão o controle do Congresso dos EUA.

items.title: アンソロピック、ＡＩ大事故への保険対応に警告　「引受能力不足も」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mia MacGregor

[２６日] -
items.body:
Mia MacGregor

[２６日] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックは２６日、ＡＩに関わる破滅的な事態が発生した場合、単独の保険会社の引き受け能力や専門知識を超える賠償責任が生じ、場合によっては保険業界全体でも対応しきれない恐れがあると警告した。

同社は２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開した。その書類の中で、ＡＩを巡る法理論が依然定まっていない中、自社モデルに関連する損害によって賠償責任や訴訟、規制当局の措置にさらされる可能性があると説明した。

アンソロピックは「われわれのＡＩモデルに関連する損害は、第三者による悪用から生じるものであれ、モデル自体の挙動によるものであれ、リスクの高い場面や機微な状況での利用によるものであれ、賠償責任や訴訟、規制当局の措置にわれわれをさらす可能性がある」とした。

同社は、契約上の保護措置や保険による補償が、利用者や開発者が意図しないモデルの挙動に起因するものを含め、損害賠償請求から十分に自社を守れない可能性があると述べた。

アンソロピックは、単一の事案、あるいは一連の事案が、不均衡なほど大きな損害と多額の賠償責任を引き起こす恐れがあると指摘。ＡＩに特化した保険市場はなお初期段階にあり、商業的に妥当な条件で補償を得る能力が制約される、あるいは全く得られない可能性があるとした。

同社は「破滅的なＡＩ関連事案から生じ得る損害の規模を踏まえると、いかなる単独の保険会社も、場合によっては保険業界全体を合わせても、そうしたリスクに見合う保険を引き受けるのに十分な能力や専門知識を持ち合わせていない恐れがある」と述べた。

＜サイバー保険・Ｄ＆Ｏ保険への懸念＞

アンソロピックは、サイバー保険に関するリスクにも言及した。同社はセキュリティー侵害などの事案による一定の損失を補償し得る保険に加入しているものの、保険市場が変化する中で補償が不十分になったり、利用できなくなったりする可能性があるとした。

アンソロピックは「さらに、現に加入している保険による補償が潜在的な損失を償うのに十分である保証や、提出した保険金請求が補償対象となり、保険会社によって適時に、あるいはそもそも支払われる保証はない」と述べた。

同社はまた、法律や規制、コーポレートガバナンス（企業統治）に関する開示基準の変化が、コンプライアンスコストを押し上げ、役員賠償責任（Ｄ＆Ｏ）保険をより高額にする可能性があるとも指摘した。

同社は「こうした規則や規制により、役員賠償責任保険の取得コストが上昇すると見込んでいる。補償限度額や補償範囲の縮小を受け入れざるを得なくなるか、同等の補償を維持するために大幅に高いコストを負担することになる可能性がある」とした。

items.title: Petróleo fecha em queda com esperanças de paz; ataques à Arábia Saudita limitam perdas
items.author: Siddharth Cavale
items.creator: Siddharth Cavale
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam em queda nesta segunda-feira, em meio a esperanças de uma redução das hostilidades no Oriente Médio; no entanto, os ataques persistentes à Arábia Saudita — um dos principais produtores — e ao transporte marítimo mantiveram os investidores cautelosos, com os preços oscilando próximos às máximas dos últimos seis meses.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam em queda nesta segunda-feira, em meio a esperanças de uma redução das hostilidades no Oriente Médio; no entanto, os ataques persistentes à Arábia Saudita — um dos principais produtores — e ao transporte marítimo mantiveram os investidores cautelosos, com os preços oscilando próximos às máximas dos últimos seis meses.
O Brent encerrou o dia com queda de 0,8%, a US$115,81 o barril, enquanto os contratos futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fecharam com queda de US$1,51, ou 1,46%, a US$101,76 o barril.
Ambos os índices de referência recuaram após fortes ganhos na sexta-feira, quando o Brent fechou com alta de mais de US$3, registrando um ganho semanal de 6%, enquanto o WTI subiu 2,3% na semana.
O foco dos investidores permaneceu nas tensões no Oriente Médio depois que os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, afirmaram ter atacado estações de bombeamento no oleoduto leste-oeste da Arábia Saudita e no aeroporto de Riade no fim de semana. Não houve confirmação imediata da Arábia Saudita sobre os ataques houthis.
A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita no Iêmen, no entanto, informou nesta segunda-feira que havia destruído três drones que tinham como alvo Riade e as regiões do sul do reino.
As esperanças de um avanço diplomático no conflito do Oriente Médio — que começou com ataques dos Estados Unidos e de Israel ao Irã e posteriormente se espalhou para a Arábia Saudita e o Iêmen — pesaram sobre os preços do petróleo no início do pregão, com o Brent caindo mais de US$2 por barril.
Mediadores do Catar viajaram para Teerã no domingo, em coordenação com os Estados Unidos, para buscar maneiras de amenizar as tensões regionais, segundo uma autoridade a par do assunto.
A Arábia Saudita, a Turquia e o Paquistão mantiveram conversações com autoridades iranianas em Teerã nesta segunda-feira, como parte dos esforços para evitar uma nova escalada na região.
As negociações representaram o primeiro contato de alto nível entre o Irã e as três nações, que assinaram um pacto de defesa mútua em agosto.
Ao final, os quatro países concordaram em continuar as negociações com o objetivo de fortalecer a cooperação em prol da paz e da segurança, informou a mídia estatal iraniana.
O Parlamento egípcio autorizou o presidente Abdel Fattah al-Sisi a tomar “todas as medidas necessárias” para ajudar a Arábia Saudita a se defender, aumentando a possibilidade de apoio militar egípcio ao reino.
