items.title: Ibovespa fecha em queda de quase 14% após reeleição de Lula acionar "circuit breaker"
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: O Ibovespa fechou com a maior queda desde 2020 nesta segunda-feira, marcada por "circuit breaker" na bolsa paulista, em meio a uma forte reprecificação das ações brasileiras após o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conquistar a reeleição no domingo.
items.body:
O Ibovespa fechou com a maior queda desde 2020 nesta segunda-feira, marcada por "circuit breaker" na bolsa paulista, em meio a uma forte reprecificação das ações brasileiras após o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conquistar a reeleição no domingo.
Investidores vinham se posicionado para uma vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no segundo turno da disputa, principalmente após ele liderar a primeira etapa da disputa, vislumbrando um governo mais favorável ao mercado e melhora do cenário fiscal. Mas, no domingo, Lula [USN:L6N46C00S TEXT:"venceu"] Flávio por 51,79% a 48,21% dos votos válidos, uma diferença de 4,4 milhões de votos, frustrando tais expectativas e desencadeando uma forte correção no mercado financeiro brasileiro como um todo.
Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) despencou 13,88%, a 176.608,23 pontos, maior perda percentual em um dia desde 16 março de 2020 (-13,92%), período marcado pela pandemia de Covid. No pior momento do dia, o Ibovespa apurou queda de mais de 17%, a 169.516,43 pontos.
O índice Small Caps (.SMLL) tombou 26,92%, para 2.036,13 pontos, maior queda em um dia da sua série histórica, iniciada em 2005.
O volume financeiro no pregão totalizou quase R$114,9 bilhões, bem acima de uma média diária já alta no mês, de cerca de R$57,5 bilhões e perto do recorde registrado em abril desse ano, quando atingiu R$120 bilhões, inflado naquela sessão pelo vencimento de opções sobre o Ibovespa.
FREIOS ACIONADOS A B3 acionou o "circuit breaker" na abertura, suspendendo por 30 minutos a negociação de ativos à vista, renda fixa privada e opções referenciadas em ações, BDR, Ibovespa, Ibovespa B3 BR+, IBrX-50, Índice Small Cap e ETFs. A B3 afirmou que decisão de acionar o mecanismo baseou-se na análise do cenário de formação do preço teórico do Ibovespa, que indicava queda superior a 20%.
O "circuit breaker" não era acionado na bolsa desde março de 2020.
"O mercado embutiu nos seus preços uma expectativa diferente no primeiro turno do que efetivamente se concretizou no segundo turno e como esse resultado foi diametralmente diferente das expectativas há esse ajuste forte", afirmou a investidora Louise Barsi, cofundadora do Grupo AGF (Ações Garantem o Futuro).
"O momento é de cautela, mas não é nem 8 nem 80, não acho que é para zerar o caixa, mas também não acho que é para deixar algumas oportunidades passarem, principalmente nomes de qualidade", afirmou, lembrando que políticos passam, mas as boas empresas ficam e as oportunidades surgem justamente nesses momentos de grande instabilidade e incerteza.
Olhando para frente, Louise citou que não dá para cravar que esse foi o único ajuste e citou que há um cenário desafiador para 2027, com baixo crescimento econômico, risco persistente de pressão inflacionária e juros ainda em níveis elevados. "Vamos ver se o governo vai fazer algum aceno ao mercado para tentar acalmar os ânimos", disse a investidora, que é filha de Luiz Barsi Filho, um dos maiores investidores individuais da bolsa brasileira.
ACENO Ainda nesta segunda-feira, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, afirmou ao Estadão que o governo apresentará uma [USN:L2N46C0V8 TEXT:"proposta"] para que possa perseguir o centro da meta fiscal ao longo do ano, e não mais o piso da margem de tolerância.
Na visão de agentes financeiros, houve um aumento das incertezas sobre as perspectivas fiscais do país e a direção dos preços dos ativos brasileiros agora dependerá das sinalizações sobre a política econômica do novo mandato. As atenções estão voltadas para a decisão sobre quem comandará o Ministério da Fazenda, bem como uma definição mais precisa da estratégia de consolidação fiscal para os próximos quatro anos.
O Goldman Sachs espera, "no máximo, medidas modestas para conter o crescimento dos gastos primários, acompanhadas por novos aumentos de uma carga tributária que já é elevada. "O governo provavelmente manterá sua forte convicção de que o setor público e as estatais devem continuar desempenhando papel central como motores do crescimento econômico e do investimento", acrescentou em relatório a clientes.
Para o Morgan Stanley, há, de modo geral, um risco relevante de queda para as ações brasileiras antes do fim do ano, especialmente para empresas mais expostas ao mercado doméstico. "Apesar de acreditar que a reação inicial dos mercados deve ser uma forte redução de exposição ao risco, o desafio subjacente é muito mais profundo, refletindo desequilíbrios macroeconômicos estruturais que se tornam cada vez mais difíceis de reverter."
O Scotiabank também destacou que o fato de Flávio [USN:S0N461031 TEXT:"se recusar"] a reconhecer a derrota e entrar com uma contestação judicial do resultado deve manter a incerteza política elevada, mantendo sob pressão as ações brasileiras. "Continuamos otimistas em relação ao Brasil, mas pode ser necessário ter mais paciência", afirmou.
DESTAQUES BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) desabou 29,33%, fechando em uma mínima desde maio de 2023, a R$17,47, em sessão [USN:S0N45001K TEXT:"bastante negativa"] para o setor financeiro, que vinha também sendo um dos mais beneficiados pelas expectativas de vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro. BTG PACTUAL UNIT tombou 24,83%, BRADESCO PN despencou 21,7%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN caiu 13,66% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT <SANB11.SA>, que divulga balanço na quarta-feira, fechou em queda de 4,47%.

B3 ON (B3SA3.SA) caiu 36,28%, enquanto XP <XP.O>, listada nos EUA, afundou 48,36%, na maior queda em um dia desde o IPO em 2019, e Nubank (NU.N) , também listada em Nova York, recuou 16,95%. Para analistas do JPMorgan, há risco de revisões negativas para as estimativas de mercado para o lucro por ação nos próximos dias e 2027 pode se mostrar um ano mais desafiador para o cenário macroeconômico brasileiro. O índice do setor financeiro (.IFNC) caiu 22,48%.
PETROBRAS PN recuou 8,18% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) perdeu 6,81%, também contaminadas pela aversão a risco na bolsa brasileira, em pregão ainda marcado pelo declínio dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional . A presidente da estatal, [USN:S0N43906C TEXT:"Magda Chambriard"], afirmou nesta segunda-feira que a forte queda nas ações se trata de "movimento especulativo" e não reflete os fundamentos da empresa. "A hora é de comprar (ações). Infelizmente não posso", disse a executiva à Reuters.
VALE ON (VALE3.SA) subiu 4,01%, descolada do viés vendedor no pregão paulista, assim como outras exportadoras, em meio à forte valorização do dólar ante o real. No fechamento, a cotação acusou R$5,4066, alta de 8,36%. Na máxima do dia, chegou a superar os R$5,60. SUZANO ON (SUZB3.SA) avançou 10,08% e EMBRAER ON (EMBJ3.SA) fechou com elevação 8,89%, na ponta positiva do Ibovespa, assim como WEG ON (WEGE3.SA) , que valorizou-se 4,21%, em pregão ainda marcado pelo anúncio de compra do negócio de Power Controls Solutions (PCS) da empresa norte-americana L&S Electric por US$11 milhões.
GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) fechou em alta de 0,91% antes da divulgação do balanço do terceiro trimestre, após o fechamento do mercado. A companhia tem parte relevante da receita oriunda da América do Norte. No setor, USIMINAS PNA perdeu 10,71% e CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) tombou 17,46%.
MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) derreteu 58,23%, em dia de forte pressão em papéis sensíveis a juros dado o movimento na curva de DIs. O índice de consumo (.ICON) da B3 caiu 26,39%, enquanto o índice do setor imobiliário (.IMOB) perdeu 29,11%, com CYRELA ON (CYRE3.SA) despencando 44,81%.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝反発、アンソロピック上場申請でＡＩ株に買い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２６日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２６日　ロイター］　 - 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請がＡＩ関連株への投資家心理を押し上げた。前週まで週足で続落していたＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合は、下落に歯止めをかけた。

アンソロピックは２６日、米国でのＩＰＯ申請書類を公開した。巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになり、開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

今週は２８日の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策決定、２９日の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）およびインフレ指標のほか、週を通じて多数の企業決算発表が予定されている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種構成企業の３分の１超が今週決算を発表する。ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）のアルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムも含まれ、巨額のＡＩ投資が成長につながっているかどうかが注目される。 

ＲＷＡウェルス・パートナーズの最高投資責任者、ＪＰ・パワーズ氏は「きょうはアンソロピックの開示が全てで、相場は再びやや楽観的な方向に傾いていると言える。ただ、開示内容は多岐にわたる。実際に上場する際、投資家にどの程度好意的に受け止められるかが注目される」と述べた。

その上で「各材料が同じ方向を示さなければ、相場が振り回されるリスクがある。きょうは少し楽観的だが、今週の他の発表を受けて何が起きるかは分からない」との見方を示した。

ＡＩブームの最大の恩恵を受ける分野の一つとみられている半導体関連銘柄が相場上昇を後押しした。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％上昇したが、月初来では依然として１２．２％下落している。

メタは１．９％下落。ＡＩ向けデータセンターやクラウドコンピューティングの拡充などに伴う巨額の費用を賄うため、最大９５０億ドルの資本調達を実施する計画を発表した。

ＡＩ関連の取引は今月、借り入れコストの上昇を受けて債務で賄う支出の正当化が難しくなりかねないとの懸念から圧力にさらされてきた。

ただ、アンソロピックのＩＰＯ申請が投資家心理を支え、コアウィーブを含むネオクラウド企業は序盤の下げから切り返した。

その他のＡＩ関連企業も好調で、光学部品メーカーのルメンタムが約８％、コヒレントが約６％、それぞれ上昇した。

超大型株とグロース（成長）株も大半が上昇。テスラは５．２％急伸し、終値で３カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。バークレイズが投資判断を「イコールウエート」から「オーバーウエート」に引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．３６対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０９対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１６７億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

items.title: Rubio dice que es necesario renovar infraestructura electoral de Venezuela antes de sufragios
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el lunes que la infraestructura electoral de Venezuela estaba diseñada para amañar las elecciones y que, por lo tanto, debía sustituirse rápidamente antes de que pueda haber una elección válida.
items.body:
El secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, dijo el lunes que la infraestructura electoral de Venezuela estaba diseñada para amañar las elecciones y que, por lo tanto, debía sustituirse rápidamente antes de que pueda haber una elección válida.
Rubio habló con periodistas por teléfono un día después de que la líder de la oposición, María Corina Machado, regresó a Venezuela por primera vez desde que Estados Unidos capturó en enero al entonces presidente del país, Nicolás Maduro, y lo llevó a Nueva York para ser juzgado.
Estados Unidos cree que las conversaciones entre el Gobierno interino de Caracas y los políticos de la oposición darán lugar a la creación de un nuevo Tribunal Supremo de Justicia a finales de este año y de un nuevo Consejo Electoral poco después, había dicho antes un alto funcionario del Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos.
"Creo que estamos logrando avances reales en ese sentido", dijo Rubio. "Pero si alguien intenta descarrilar el proceso, estará causando un gran daño a Venezuela".
El Gobierno de Maduro estableció la infraestructura electoral del país para amañar las elecciones, por lo que debe cambiarse rápidamente, añadió Rubio.

items.title: Neil Young sues Trump again over 'Rockin' In The Free World'
items.author: Blake Brittain
items.creator: Blake Brittain
items.summary: Rock star Neil Young sued a group associated with President Donald Trump for copyright infringement in Virginia federal court on Monday over the president's alleged misuse of his song "Rockin' in the Free World" at an October rally.
items.body:
Rock star Neil Young sued a group associated with President Donald Trump for copyright infringement in Virginia federal court on Monday over the president's alleged misuse of his song "Rockin' in the Free World" at an October rally.
Young said in the complaint against the Trump 47 Committee that his 1989 song was played without a license before Trump took the stage at a rally in Youngstown, Ohio, in support of Republican midterm election candidates on October 12
"The lyrics paint vivid street-level portraits -- a mother discarding her baby, addicts lost in despair, garbage piling in the shadows of prosperity -- while the repeated chorus delivers a savage irony, celebrating freedom that clearly isn't shared at all," the complaint said. "In short, the song is the opposite of everything Donald J. Trump stands for."
Spokespeople for the White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the complaint
Young [USN:KCN250300 TEXT:"previously sued"] the Trump campaign in 2020 for using "Rockin' in the Free World" and another Young song at campaign rallies without permission
According to the complaint, the campaign promised never to use "Rockin' in the Free World" again without a license after [USN:L1N2IN2SH TEXT:"settling"] the case later that year
Young asked the Virginia court on Monday for $10 million in damages
The case is Young v. Trump 47 Committee Inc, US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia, No. 3:26-cv-01398
For Young: Robert Besser of the Law Offices of Robert Besser
For the organization: attorney information not yet available
Read more:
[USN:KCN250300 TEXT:"Neil Young sues Donald Trump's campaign for using his songs"]
[USN:L1N2IN2SH TEXT:"Neil Young ends lawsuit against Donald Trump's campaign over use of his songs"]

items.title: Shane Steichen keeping Daniel Jones as Colts' starting QB
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Colts coach Shane Steichen once again told reporters Monday that Daniel Jones will remain Indianapolis' quarterback for the team's game at Jacksonville this week.
items.body:
Colts coach Shane Steichen once again told reporters Monday that Daniel Jones will remain Indianapolis' quarterback for the team's game at Jacksonville this week.
Steichen said after the Colts' 16-10 loss to Minnesota on Sunday to fall to 2-5 that he had previously given no consideration to a change at QB.
"He knows he's got to play better," Steichen told reporters Monday. "He's proven that he can do it. So that's where the confidence comes from. And we need to get him back playing to that level that he was last year. It's taking a little bit longer."
Jones completed 68% of his passes for 3,101 yards, 19 touchdowns and eight interceptions in 13 games last season, his first with the Colts, before tearing his Achilles.
This season, he's completing a career-low 59.6% of his passes for 1,398 yards with four touchdowns and seven interceptions -- one off the NFL lead. He has one TD and four interceptions in Indianapolis' last four games.
Jones, 29, was the sixth overall pick in the 2019 NFL Draft. He's thrown for 19,081 yards, 93 TDs and 62 picks over 90 career games for the Giants (2019-24) and Colts.
Anthony Richardson Sr., Indianapolis' fourth overall pick in the 2023 draft, is the team's backup QB. He's appeared in 17 games (15 starts) and completed 50.6% of his passes for 2,400 yards, 11 touchdowns and 13 interceptions.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US judge refuses to block Eli Lilly weight-loss drug ads, rules against Novo Nordisk
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: A US judge rejected on Monday Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly from continuing advertisements for weight-loss drugs that the Danish drugmaker considered false and misleading, affecting markets with tens of billions of dollars of annual sales.
items.body:
A US judge rejected on Monday Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) request to block Eli Lilly (LLY.N) from continuing advertisements for weight-loss drugs that the Danish drugmaker considered false and misleading, affecting markets with tens of billions of dollars of annual sales.
US District Judge Zahid Quraishi in Trenton, New Jersey, said Novo Nordisk did not deserve a preliminary injunction, having failed to show that Eli Lilly's ads threatened sales, undermined its goodwill, or caused lasting damage to its clinical reputation.
Quraishi called Novo Nordisk's claim of irreparable harm "inadequate to warrant the extraordinary relief it seeks." The judge ruled after a two-day hearing in late August.
Novo Nordisk [USN:L1N43N0EQ TEXT:"sued"] Eli Lilly in July, saying ads for the obesity drug Zepbound and diabetes treatment Mounjaro violated federal and state false advertising and unfair competition laws by comparing higher doses of those products with lower doses of Novo Nordisk's Wegovy and Ozempic.
One commercial included a voiceover claim, with a written disclaimer, that people using Zepbound on average lost 50 pounds (23 kg) while people using Wegovy on average lost 33 pounds (15 kg).
"While we are disappointed with the court’s decision, today's ruling did not decide the question of whether Lilly's advertising is false and misleading, and this litigation is still ongoing," a Novo Nordisk spokesperson said in an email. "Everyone deserves clear, accurate and up-to-date information when making decisions about their health."
Eli Lilly, based in Indianapolis, has denied wrongdoing and said it was pleased with the decision.
WEIGHT-LOSS DRUGS ARE BIG BUSINESS Weight-loss drugs have become major businesses for large pharmaceutical companies. The United States is among a handful of countries that allow direct-to-consumer advertising of prescription medicines.
In his 25-page decision, Quraishi said that while Novo Nordisk's witnesses were credible, Eli Lilly's ads had at most a negligible market impact between April and July, with prescriptions for Novo Nordisk's products remaining stable.
The judge said money damages could compensate Novo Nordisk for any "nontrivial harm" it might suffer absent an injunction.
Quraishi also found Novo Nordisk's case "less than persuasive" based on a "very preliminary record," though he did not rule on the merits.
Novo Nordisk reported combined sales of about $32 billion for obesity medicines and Ozempic in 2025, court papers show.
The drugmaker is working to regain market share in the United States for its injectable obesity drugs, a market projected to exceed $100 billion by the end of the decade.
items.raw_description: A US judge rejected on Monday Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly from continuing advertisements for weight-loss drugs that the Danish drugmaker considered false and misleading, affecting markets with tens of billions of dollars of annual sales.

items.title: Rubio says Venezuela's electoral infrastructure must be replaced before a vote
items.author: Simon Lewis, Matt Spetalnick
items.creator: Simon Lewis, Matt Spetalnick
items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday that Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held.
items.body:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday that Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held.
Rubio spoke to reporters by phone a day after opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returned to Venezuela for the first time since the US captured the country's then-President Nicolas Maduro in January and took him to New York for trial.
The US believes that talks currently underway between the interim government in Caracas and opposition politicians are expected to see a new supreme judicial tribunal in place by the end of this year and a new electoral council shortly thereafter, a senior US State Department official said earlier.
"I think we're making real progress in that regard," said Rubio, who has acted as US President Donald Trump's point person on Venezuela. "But if anybody tries to derail that process, they're doing a great harm to Venezuela."
Maduro's government had set up the country's electoral infrastructure to rig elections so must be quickly changed, Rubio added.
But Rubio stopped short of giving a target date for elections. Machado has said elections should be held by mid-2027, though Trump has previously said he did not believe Venezuela was ready for a nationwide vote.
Machado's return to Venezuela after several failed attempts risks straining her ties with Trump's administration.
Nobel Peace Prize laureate Machado, who was prevented from challenging Maduro for the presidency in 2024, had been out of the country for 10 months and spent the previous year in hiding following the disputed election.
Washington has said Machado has every right to be in Venezuela, but has praised acting President Delcy Rodriguez and supports a negotiation process between the Rodriguez government and opposition groups that do not include Machado's Vente Venezuela movement.
Rubio said the only time he had "discouraged" Machado from going back to Venezuela was in the immediate aftermath of devastating earthquakes in the summer, because the country was grappling with a humanitarian crisis.
But Rubio said that weeks ago the US told Venezuela's interim authorities that Machado "belongs in her country" and "should be allowed to return unperturbed," and the government had agreed.
Asked about Machado's criticism of an oil deal that Trump had struck with the interim rulers, Rubio insisted that the agreement was a good one for both countries but that she had a right to express her opinion on the matter.
Trump has repeatedly expressed support for Rodriguez, a former deputy to Maduro, and hailed deals on oil production and other business ventures by US companies in the South American country.
But some critics have accused Trump of a neo-colonialist approach to Venezuela aimed at exploiting its natural resources.
A faction of the opposition and the interim government held a round of talks this month, with the aim of remaking the top court and electoral council, among other goals, ahead of eventual elections. The talks have not included Machado's political movement.

items.title: トランプ政権下の燃料平均価格、バイデン前政権超え　中間選挙控え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン ２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン ２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の２期目における給油所のガソリン・軽油の平均価格は、民主党のバイデン前大統領の政権時を上回っていることが米自動車協会（ＡＡＡ）のデータで明らかになった。

１１月３日の中間選挙で共和党が上下両院で僅差の過半数維持を目指す中、燃料価格の高騰はトランプ氏にとって大きな悩みの種となっている。

ＡＡＡのデータによると、トランプ氏が約２年前に就任して以降、レギュラーガソリンの平均価格は１ガロン当たり３．４７２ドルと、バイデン政権時の平均３．４７１ドルをわずかに上回った。

農業や重工業から運輸まで世界経済を動かす燃料である軽油の価格も、トランプ政権下で１ガロン当たり４．３４３ドルと、バイデン政権時の４．０７８ドルを上回った。米国の軽油価格は、ウクライナとイランの戦争が世界の燃料供給を混乱させる中、９月２２日に１ガロン当たり６．５２３ドルと過去最高を付けた。

イランとの戦争は中東全域に波及し、戦闘は主にホルムズ海峡周辺で展開されている。２月の開戦前には、世界の石油・ガス供給の約５分の１が同海峡を通過していた。

ホワイトハウスのロジャース報道官は「この紛争が終結すれば、ガソリン価格は大幅に下落する。米軍の卓越した働きにより、今やイラン紛争が始まる前よりも多くの石油がペルシャ湾から運び出されている」と述べた。

アナリストらは、インフレが根強く続いているため、名目価格の比較は誤解を招くと指摘する。

燃料価格情報サイト、ガスバディーの石油分析責任者パトリック・デハーン氏は、トランプ政権下の燃料平均価格がバイデン政権時を上回ったことについて「ドルの価値は長期にわたって価格に影響を与えるため、インフレ調整を加味すれば実態を捉えられる。米国民が給油に費やす金額の所得に占める割合は、依然として過去最高ではない」と述べた。

items.title: Ben & Jerry's founders explore deal to separate brand from owner, WSJ reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ben & Jerry's founders Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield are exploring a deal to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
items.body:
Ben & Jerry's founders Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield are exploring a deal to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The ice cream brand is owned by Unilever (ULVR.L) spin-off Magnum Ice Cream (MICCT.AS) .
The co-founders have been discussing a deal with Pete Stavros, founder of Expanding ESOPs, to carve out the business and structure it under an employee stock-ownership plan, WSJ said, citing Stavros and Cohen.
The structure would give rank-and-file employees stock while providing the company with tax benefits, the report added.
But any deal would need to be approved by Ben & Jerry's owner Magnum, which told Reuters in an emailed statement that "Ben & Jerry's is not for sale and, more importantly, is thriving as part of The Magnum Ice Cream Company."
"Taking Ben & Jerry's out of Magnum would drive significant dis-synergies, investment in the social mission would fall, and selling prices per unit would inflate," it added.
Ben & Jerry's has a history of vocal social activism and its founders and board have [USN:L6N40E1GS TEXT:"repeatedly clashed"] with former parent Unilever over political and ethical stances.
Magnum has also looked to [USN:L1N41J0MN TEXT:"weaken the control"] of Ben & Jerry's independent board, which has been reduced to just two members.
Cohen told the WSJ that "all he could do is try to generate more public pressure on Magnum to sell."
Ben & Jerry's and representatives for the co-founders and Stravos did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

items.title: Trump afirma, sem provas, que eleição no Brasil parece ter sido manipulada
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira que a eleição brasileira, vencida no domingo pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, parece ter sido fraudada.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira que a eleição brasileira, vencida no domingo pelo presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, parece ter sido fraudada.
"Não tomei partido, mas parecia mais uma eleição fraudulenta", disse ele a jornalistas, sem apresentar nenhuma evidência. "As eleições precisam ser incontestáveis, e isso me pareceu muito ruim."
Derrotado no segundo turno da eleição, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) se recusa a reconhecer o resultado. Na noite de domingo, o candidato do PL criticou a prorrogação por duas horas do horário de votação do pleito, apesar de seu próprio partido também ter pedido a extensão.
Seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, foi um aliado próximo de Trump enquanto esteve no cargo.
O governo Trump vinha saudando uma onda de recentes vitórias eleitorais da direita em outros países da América Latina.
Trump disse ainda nesta segunda-feira gostar de Lula e se dar bem com ele.
O vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin, reeleito na chapa de Lula no domingo, rebateu a declaração do presidente norte-americano, classificando-a como "totalmente equivocada".
"Primeiro, não se interfere na política de outro país. Essa é uma regra basilar. Segundo, não tem nenhum referencial pra dizer isso. Aliás, o Brasil é um exemplo pro mundo. De urna eletrônica, de segurança jurídica. Democracia é assim. Você ganha eleição, você perde a eleição, é o povo que decide", disse Alckmin à Rede Vanguarda.
O vice aproveitou para falar que agora é hora de seguir com as negociações tarifárias com os EUA.
“Nós, encerrada a eleição, vamos continuar a negociação com os Estados Unidos para ter um bom acordo", afirmou.

items.author: Echo Wang, Milana Vinn
items.creator: Echo Wang, Milana Vinn
items.summary: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
DoorDash (DASH.O) is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart (CART.O) in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
A deal may be finalized as soon as Wednesday, although there are no guarantees it will come together, the person said. Instacart's deal talks with Uber (UBER.N) are no longer active, the person added.
Shares of Instacart, which had a market value of about $13 billion as of Friday's close, rose about 8% in regular trading, while DoorDash fell around 6%.
The Wall Street Journal first reported the developments on Monday.
The food delivery industry has been grappling with rising labor costs, tighter regulation of delivery workers and growing competition after the pandemic-driven boom in online ordering faded.
The potential deal comes as delivery companies expand into grocery and retail to drive growth beyond restaurant delivery, with DoorDash [USN:L4N3RE0BH TEXT:"buying"] Deliveroo and Uber acquiring [USN:KBN2470AP TEXT:"Postmates"] and Delivery Hero .
If successful, the acquisition of Instacart would give DoorDash access to the platform's established marketplace and retailer ties, which it could combine with its own vast delivery network and customer base.
The grocery platform has been exploring a possible sale and has held [USN:L4N4691PA TEXT:"preliminary discussions"] with potential buyers including Uber and DoorDash, the Information reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Instacart declined to comment when contacted by Reuters, while Uber and DoorDash did not immediately respond.
"Strategically, DoorDash looks like the more natural fit for Instacart, given the complementary strengths of its restaurant delivery network and Instacart's grocery expertise," said Nick Smith, co-founder of growth strategy consultancy Manifesto Growth Architects.
"For Uber, the opportunity would be to deepen its position as an everyday convenience platform. But an acquisition only makes sense if it delivers incremental customer value and profitable growth — not simply greater scale."
Separately, Instacart said in a regulatory filing on Monday it would wind down its Caper Cart smart shopping-cart business by the end of the second quarter of 2027, expecting pre-tax charges of $55 million to $80 million related to the move.

items.title: Trump offers $1 million for tipoffs that lead to voter fraud convictions
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Monday the US would give $1 million to anyone who reported voter fraud that leads to an arrest and conviction, a week before midterm elections that polls show could prove difficult for his Republican Party.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Monday the US would give $1 million to anyone who reported voter fraud that leads to an arrest and conviction, a week before midterm elections that polls show could prove difficult for his Republican Party.
BACKGROUND AND QUOTE: The Trump administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach to election oversight, for example by pressing states for voter-registration data and arguing stricter measures are needed to ensure public confidence in the vote.
Critics, including political experts as well as Democratic and some Republican election officials, view the moves as federal overreach.
"Anybody reporting Voter Fraud in the past Elections, or the upcoming 2026 Midterm Election, will be paid $1,000,000 upon the arrest and conviction of those that created the Fraud," Trump wrote on Truth Social on Monday.
Some election officials have told Reuters they are preparing for potential federal interference in midterm elections.
Trump has made false claims related to elections in the past, including not acknowledging his defeat in the 2020 elections.
His supporters [USN:L6N3OH01A TEXT:"eventually stormed the US Capitol"] on January 6, 2021, in an unsuccessful attempt to prevent congressional certification of those elections.
Republicans currently hold a narrow majority in the House of Representatives and Senate.
However, ahead of the midterm vote in which control of Congress is at stake, Trump's approval has remained low due to voter concerns about the high cost of living and rising fuel prices from the US-Israeli war on Iran .

items.title: 中国アリババのＡＩ、北京のサーバーに無断でデータ送信試みる＝加コヒア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - カナダの人工知能（ＡＩ）スタートアップ、コヒアは２６日、中国のテクノロジー大手アリババ・グループのオープンウエート型ＡＩモデル「Ｑｗｅｎ」の１つが、セキュリティーテスト中に北京にあるアリババクラウドのストレージサーバーへデータを送信しようとしたと明らかにした。 

このモデルは、自らの推論過程ではそうした行為を行わないと示していたにもかかわらず、送信を試みたという。アリババは通常の営業時間外のため、直ちにコメントを得ることはできなかった。 

コヒアによると、アリババの「Ｑｗｅｎ３．８─Ｆｌａｓｈ─Ｎｅｘｔ」は、悪意あるファイルのダウンロードを検知するルールを作成するよう指示されたが、代わりに実行中のマシンの状態を調査し、北京のサーバーにテストファイルを送信しようとしたという。 

コヒアのテスト環境はインターネットに接続されておらず、この試みは阻止されたものの、開発者のノートパソコンや通常のネットワークアクセスが可能なシステム上であれば、この要求がサーバーに到達していた可能性もあると同社は指摘した。

こうした挙動はまれで、コヒアのテスト全体で１０万回の動作に１回未満の頻度でしか発生しなかったが、週に１０００万件のエージェント動作を処理するサービスであれば、最大で１００件程度の同様の試みが発生し得るという。

コヒアは、この挙動が意図的なものか、それともモデルの訓練環境から消去されずに残ったデータなどによるものかは特定できなかったと述べた。

コヒアは、企業や政府向けにＡＩモデルを「ソブリンＡＩ」として販売しており、「Ｑｗｅｎ」のように誰でもダウンロードして自前のサーバーで実行できるオープンウエート型モデルと競合している。

items.title: US, Canada working on deal to ease steel, auto tariffs, sources say
items.author: Promit Mukherjee, David Shepardson
items.creator: Promit Mukherjee, David Shepardson
items.summary: The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, two US and four Canadian sources said, as the two governments try to repair relations that soured after trade talks broke down in August.
items.body:
The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease US tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, two US and four Canadian sources said, as the two governments try to repair relations that soured after trade talks broke down in August.
The talks focus on tariffs imposed under Section 232 of US trade law, including up to 50% tariff on Canadian steel and a 25% tariff on autos, with negotiators discussing potential relief from those duties.
Just [USN:L6N46C17B TEXT:"32%"] of Americans approve of US President Donald Trump and his Republican Party risks losing control of Congress in next week's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. Tariffs on Canadian imports have become a [USN:L6N4580Y1 TEXT:"political liability"] for Trump, with Republican candidates in border states calling for an end to the trade war with Canada.
One Canadian source briefed on the negotiations said a deal on steel and auto tariffs was possible before the November 3 elections, while US sources said the Trump administration wanted Canada to make further concessions. The sources spoke on condition of anonymity because the talks are private.
The Section 232 tariffs are administered by the Commerce Department, putting Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick rather than the US Trade Representative's office at the center of the negotiations, sources on both sides of the border said.
Lutnick and Canada's Dominic LeBlanc, the minister responsible for Canada-US trade, have been in regular contact recently, one of the sources said.
"Canada remains in constructive dialogue with our U.S. counterparts on a range of priorities," a spokesperson for LeBlanc, said in a statement. "We stand ready to work constructively and in good faith towards a more mutually beneficial trading relationship that respects Canada’s interests.”
The US Trade Representative's Office and Canada have also been in contact in recent days regarding the overall architecture of any deal and all other trade issues, a USTR official said.
The White House and the Commerce Department did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
OTTAWA SEES PROGRESS Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said there had been "a slight intensification" in talks with the United States, adding that Ottawa had not changed its stance.
"To the extent any progress has been made, it's because the US is coming closer to our position," he told reporters, but did not give details.
A Canadian industry source said a deal could come quickly, but not necessarily a broad one. "If it happens, it'll happen fast. But my sense is it'll be a narrowed deal, if it even happens,” the source said.
Another Canadian source said they have believed for some time that a deal on Section 232 tariffs is likely before the midterms. Any agreement would be driven by Trump and Carney, the source said, adding that both leaders had said a mutually beneficial deal is possible.
Carney has said he wants a [USN:O8N40E02J TEXT:"good deal "]for Canada.
US and Canadian trade talks collapsed in August over issues such as whether to cut duties on medium- and heavy-duty vehicles that are critical for Canadian factories. US automakers [USN:L6N44N0VK TEXT:"had hoped"] the trade talks would deliver relief from Washington's original 25% tariffs that have raised the cost of shipping vehicles and parts across the border.
Trump has previously announced that he would raise the tariffs on steel and auto imports from Canada to 50% from January 1, 2027. At a political rally on Sunday, Trump predicted the trade dispute would be resolved "soon," without providing specifics.
Trump signed an order on Friday to remove 50% tariffs on some Canadian agricultural and forestry products in a move that could benefit businesses in Maine.

Oct 26 : Skydance is offering some employees a one-time voluntary buyout, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, as the media company looks to cut costs after scooping up bigger rival Warner Bros Discovery and assuming its massive debt.
The company, whose shares have fallen by about a third this year, is also moving to a five-day-a-week in-office policy, the memo showed.
• "As we bring our teams together, we recognize that not everyone will see their future here, and we respect that," Skydance CEO David Ellison and co-CEO Ynon Kreiz said in the memo
• The communication also said employees who qualify for the buyout program would be notified of the terms and given a window to decide whether to accept the one-time offer

• Earlier this month, Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery, with the combined entity renamed Skydance
• Skydance is expected to have about 53,000 employees, according to the companies' respective annual filings as of the end of last year
• The company is expected to shoulder about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on management to expand streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance
• The company is set to report third quarter results on November 9, where investors will be focused on its new strategy
• Semafor and CNBC reported last week that Elon Musk has invested roughly $1 billion in Skydance

items.title: STF não ordenou volta de Bolsonaro ao regime fechado após suposto desacato
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts.
items.body:
O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) não determinou que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, em prisão domiciliar desde novembro de 2025, retorne ao regime fechado, como afirmam posts.
“Urgente: Jair Bolsonaro é preso por desacato à autoridade e será enviado de volta para a Papuda”, dizem postagens que passaram a circular no Facebook e no Instagram neste domingo, após a vitória do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sobre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).
O STF negou à Reuters que tenha havido uma decisão da Corte neste sentido.
A determinação também não consta no processo de execução penal do ex-presidente, que cumpre pena de mais de 27 anos de prisão por tentar dar um golpe de Estado em 2022.
A defesa do político disse por mensagem que “desconhece” uma ordem para que ele volte ao regime fechado e o alegado episódio de desacato.
Até ser enviado para a prisão domiciliar , Bolsonaro foi mantido na prisão da Papudinha, que faz parte do Complexo Penitenciário da Papuda. A Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal, que administra a Papudinha, disse que a alegação sobre o retorno do ex-presidente "não procede".
No fim da tarde desta segunda-feira, Flávio Bolsonaro publicou um vídeo em seu Instagram dizendo que havia visitado o pai em casa pela manhã.
(Texto atualizado em 26 de outubro de 2026 com resposta da Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal e informação sobre visita de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro.)
VEREDICTO Falso. O STF, a defesa de Bolsonaro e a Polícia Militar do Distrito Federal negaram que o ex-presidente tenha sido enviado de volta ao regime fechado após um suposto episódio de desacato à autoridade.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.body:
Rodrigo Campos　Marcela Ayres　Karin Strohecker

[ニューヨーク／ブラジリア　２６日　ロイター] - ブラジルで２５日に行われた大統領選の決選投票で、左派で現職のルラ大統領が右派のフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員を破り再選を果たしたことを受け、２６日のブラジル金融市場は株価とレアル相場が急落するなど大荒れの展開となった。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの中南米担当シニアエコノミスト、マウリシオ・モンヘ氏は「ルラ氏の勝利を受け、ルラ氏の４期目政権下での財政見通しを巡る見直しが市場で進み、急激な売りが広がった」と指摘。「ルラ氏にとって最大の課題は、実質賃金の上昇と雇用拡大を優先しながら、信頼性があり持続可能な財政再建の実現は可能だと市場を納得させることだ」と述べた。

ＩＮＧのストラテジスト、クリス・ターナー氏は「国内金融市場にとって重要なのは、ボルソナロ氏がどれだけ早く選挙結果を受け入れるか、少なくとも憲法に基づく手続きの進行を容認することだ」と指摘。市場はまた、ルラ氏の財務相人事にも注目。ＲＢＣブルーベイ・アセット・マネジメントのグラハム・ストック氏は「次期ルラ政権が財政規律を維持する意思を示すかが市場にとって最大の焦点になっている。その第一歩となるのが、今後数週間以内に行われる新財務相の任命だ」と述べた。

２６日の株式市場では、ブラジルの主要株価指数のボベスパ指数が一時１５％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては１９９８年以来最大の下落率となる可能性がある。ブラジル証券取引所を運営するＢ３は、ボベスパ指数が前営業日終値から１０％下落したことを受けサーキットブレーカーが発動され、株式売買を３０分間停止したと発表した。

外国為替市場では、ブラジルレアルが対ドルで一時１１％超下落。１日当たりの下落率としては過去最大級になる可能性がある。

売りはブラジル国債にも波及。２０５４年償還債など超長期債を中心に大きく売られた。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスのデータによると、ブラジルの５年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ）保証料率は１５１．６７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）に上昇。前週末終値の１２０．２１ｂｐから大幅に拡大した。ＣＤＳは国債の債務不履行（デフォルト）に対する保険コストの指標とされる。

市場が急落する中、ブラジル財務省は２７日に予定していた物価連動国債の入札と、２９日に予定していた固定利付国債の入札を中止した。

items.body:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

上昇して取引を終えた。幅広い銘柄に買い注文が入り、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反発。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．０９％高と続伸した。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発投資への警戒感が根強い中、米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請の動きが好感された。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は５．２８％高。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは６．１％、防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは４．１％それぞれ上昇した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは堅調な利益見通しを示し、１３．１％高。プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドの３ｉグループは２．６％上昇した。

一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．８９％安。石油大手のＢＰは１．２％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

今週は、ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案発表を２８日に控える。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が開催する連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）にも注目が集まっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。堅調な企業業績見通しが相次いで発表され、投資家の期待感が相場を後押しした。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は０．９１％高。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．６４％高。旅行・娯楽関連株指数は１．９２％上昇。一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．１９％下落した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは通期利益見通しが市場予想を上回り、１３．１％上昇。大腸がん治療薬の臨床試験のデータを発表したデンマークのバイオ医薬品会社ジェンマブは１２．１％値上がりした。

ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が発表した１０月の業況指数は市場予想以上に改善した。

今週は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がそれぞれ金融政策決定会合を開く。市場では、ＥＣＢが政策金利を据え置き、１２月に利上げするとの観測が強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債の価格が５月以来最大の上昇率を記録する勢いとなった。ムーディーズによる格下げを免れたほか、週末の抗議活動もおおむね前週のような騒乱に発展せず、国債売りに歯止めがかかった。

週内に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利決定を控え、原油価格の小幅下落も一部のユーロ圏国債を支えた。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは約１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、４．９１５％となった。１日の低下幅としては５月下旬以来最大となる見通し。前週は５．１４１５％と、２４年ぶりの高水準に達していた。

独仏１０年債の利回り格差は１１ｂｐ縮小して１５５ｂｐとなった。前週には１７７．７ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。

議会の分裂で財政再建が難航し、２０２７年の大統領選に向けた駆け引きも始まる中、仏政府にとって一定の安心材料となった。しかし、ＤＺ銀行のアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は、フランス国債の重しとなっている財政問題は解消していないと指摘した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．３５％となった。

ＥＣＢの政策見通しの変化に敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇し、３．０７５％となった。

ドイツ国債は前週、安全資産への資金逃避の主な受け皿の一つとなった。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は２．６４％高。旅行・娯楽関連株指数は１．９２％上昇。一方、石油・ガス株指数は０．１９％下落した。

テクノロジー・サービスプロバイダーのコンピュータセンターは通期利益見通しが市場予想を上回り、１３．１％上昇。大腸がん治療薬の臨床試験のデータを発表したデンマークのバイオ医薬品会社ジェンマブは１２．１％値上がりした。

ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が発表した１０月の業況指数は市場予想以上に改善した。

今週は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）や米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がそれぞれ金融政策決定会合を開く。市場では、ＥＣＢが政策金利を据え置き、１２月に利上げするとの観測が強い。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債の価格が５月以来最大の上昇率を記録する勢いとなった。ムーディーズによる格下げを免れたほか、週末の抗議活動もおおむね前週のような騒乱に発展せず、国債売りに歯止めがかかった。

週内に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金利決定を控え、原油価格の小幅下落も一部のユーロ圏国債を支えた。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは約１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、４．９１５％となった。１日の低下幅としては５月下旬以来最大となる見通し。前週は５．１４１５％と、２４年ぶりの高水準に達していた。

独仏１０年債の利回り格差は１１ｂｐ縮小して１５５ｂｐとなった。前週には１７７．７ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。

議会の分裂で財政再建が難航し、２０２７年の大統領選に向けた駆け引きも始まる中、仏政府にとって一定の安心材料となった。しかし、ＤＺ銀行のアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は、フランス国債の重しとなっている財政問題は解消していないと指摘した。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇し、３．３５％となった。

ＥＣＢの政策見通しの変化に敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ上昇し、３．０７５％となった。

ドイツ国債は前週、安全資産への資金逃避の主な受け皿の一つとなった。

items.title: Alibaba AI model secretly tried to reach Beijing server in test, rival Cohere says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test.
items.body:
Canadian AI company Cohere said on Monday one of Alibaba's Qwen AI models tried to send data to an Alibaba Cloud storage server in Beijing during a security test.
The model made the attempt even though its own reasoning indicated it would not do such a thing, Cohere said. Alibaba was not immediately available for comment outside regular business hours.
Cohere, which sells its own AI models to businesses and governments as a "sovereign AI" provider, competes with open-weight models such as Alibaba's Qwen, which anyone can download and run on their own servers
Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next was asked to write a rule to detect malicious file download, but instead took stock of the machine it was running on and tried to send a test file to the Beijing server, Cohere said
Cohere's test environment had no connection to the internet and blocked the attempt but the company said the request could have reached the server on a developer's laptop or a system with normal network access
The behavior was rare, occurring in fewer than one in 100,000 actions across Cohere's tests, but a service handling 10 million agent actions a week could see as many as 100 such attempts, Cohere said
The Canadian AI platform said it could not determine whether the behavior was deliberate or a leftover from the model's training, such as unscrubbed data from the environments where it was trained
Chinese models accounted for 41% of downloads on AI platform Hugging Face over the past year, more than any other country's, according to the platform’s spring 2026 report

items.title: Libya says international aviation restrictions lifted after 11 years
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Libya's Ministry of Transport said on Monday that airspace restrictions issued by the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization in 2015 during the country's civil war have been removed.
items.body:
Libya's Ministry of Transport said on Monday that airspace restrictions issued by the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization in 2015 during the country's civil war have been removed.
The ministry said the decision, which was formally issued on October 23, was announced by ICAO Secretary General Juan Carlos Salazar at the opening of a meeting of civil aviation officials from the Middle East in Doha.
"This measure comes as a result of the notable progress made and the confidence placed in the capabilities of the Libyan civil aviation sector in recent times," the Tripoli-based Ministry of Transport said in a statement on its verified Facebook page.
The ministry, in a separate statement, said the North African country has received requests for permits to transit Libyan airspace that it characterized as "unprecedented demand from international airlines."
"The total number of permits registered for 2026-2027 winter season has surged to 61,968 flights per month, effective from this November," the ministry said, calling it a significant jump from an average of 2,000 transit flights per month during the 2025-2026 season.
"Such an increase will generate substantial financial revenues using Libyan airspace," it added.
Libya slid into chaos after the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in a NATO-backed uprising in 2011. Three years later, a civil war broke out between armed factions vying for power and divided the country between eastern and western administrations.
The war caused damage to up to 20 aircraft, including Airbus (AIR.PA) models, at Tripoli International Airport in 2014.
There are currently few airlines operating flights in and out of Libya, and they have long been limited to destinations such as Tunisia, Jordan, Turkey, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Sudan.
The ICAO's decision would be circulated to all 193 member states for their implementation, the ministry added.

items.title: 米天然ガス大手ＥＱＴ、130億ドルで同業買収　国内最大規模に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sumit Saha

[２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sumit Saha

[２６日 ロイター] - 米天然ガス大手のＥＱＴは２６日、同業レンジ・リソーシズを１３０億ドルの株式交換方式で買収すると発表した。米天然ガス需要が拡大する中、統合により米最大規模の天然ガス生産会社となる見通し。負債を含めた統合後の企業価値は５００億ドルを超える見込みで、取引は２０２７年１─３月期に完了する見込み。

統合後の経営はＥＱＴが主導し、本社も引き続き東部ペンシルベニア州に置く。レンジから最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）ら２人が取締役に加わる。ＥＱＴの株主は統合後の会社の約７３％を、レンジ株主は残り２７％をそれぞれ保有。５年間で計約２００億ドルのフリーキャッシュフローを生むと見込まれる。

米国では、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の輸出増や、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連データセンターからの電力需要の増加が顕著だ。米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、米国内消費量は２５年の日量９１９億立方フィートから２７年に９４３億立方フィートに増える見通し。

ＥＱＴとレンジは、いずれもアパラチア盆地にガス資源を保有する。統合によってＥＱＴの収益力が改善するほか、掘削可能な資源を拡充。電力会社やＬＮＧの輸出業者などへの供給体制を強化する。

レンジの株主は、保有１株につきＥＱＴの０．９８７株を受け取る。ロイターの試算によると、株式価値は１２８億３０００万ドル（１株当たり５４．９１ドル）と、レンジ・リソーシズの２３日の終値に対して約２０．６％のプレミアムが付く。

事情に詳しい関係筋が匿名を条件に語ったところによると、対象となるのは「ＡＩエクスペリエンス」、ＡＩアシスタント「コパイロット」、財務、人事、ゲーム部門「Ｘｂｏｘ」などの従業員で、マーケティング、商業部門、セキュリティーなどの部門の従業員は対象外になるという。

マイクロソフトは、今回の募集は、カナダ、インド、英国、米国の対象チームに属する、レベル７０以下の対象従業員が利用できると説明した。

エイミー・コールマン最高人事責任者は従業員向けの文書で「この募集は、将来的に社外でのキャリアを検討している対象従業員に対し、支援を受けながら今すぐ転身するための新たな選択肢を提供するものだ。また、対象となる部門にとっては、変化するニーズに合わせて人員体制を調整するための新たな手段にもなる」と記した。

マイクロソフトは他のテクノロジー大手と同様、ＡＩ向けのデータセンターや半導体に数千億ドルを投じており、その莫大なコストに見合うだけのリターンが得られるかどうか、投資家の厳しい視線が注がれている。同社は２８日の市場引け後に第1・四半期決算を発表する予定で、２０２６暦年の設備投資額を１７５０億ドルと見込んでいる。

今回の件は、ニュースサイトのビジネス・インサイダーが最初に報じていた。

同社の株価は午後の取引で約１％上昇した。

items.title: Under financial pressure from AI investments, Microsoft offers voluntary severance packages to 60,000 employees, affecting departments such as Xbox and Windows
items.author: 华尔街见闻
items.creator: 华尔街见闻
items.summary: As of the end of June, Microsoft had a total of 223,000 employees worldwide. This latest round of measures involves more than one-quarter of the total workforce, covering departments such as Xbox, Windows, Copilot, and Finance. Positions related to data centers, sales, cybersecurity, and quantum computing are not included. A Microsoft spokesperson stated that the proportion of employees expected to accept the proposal is below 30%. Microsoft is scheduled to release its financial report on Wednesday, and the market is focused on whether its investments in AI have begun to yield quantifiable returns.
items.body: Microsoft is undergoing a rare large-scale voluntary resignation program to reshape its workforce structure, aiming to control costs and raise funds for its extensive investments in AI. According to Bloomberg citing a Microsoft spokesperson, the company will offer voluntary severance packages to approximately 60,000 employees across the United States, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, targeting staff at the vice president level and below. Chief Human Resources Officer Amy Coleman stated in a memo to employees on Monday that this initiative is intended to provide a supportive transition path for employees "considering leaving the company," with compensation comparable to the standard severance package. Microsoft will release its financial report on Wednesday, with the market focused on whether the substantial AI investments have begun to yield measurable returns. As of publication, Microsoft shares were up 1.1% in Tuesday's trading session. Xbox, Windows, and Other Divisions Fully Involved; Data Center Roles Not Included According to Bloomberg citing informed sources, the Xbox, Windows, Copilot, and Finance divisions will be fully involved in this program; however, certain employee groups are excluded, including positions focused on data centers, sales, marketing, cybersecurity, and quantum computing. A Microsoft spokesperson stated that compared to the voluntary severance plan for retirement-age employees introduced in July this year, the company expects the proportion of staff accepting the offer this time to be significantly lower. At that time, among approximately 8,750 eligible employees, over 30% accepted the package. As of the end of June this year, Microsoft’s global headcount stood at 223,000. Since the company began substantial investments in AI and data center construction around 2022, total employee numbers have remained largely steady—indicating that surging AI expenditures have effectively compressed hiring and budgeting for other areas. The “Embrace AI or Leave” Logic Deepens in the Tech Sector This resignation program reflects a clearer strategic direction for talent. A Microsoft spokesperson said the company seeks to retain employees truly committed to tackling critical challenges, aligning closely with public statements from management at other tech companies—where continued employment means accepting a faster work pace and greater demands for change. This trend is not isolated in the industry. After Elon Musk acquired Twitter in 2022, he required employees to choose between “hardcore work” or severance pay. Reports indicate that earlier this year, a Google executive also told team members they could opt for voluntary resignation if they were not “all-in” on AI. Last year, Alphabet, Google’s parent company, launched similar programs across several divisions; Meta Platforms has also reduced its workforce by over 20,000 people since the peak at the end of 2022. Both companies rank among the world’s largest investors in data center infrastructure. How Employees Weigh Choices, and How the Company Provides a Safety Net For employees, whether to accept a voluntary severance package often depends on multiple factors: personal savings, the potential risk of layoffs, the capacity of the current job market, and whether compensation provides a sufficient buffer to achieve a career transition. Compared to involuntary layoffs, voluntary resignation packages are typically more generous and often target higher-paid mid- and senior-level employees. A Microsoft spokesperson added that if certain top talent chooses to accept the package, the company will also attempt to retain them. In the memo, Amy Coleman described this initiative as another tool for business units to “adjust workforce structures to meet evolving demands.” In recent years, Microsoft has undergone several rounds of large-scale layoffs, cutting tens of thousands of positions. This compensation plan, oriented towards voluntary exits, represents a softer yet equally resolute way for the company to transition its human capital to the AI era.

items.summary: India's Tata Motors' takeover bid for Italian truck maker Iveco has cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, reaching 87.8% on the last day of the offer, an Italian stock market filing showed on Monday.
items.body:
India's Tata Motors' (TATM.NS) takeover bid for Italian truck maker Iveco (IVG.MI) has cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, reaching 87.8% on the last day of the offer, an Italian stock market filing showed on Monday.
Tata now holds 89.42% of Iveco's common share capital based on provisional results, both companies said
Final results will be communicated before market opening on October 29
The offer is set to be reopened during November 2-6, Iveco said
The tender offer ending Monday ran from September 7
The offer price was raised to €14.40 per share, from €14.10 per share, on October 9
Tata Motors [USN:L8N3TR2BQ TEXT:"agreed last year"] to buy Iveco's commercial vehicle business in a deal valued at €3.8 billion

items.title: Average price of gasoline during Trump's term now exceeds Biden's, as midterms loom
items.author: Georgina Mccartney
items.creator: Georgina Mccartney
items.summary: Americans have paid more for their gasoline and diesel at the pump on average during President Donald Trump's second term than they did under his Democratic predecessor, Joe Biden, according to the AAA.
items.body:
Americans have paid more for their gasoline and diesel at the pump on average during President Donald Trump's second term than they did under his Democratic predecessor, Joe Biden, according to the AAA.
Surging fuel prices are a major thorn in Trump's side as [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"] loom and the Republican Party looks to defend narrow majorities in both legislative chambers on November 3.
The price of a gallon of regular gasoline has averaged $3.472 since Trump took office almost two years ago, edging out the $3.471-per-gallon average for Biden's term, according to data from the AAA.
Russia's war in Ukraine , now in its fifth year, as well as the US-Israeli war with Iran , almost in its ninth month, have both squeezed global crude and fuel supplies and forced emergency oil releases in the US and Europe.
The war in Iran has spilled out across the Middle East, with much of the conflict centered around the Strait of Hormuz, through which around a fifth of global oil and gas supplies flowed before the war broke out in February.
“Once this conflict comes to an end, gas prices will drop drastically... Thanks to the exceptional work of the US military, more oil is now flowing out of the Persian Gulf than before the Iran conflict began,” said White House spokeswoman Taylor Rogers.
The seven-day moving average for Middle East oil exports including Hormuz flows and Gulf of Oman shipments as well as Red Sea shipments reached 24.6 million barrels per day in the week to October 18, according to Kpler, its highest level since the war broke out in late February, and surpassing pre-war levels.
STICKY INFLATION Sticky inflation makes nominal price comparisons misleading, analysts said, with consumer expectations for inflation over the next year nudged up to 4.7% from 4.6% in September, a [USN:L1N4690PT TEXT:"survey"] showed last week.
Twelve-month inflation expectations have surged from 3.4% in February before the US-Israeli war with Iran started.
"Adjusting for inflation puts this into context as the value of the dollar continues to impact prices over the longer run. Americans are still not paying record amounts of their income on filling up their tanks," said Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, on average fuel prices under Trump surpassing those under Biden.
Trump's approval rating fell to a record low this month as Americans worried about high gasoline prices, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll published on October 19.
Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms, the four-day poll showed. Just 23% of adults polled nationwide approve of his handling of the economy.
Prices for diesel, the fuel that powers the global economy from agriculture and heavy industry to shipping, have also surpassed Biden's national average under Trump, at $4.343 a gallon compared with $4.078 a gallon. US diesel hit a record high on September 22 at $6.523 a gallon.

By Makini Brice and Inti Landauro
PARIS, Oct 26 (Reuters) – French student leaders said the government had offered a package of education proposals on Monday in response to weeks of street protests, but vowed to keep demonstrating as the measures had fallen short of their demands.

Emerging from a meeting with government officials, the students said the proposals included capping the size of some classes, loans for renovating schools and the replacement of a university admissions system they saw as unfair.

“Not all our demands were met. We’ll go on for as long as it takes,” Louis Letoublon, one of the representatives of high school students, said.

Show Full Article

There was no immediate confirmation of the education proposals from the government. A press conference to announce the details was delayed.

There were no immediate details on how much funding any such education package would require. The hands of President Emmanuel Macron’s minority government are tied by national debt approaching 120% of GDP and high new borrowing needs already making it difficult to agree a budget for next year.

The protests, initially triggered by student discontent, have shown little sign of easing after violence nine days ago engulfed dozens of cities, leading to fears the state had lost control of the streets.

The movement has since expanded, drawing in trade unions and “yellow vest” activists, known for their high-visibility jackets and mass demonstrations against economic pressures including high fuel costs.

Earlier, Macron acknowledged it was likely there would be more unrest this weekend ahead of a bigger nationwide day of protests set for November 5.

On a tour to survey the damage in Marseille and to thank emergency services after Saturday’s protests, he said he would keep security measures in place and work to move protests outside city centres.

The unrest and the sense among many French that authorities are struggling to keep the peace have further boosted the poll ratings of far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, already the frontrunner in next year’s presidential election.

An opinion poll published Sunday put her on 32%-33.5%, well ahead of her nearest rival, hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon on 17%. Surveys suggest she would easily defeat Melenchon in a run-off ballot, expected to be held in early May.

FAR-RIGHT GANGS CONFRONT FAR-LEFT ACTIVISTS

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez earlier said 1,435 people were arrested nationwide during demonstrations on Saturday and that police had also recorded a new phenomenon, with organised far-right gangs confronting far-left activists in several cities.

“We knew there had been calls from numerous identity-based and nationalist movements to come out, officially, to defend businesses,” he said. “In a number of cities, such as Nice and Montpellier, these groups arrived in organised formations, mainly to target the ultra-left movement.”

A selloff in French government bonds paused on Monday after the country’s sovereign debt was spared a ratings downgrade on Friday by rating agency Moody’s.

But business leaders said the unrest was continuing to inflict heavy economic damage despite a calmer weekend.

Alain Di Crescenzo, head of the CCI France network of chambers of commerce and industry, said many retailers had remained closed as a precaution after the violence of October 17, adding that sales had fallen by about 80%.

“We have shopkeepers who are tired and demoralised, and we are killing local commerce,” he told Radio Classique.

(Reporting by Sudip Kar-Gupta, Makini Brice and Inti Landauro; Writing by Mark John; Editing by Toby Chopra and Andrew Heavens)

items.title: Apple presenta un nuevo iPad mini más delgado, ligero y resistente al agua: precio y características
items.author: Mark Gurman, Chris Welch
items.summary: El dispositivo incorpora el chip A20 Pro, una pantalla más grande y resistencia al agua y al polvo. Los pedidos anticipados comienzan el miércoles y la venta al público arrancará el 6 de noviembre.
items.body: Bloomberg — Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) presentó este lunes un iPad mini renovado con pantalla OLED, diseño resistente al agua y un chip más rápido, iniciando de esta manera una semana de lanzamientos de productos. Esta tableta, con un precio de US$699, cuenta con una pantalla OLED de 8,5 pulgadas que ofrece negros más profundos, blancos más brillantes y un contraste mejorado. Apple además aumentó el tamaño de la pantalla con respecto a las 8,3 pulgadas anteriores al reducir el grosor de los biseles que rodean el panel. El dispositivo rediseñado también incluye un nuevo sistema de audio denominado Acoustic Display , que ubica los altavoces debajo de la pantalla, lo que contribuye a que este sea el primer iPad con clasificación IP67 de resistencia al polvo y al agua. Ver más: ¿Vale la pena el iPhone Duo? Esto dicen los expertos sobre el primer teléfono plegable de Apple El nuevo iPad mini es un 14% más delgado y un 13% más ligero que el anterior modelo, y Apple ha reubicado la cámara frontal para que resulte más adecuada para las llamadas de FaceTime y las videoconferencias. En su interior, cuenta con el chip A20 Pro, una mejora respecto al procesador A17 Pro del anterior iPad mini, cuyo precio partía en US$599. Se ofrece con opciones de pantalla estándar y con nanotextura mate, así como con configuraciones de almacenamiento que van desde los 128 hasta los 512 gigabytes. Con la configuración máxima de almacenamiento, una pantalla mate grabada y conectividad móvil, la tableta puede llegar a costar hasta los US$1.249. Apple además ha mejorado el nuevo modelo con su chip de red N1, lo que incorpora Wi-Fi 7 y Bluetooth 6 al iPad mini. Los modelos con conexión móvil están equipados con el módem C2 de la compañía. El último iPad mini da comienzo a una serie de lanzamientos de productos de Apple previstos para finales de octubre. A finales de esta semana, la compañías tiene previsto presentar una nueva iMac y una MacBook Pro de 14 pulgadas con el chip M6, antes de cerrar la semana con su primer MacBook Pro con pantalla táctil. Los pedidos por adelantado del nuevo iPad mini comienzan este miércoles y saldrá a la venta el 6 de noviembre. El último modelo está disponible en los colores denominados midnight y starlight . Ver más: Apple se convierte en refugio de Wall Street ante los temores por el gasto en IA El chip A20 Pro del iPad mini se ofrece en dos versiones: los modelos de 128 y 256 gigabytes incluyen cinco núcleos de CPU, mientras que la configuración de gama alta cuenta con seis núcleos. Ambos utilizan siete núcleos gráficos. La variante de gama alta cuenta además con un Neural Engine dual de 16 núcleos para un procesamiento mejorado de la inteligencia artificial. Apple celebrará este miércoles un evento de presentación en Los Ángeles, donde los miembros de la prensa y los creadores de contenidos podrán interactuar con los nuevos dispositivos. Estas presentaciones ponen el broche final a un año repleto de lanzamientos de productos para Apple, incluido el del pasado viernes del iPhone Duo, su primer smartphone plegable. Bloomberg News informó por primera vez sobre el nuevo iPad mini en el 2025. La compañía además está trabajando en un nuevo iPad de gama baja, un iPad Air con pantalla OLED y un iPad Pro renovado para el primer semestre del próximo año. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Now home, Venezuela opposition leader Machado walks tightrope with supporters, Trump
items.author: Mayela Armas, Julia Symmes Cobb
items.creator: Mayela Armas, Julia Symmes Cobb
items.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups.
items.body:
Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado, who returned on Sunday after nearly a year away, will walk a tightrope as she seeks the elections her supporters want without running afoul of a US-backed negotiation process between the interim government and other opposition groups.
Machado's return to Venezuela after [USN:L1N45F02O TEXT:"several failed attempts"] risks [USN:L1N42Y0X4 TEXT:"straining her ties"] with US President Donald Trump's administration. Washington has said she has every right to be in Venezuela, but has praised acting President Delcy Rodriguez and supports a negotiation process between the Rodriguez government and opposition groups that do not include Machado's Vente Venezuela movement.
The talks, which have continued this month, would remake the electoral council and top court ahead of eventual elections. Both bodies are staffed by ruling party loyalists and backed ousted President Nicolas Maduro in a disputed 2024 presidential election, despite tallies published by Machado's movement that showed her candidate had won. The US military captured Maduro in January.
Machado supporters, tens of thousands of whom swarmed her caravan between Barquisimeto and Caracas on Sunday, waving flags, chanting her name and festooning her with rosaries, are [USN:L2N46B03Y TEXT:"eager for elections"] and call her the next president. She has said a presidential vote should happen in 2027.
Machado's team did not respond to a request for comment.
Asked whether Machado would participate in the negotiations, Rodriguez said she hopes the dialogue will lead those who called for sanctions against the country — a common ruling party critique leveled at Machado — to feel remorse. Rodriguez added that the talks offer a chance for all voices to be heard.
“I hope both the dialogue and the program for democratic coexistence and peace can provide a space where all voices can be heard, where voices seeking the good of the country can be heard," the acting president said during a visit to a military hospital in Caracas, where she urged politicians to concentrate on serious issues and not put on a "show."
Though Machado [USN:L4N3W51LU TEXT:"cultivated Trump as an ally"] for years, he said last month it was [USN:L1N44V0SA TEXT:"too soon to consider democratic elections."] On Sunday, Trump said he had been unaware of her return plans, though a person briefed on her movements disputed that.
RISK OF SHORT CIRCUIT WITH WASHINGTON Machado's eagerness for a vote could "short-circuit" the relationship with the US and its three-phase stabilization, recovery and transition plan for Venezuela, said Ricardo Rios, head of Poder y Estrategia, a political risk consultancy.
"The idea (at the negotiations) is to hold a regional election before a presidential election. She will probably push for electoral guarantees and for a presidential election to be held as soon as possible," Rios said.
But much remains to be defined before voters cast ballots.
“What guarantees does the ruling sector have to leave power (if it is defeated)?" Rios asked. "That still needs to be defined in order to make this viable, because otherwise, no matter how popular she is, it complicates matters."
US AND EU URGE DIALOGUE Machado's safe return was a direct outcome of the negotiations, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, a longtime champion of Machado, said on Sunday, adding he expects all political actors to support the talks.
Venezuela's electoral infrastructure was designed to rig elections and so must be quickly replaced before a valid election can be held, he told reporters on Monday. He did not provide an estimated date for elections.
"I think we're making real progress in that regard," Rubio said. "But if anybody tries to derail that process, they're doing a great harm to Venezuela."
The EU echoed that sentiment, saying on Monday authorities and all political actors should advance "an inclusive, Venezuelan-led dialogue towards free and fair elections."
The negotiations will lead to a top court being in place by the end of this year and a new electoral council shortly thereafter, a senior US State Department official said earlier.
"The reception (Machado) got yesterday will only reinforce the tendency to demand instant results," said Phil Gunson, senior analyst for the Andes region at the International Crisis Group think tank. "Not only might that provoke a reaction from government hardliners, but it could — if successful — produce a political rupture instead of a peaceful transition, with inadequate post-electoral guarantees and a potentially ungovernable country."
The opposition included in the talks, led by Dinorah Figuera, a lawmaker elected in 2015 to the last Venezuelan legislative body recognized by the US, said Machado's return was a significant step in the US plan.
“Her role is also tied to how she interprets the signals from the United States, which has called for reconstruction and reconciliation. She has to be an ally in the negotiations," said Oswaldo Ramirez, managing director of ORC Consultores.
"Rubio sent a clear message," he added. “I don’t see her trying to torpedo the negotiations. She can’t stray outside the lines.”

By Edward McAllister and Aleksandar Vasovic
BELGRADE, Oct 26 (Reuters) – By unseating longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic in Sunday’s election, Serbia’s student protest movement did what demonstrators in other European capitals can only dream of. Now, though, comes the gritty business of governing – something neither the students nor their handpicked candidates have any experience of. 

Tens of thousands of people took to the streets across the country to celebrate when Vucic conceded defeat late on Sunday in a historic poll that capped two years of peaceful anti-government protests. 

But as the jubilant crowd lit flares and fireworks, sang and danced, questions lingered: who will emerge from this leaderless movement as prime minister, what exactly will their policies be, and can a bunch of political unknowns with no previous affiliation stick together to shore up the economy, root out graft and juggle complex international relations?

Show Full Article

The answers will determine the political stability of Serbia, the largest economy in the Western Balkans, and its relations with China, Russia, and its largest trading partner, the European Union. 

The students’ victory “is likely to trigger broad institutional and policy changes centred on anti-corruption, the rule of law, and better public services. However, bureaucratic resistance to reforms and the movement’s limited governing experience could make the transition challenging,” Teneo Global Research said in a report on Monday.

WINNERS, BUT CAN THEY STICK TOGETHER?

The protest movement began after 16 people died when a railway station canopy collapsed in the northern city of Novi Sad in 2024 and the student-led demonstrations called for accountability and an end to corruption.

Despite not having a figurehead, the students won widespread support, before choosing 250  academics, lawyers, doctors, actors, farmers and musicians to represent them in the election. 

The movement and some of the top candidates on its list have given some idea of what it stands for, promising a domestic anti-corruption program centred on institutional overhauls.

It does not recognise Kosovo, Serbia’s former southern province which declared independence in 2008, but wants to hold a referendum on Serbia’s accession to the EU, with which relations have frayed in recent years. 

Prominent figures include the head of the students’ candidate list, cardiologist Ilija Srdanovic, former central bank governor Dejan Soskic and Radomir Sajcic, a professor at Belgrade University, who spoke on behalf of the students following their victory. But there is no certainty that any of them will hold a ministerial post, and it remains to be seen whether the candidates can form a cohesive government that can agree on policy long enough to use their comfortable parliamentary majority to enact change. 

“(The student movement created) such a shift in Serbia’s culture; we will just have to see if it lasts,” said Katarina Popovic, also a professor at the University of Belgrade.

“We just hope that there are big goals that can keep them together long enough to deconstruct the system.”

REFORMING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS

Under Serbia’s constitution, the students’ candidates have 90 days to form a government once parliament is convened after the announcement of final results by the state election commission.

Time matters, especially with a budget to pass before year-end amid growing public and private debt levels, while any attempt to end corruption will require an overhaul of the police and intelligence services and judicial reform. 

State institutions require “detoxification” after 14 years of Vucic, said Bozo Prelevic, a Belgrade-based lawyer and former co-minister of the interior. 

Prelevic warned that Vucic’s Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), will pose a strong opposition, and that the new government would have to fight its corner.

Vucic and the SNS repeatedly denied accusations of repression and corruption.

INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS 

In Russia, Serbia’s traditional ally and principal supplier of natural gas, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov praised Vucic, but stopped short of congratulating the students. 

“We respect Russia both as a great power and as our historically important partner and, in many cases, protector,” Student List representative Jovo Bakic, a sociologist and a university lecturer, told Russia’s RT Balkan TV, adding that there would be no change in Serbia’s foreign policy towards Russia, including not introducing sanctions against Moscow. 

Also closely watching is Ukraine, which has been an indirect beneficiary of Serbian weapons in its fight to repel Russia’s four-year-long invasion.

European officials congratulated the students and said they stood ready to help the country in its fight against corruption.

“I am sure (the Student List) will find a way, just as they have so far, to choose someone capable of governing – someone who will have the privilege, but also the immense responsibility, to lead Serbia through these reforms,” said Savo Manojlovic of the student-friendly Move-Change movement. 

(Writing by Edward McAllister; Editing by Kirsten Donovan)

items.title: Cinépolis obtiene préstamo por US$380 millones del IFC y bancos en México
items.author: Italia López
items.summary: La cadena de cines destinará los recursos a la apertura de nuevos cines, la transformación digital y la inversión en contenido local.
items.body: Ciudad de México — Cinépolis, una cadena de cines mexicana, obtuvo un financiamiento de US$380 millones liderado por la Corporación Financiera Internacional (IFC), el brazo del Banco Mundial enfocado al sector privado. Las filiales de BBVA y Scotiabank en México, así como los bancos Banamex y BanBajío, participaron en el préstamo vinculado a la sostenibilidad. Ver más: Sheinbaum hablará con Lula para felicitarlo y retomará relación de Pemex con Petrobras Los recursos se destinarán a la apertura de nuevos cines, la renovación de complejos existentes, la transformación digital y la inversión en contenido audiovisual local, informó el IFC en un comunicado. La expectativa es que estas inversiones generen cientos de empleos directos en la cadena de cines que tiene una plantilla de 34.000 personas en todo el mundo, así como empleos indirectos, principalmente en la cadena de valor de las industrias creativas. El préstamo sin garantía tiene un plazo de siete años y vincula el crecimiento de Cinépolis con metas sociales y ambientales, incluyendo resultados en materia de género y sostenibilidad operativa. Ver más: IFC del Banco Mundial prevé más inversiones en el sector energético de México El CEO de Cinépolis, Alejandro Ramírez, dijo que además de diversificar las fuentes de fondeo de la empresa y extender su perfil de financiamiento, el préstamo les “ayudará a crear oportunidades para los jóvenes y a seguir invirtiendo en contenido local”. De acuerdo con el IFC, se trata del primer financiamiento en su tipo para las industrias creativas de América Latina. Cinépolis, se fundó en 1971 en el estado de Michoacán, y es una de las dos grandes cadenas de cines en México junto a Cinemex, propiedad del magnate Germán Larrea. La empresa opera más de 6.800 pantallas de exhibición en 18 países alrededor de América, Europa y Asia.
