items.title: Soja, café e açúcar caem nas bolsas globais com alta do dólar após eleição no Brasil
items.author: P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel
items.creator: P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel
items.summary: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago chegaram a cair mais de 2% nesta segunda-feira, enquanto o açúcar e o café também despencaram, pressionados pela desvalorização da moeda brasileira em relação ao dólar, após os resultados das eleições no Brasil.
O Brasil é o maior produtor de soja, café e açúcar, enquanto o dólar mais forte frente ao real torna os produtos mais acessíveis para compradores no exterior. A moeda norte-americana mais valorizada também impulsiona vendas de exportadores.
O real brasileiro enfraqueceu perto de 12% em relação ao dólar norte-americano no mercado à vista, quando as negociações no Brasil tiveram início nesta segunda-feira, e a bolsa de valores do país suspendeu as negociações por meio de um mecanismo de segurança de interrupção automática, na esteira da reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
O mercado reverteu o otimismo que se instalou entre os investidores quando o rival de direita, Flávio Bolsonaro, liderou o primeiro turno das eleições no início do mês.
Operadores afirmaram que a surpreendente reviravolta foi particularmente negativa para os futuros de soja dos EUA, concorrentes do Brasil neste mercado.
"Certamente a eleição foi uma surpresa, e isso está ligado à desvalorização da moeda e, consequentemente, à queda nos preços da soja", disse Jack Scoville, vice-presidente e analista de mercado do The Price Futures Group, em Chicago.
"A magnitude do movimento nos preços da soja decorre disso e também exerceu alguma pressão indireta sobre o milho."
O contrato novembro da soja fechou em baixa de 15,25 centavos, cotado a US$12,4125 por bushel.
Os preços da soja também foram pressionados pela chegada da colheita recorde dos EUA ao mercado.
Os contratos futuros de açúcar bruto negociados na bolsa ICE , considerados uma referência global de preços, recuaram 5,6%, para fechar a 19,10 centavos de dólar por libra-peso.
Já os contratos futuros de café arábica na ICE caíram 2,1%, para US$3,0095 por libra-peso, distanciando-se da máxima de seis semanas registrada na quarta-feira, de US$3,1820.
O açúcar refinado terminou em queda de 3,6% para US$515,40 a tonelada, enquanto o café robusta perdeu 1,3% para US$3.201 a tonelada.
Já o milho negociado em Chicago terminou com leve baixa de 1 centavo, a US$4,55 o bushel, pressionado pelo avanço da colheita nos EUA.
O trigo caiu 9 centavos, para US$6,16 o bushel, em meio a uma nova proposta de reabertura segura das exportações de grãos pelo Mar Negro, onde terminais estão limitados por conta da guerra entre Ucrânia e Rússia.
(Por P.J. Huffstutter, May Angel e Marcelo Teixeira)

FAST

NEW YORK: US stocks closed higher on Monday (Oct 26), with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq coming off consecutive weekly declines, as Anthropic's IPO filing helped boost sentiment in AI-related stocks in a week filled with a host of market catalysts.
Anthropic disclosed steep losses and red-hot revenue growth in its filing for a US initial public offering, laying out its ambition to build AI systems capable of reshaping the global economy despite the high costs of developing the technology.
The AI lab is pushing ahead with its listing plans even as a once-lively autumn IPO calendar has slowed, with recent market volatility prompting companies to delay offerings.
Anthropic's filing comes as investors increasingly dissect the potential payoff from massive AI spending and at the start of an eventful week. On tap are the Federal Reserve's policy statement on Wednesday, readings on economic growth and inflation on Thursday and a slew of corporate earnings reports throughout the week.

More than a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings this week, including hyperscalers Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon.com, whose results will be parsed for signs of whether the hefty AI investments are translating into growth.
"Today's all about the Anthropic release, so we're back on a little bit of an optimistic tilt, I would say. But there's a lot in that release. It will be interesting to see how well things are received when they actually come to list," said JP Powers, chief investment officer at RWA Wealth Partners in Boston.
"The risk is maybe a little bit of a whipsaw if things aren't all moving in the same direction. A little optimism today, but who knows what will happen from some of these other releases this week," he said.
According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 gained 53.35 points, or 0.70 per cent, to end at 7,677.03 points, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 214.02 points, or 0.83 per cent, to 26,169.38. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 146.60 points, or 0.28 per cent, to 52,361.76.
Semiconductor and chip-related companies, widely viewed as some of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, helped fuel the gains. The broader Philadelphia chips index was up about 3 per cent on the day but is still down nearly 12 per cent on the month.

Related:

Commentary: PHP vulnerabilities - why the good guys have notched a victory in AI-cybersecurity age

Meta said on Monday it plans to raise up to US$95 billion in equity to fund its AI-related expansion of data centers, cloud computing power and other infrastructure.
The AI trade has come under pressure this month amid concerns that debt-funded spending may become harder to justify in the face of climbing borrowing costs.
The Anthropic filing helped buoy sentiment, however, as neocloud firms, including CoreWeave, erased earlier declines.
Other AI-linked companies, including photonic product makers Lumentum and Coherent, were among the best-performing S&P 500 stocks. The technology index led gains among the 11 major S&P 500 sectors.
Megacap and growth stocks were also mostly higher. Tesla jumped to its highest intraday level in more than three months after Barclays upgraded its rating on the stock to "overweight" from "equal-weight".
Markets are pricing in only a 12.7 per cent chance of a rate hike from the Fed on Wednesday, according to CME FedWatch. But with inflation pressures showing no signs of abating, market participants do not believe the central bank will be on hold for long.
Investors are also bracing for the Nov 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.

Source: Reuters/fs/dy

items.title: Machete-wielding mob attack health workers responding to Ebola in Congo
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Angry youths armed with machetes attacked two community health workers raising awareness about the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, killing one and wounding the other, according to officials and a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, in the latest in a series of attacks fueled by misinformation.
items.body:
Angry youths armed with machetes attacked two community health workers raising awareness about the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, killing one and wounding the other, according to officials and a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, in the latest in a series of attacks fueled by misinformation.
The worker who was killed was an experienced nurse who had worked at the general hospital in the town of Bafwasende in Tshopo province, and was recently tasked with helping to raise awareness about the deadly virus in the local community, where he was a well-known figure, a local official and the memo said.
"We are shocked at how the population turned against this nurse. It is impossible to believe that he was mistaken for a stranger," a local health official told Reuters.
The attack took place on Friday afternoon, when the nurse and a colleague, a teacher also working on community outreach, stopped to check on a lot of land. A group of people building a home next door began to accuse them of spreading the disease by contaminating water.
"Here are the people that are spreading the Ebola virus through people's toilets and rivers!" they shouted, according to the memo shared by a health official.
The angry group was joined by youths wielding machetes and batons, who attacked the pair. The nurse died on the spot before the hospital's emergency services could reach them, the memo said, while the teacher survived.
MISINFORMATION FUELING ATTACK Tshopo is among eight provinces in Congo that are battling a fast-spreading outbreak of the Bundibugyo species of the Ebola virus. Congo's public health institute on Friday reported 9,964 total confirmed cases with around a 48.6% fatality rate since the outbreak was declared in May.
Attacks on [USN:L8N44026Z TEXT:"health workers"] have [USN:L8N43I0HO TEXT:"targeted hospitals"], vehicles and staff involved in the Ebola response, underscoring the challenge of building trust among the population.
The local official said health workers in Bafwasende, where the latest attack took place, are sheltering at the general hospital under police guard, too afraid to go home, while the army also briefly deployed to the area.
"None of the nurses have slept at their homes because they fear for their security," the official added.
Only days earlier, an angry mob attacked another community worker raising awareness about Ebola, and set his house on fire, the memo said.
Reuters previously reported on how [USN:L1N41K0Z7 TEXT:"the rapid spread of health misinformation"] posed a threat to healthcare workers in eastern Congo even before Ebola began to spread, with multiple health workers killed in Tshopo after they were accused of spreading an imaginary disease that caused male genitals to atrophy.
"The killing of a nurse yesterday in Bafwasende is a loss to the Ebola response and an even greater loss to patients," Julien Harneis, the senior United Nations Ebola coordinator, said in a post on X on Sunday.

items.title: ＡＩ銘柄上昇、アンソロピックがＩＰＯ申請書類公開　ナスダック約320ポイント高
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、ＡＩ（人工知能）のインフラ投資が債務に依存しているとの警戒感が強まる中、同関連株が上昇した。ＡＩ開発のアンソロピックが米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類を公開したことが材料となった。

時価総額世界一の半導体大手エヌビディアの株価は３％近く上昇。マイクロソフトとアマゾンも、それぞれ１％近く上げた。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は一時、約３２０ポイント上昇。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３％超上昇した。

アナリストらは、アンソロピックのような巨大ＡＩ専業企業が上場に成功すれば、半導体メーカーや関連インフラ企業など、急成長している同業界の一角に対する市場の評価の仕方が変わる可能性があると指摘している。また、投資家がＡＩ関連の新たな投資先を組み入れようとポートフォリオの再配分を進めれば、一部の大手テクノロジー企業から資金が流出する可能性もある。

オールスプリング・グローバル・インベストメンツのマイケル・スミス氏は「結局のところ、現在ＡＩに投資するということは、話題を集める有名銘柄の先にある機会を探すことだ」と指摘。「現在、ＡＩ分野における魅力的な投資機会は、拡大するインフラ上の懸念を効率的かつ迅速に解決できる中小企業にあるかもしれない」と述べた。

items.title: Serbia's student movement toppled a political giant. Can it now govern the country?
items.author: Edward Mcallister, Aleksandar Vasovic
items.creator: Edward Mcallister, Aleksandar Vasovic
items.summary: Who will emerge from this leaderless movement as prime minister, what exactly will their policies be, and can a bunch of political unknowns with no previous affiliation stick together to shore up the economy, root out graft and juggle complex international relations?
items.body:
By unseating longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic in Sunday's election, Serbia's student protest movement did what demonstrators in other European capitals can only dream of. Now, though, comes the gritty business of governing - something neither the students nor their handpicked candidates have any experience of.
Tens of thousands of people took to the streets across the country [USN:L6N46B0A6 TEXT:"to celebrate"] when Vucic conceded defeat late on Sunday in a historic poll that capped two years of peaceful anti-government protests.
But as the jubilant crowd lit flares and fireworks, sang and danced, questions lingered: who will emerge from this leaderless movement as prime minister, what exactly will their policies be, and can a bunch of political unknowns with no previous affiliation stick together to shore up the economy, root out graft and juggle complex international relations?
The answers will determine the political stability of Serbia, the largest economy in the Western Balkans, and its relations with China, [USN:L6N46C0NO TEXT:"Russia,"] and its largest trading partner, the European Union.
The students' victory "is likely to trigger broad institutional and policy changes centred on anti-corruption, the rule of law, and better public services. However, bureaucratic resistance to reforms and the movement’s limited governing experience could make the transition challenging," Teneo Global Research said in a report on Monday.
WINNERS, BUT CAN THEY STICK TOGETHER? The protest movement began after 16 people died when a railway station canopy collapsed in the northern city of Novi Sad in 2024 and the student-led demonstrations called for accountability and an end to corruption.
Despite not having a figurehead, the students won [USN:L8N4650K6 TEXT:"widespread support,"] before choosing 250 academics, lawyers, doctors, actors, farmers and musicians to represent them in the election.
The movement and some of the top candidates on its list have given [USN:L6N46C0IX TEXT:"some idea of what it stands for,"] promising a domestic anti-corruption program centred on institutional overhauls.
It does not recognise Kosovo, Serbia's former southern province which declared independence in 2008, but wants to hold a referendum on Serbia's accession to the EU, with which relations have frayed in recent years.
Prominent figures include the head of the students' candidate list, cardiologist Ilija Srdanovic, former central bank governor Dejan Soskic and Radomir Sajcic, a professor at Belgrade University, who spoke on behalf of the students following their victory. But there is no certainty that any of them will hold a ministerial post, and it remains to be seen whether the candidates can form a cohesive government that can agree on policy long enough to use their comfortable parliamentary majority to enact change.
"(The student movement created) such a shift in Serbia's culture; we will just have to see if it lasts," said Katarina Popovic, also a professor at the University of Belgrade.
"We just hope that there are big goals that can keep them together long enough to deconstruct the system."
REFORMING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS Under Serbia's constitution, the students' candidates have 90 days to form a government once parliament is convened after the announcement of final results by the state election commission.
Time matters, especially with a budget to pass before year-end amid growing public and private debt levels, while any attempt to end corruption will require an overhaul of the police and intelligence services and [USN:L6N3Z90I6 TEXT:"judicial reform"].
State institutions require "detoxification" after 14 years of Vucic, said Bozo Prelevic, a Belgrade-based lawyer and former co-minister of the interior.
Prelevic warned that Vucic's Serbian Progressive Party (SNS), will pose a strong opposition, and that the new government would have to fight its corner.
Vucic and the SNS repeatedly denied accusations of repression and corruption.
INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS In Russia, Serbia's traditional ally and principal supplier of natural gas, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov praised Vucic, but stopped short of congratulating the students.
"We respect Russia both as a great power and as our historically important partner and, in many cases, protector," Student List representative Jovo Bakic, a sociologist and a university lecturer, told Russia’s RT Balkan TV, adding that there would be no change in Serbia's foreign policy towards Russia, including not introducing sanctions against Moscow.
Also closely watching is Ukraine, which has been an indirect beneficiary of Serbian weapons in its fight to repel Russia's four-year-long invasion.
European officials [USN:L6N46C0NS TEXT:"congratulated the students"] and said they stood ready to help the country in its fight against corruption.
"I am sure (the Student List) will find a way, just as they have so far, to choose someone capable of governing - someone who will have the privilege, but also the immense responsibility, to lead Serbia through these reforms," said Savo Manojlovic of the student-friendly Move-Change movement.

items.title: Anthropic vs OpenAI: How Claude maker’s growth is challenging ChatGPT ahead of IPO
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Anthropic has seen significant revenue growth, reaching $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026. OpenAI continues to expand its business model while generating substantial revenues from its consumer and enterprise offerings. Both companies face financial pressures as they invest heavily in infrastructure and computing power. The competition between Anthropic and OpenAI is primarily driven by their customer acquisition strategies and operational efficiencies.
items.body: Anthropic has emerged as a strong challenger to OpenAI in the race to sell artificial intelligence to businesses, with its revenue rising sharply as demand for its Claude models grows. But investors weighing the two companies must look beyond sales growth to understand which business is better placed to deliver returns.Anthropic, which unveiled its initial public offering filing on Monday, reported revenue of $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026. OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, reported quarterly revenue of $6.7 billion in the second quarter, according to Reuters.The figures suggest Anthropic has built strong momentum in the enterprise market, where companies pay to use AI for software development, data analysis and other business tasks. But the comparison is not straightforward because the two companies account for some sales through cloud partners differently.OpenAI has also been expanding rapidly and remains a major player in the consumer AI market. The competition between the two companies is therefore likely to depend on their ability to attract paying customers, control computing costs and turn revenue growth into cash.Revenue growth favours AnthropicAnthropic’s revenue rose to $4.59 billion in 2025 from $386 million in 2024, according to its IPO filing. Revenue for the first six months of 2026 reached $16.29 billion.The company has benefited from growing demand for Claude, particularly its coding tools, which help software developers write, check and fix code. Its products are also used by businesses seeking to automate work and build AI-powered applications.OpenAI, meanwhile, has expanded beyond ChatGPT into business software, developer tools and AI agents. Reuters reported in October that OpenAI’s annualised revenue run rate for September was close to $50 billion, lower than the nearly $70 billion figure it had previously indicated to investors.An annualised revenue run rate estimates a full year’s revenue by extending a recent period’s sales. It is not the same as revenue actually earned over a year.Also Read: Anthropic IPO: 5 jaw-dropping numbers investors need to know about $1.5 trillion public offerIt should be noted that Anthropic records the full value of certain sales made through cloud marketplaces as revenue and records the platform fees separately. OpenAI does not include some similar cloud-partner sales in its revenue figures.This difference makes it difficult to determine which company has the larger underlying business from headline revenue alone.The profitability questionRapid revenue growth has not removed the financial risks facing either company.Anthropic reported an operating loss of $693 million in the first half of 2026, according to its IPO filing. Its reported net loss was much larger, at $80.7 billion, largely because of a non-cash accounting charge linked to the increased estimated value of bonds that may eventually convert into company shares.The operating loss provides a better indication of the gap between the company’s operating income and expenses during the period, although it does not by itself show how much cash the company generated or used.OpenAI also faces heavy spending requirements. Reuters reported in September, citing a Financial Times report, that the company expected to use about $278 billion in cash between 2026 and 2030 as it invests in computing power and infrastructure.The figures are not directly comparable because they cover different periods and measures. However, they underline the challenge facing both companies: advanced AI requires large investments in computing capacity, data centres, chips and research before the companies can generate sustainable returns.Computing costs and Big Tech dependenceAnthropic depends heavily on Amazon and Google for computing infrastructure and access to business customers. Both companies are also investors in Anthropic and compete with it in AI.Reuters reported that Amazon and Google’s cloud marketplaces accounted for 47% of Anthropic’s sales to customers in 2025. These relationships help Claude reach businesses already using their cloud services, but they also expose Anthropic to dependence on a small number of powerful partners.OpenAI has its own infrastructure requirements and strategic partnerships, including its close relationship with Microsoft. It has also been committing substantial sums to secure computing capacity for future AI development.The companies’ ability to manage these commitments will be important as competition increases. If AI usage grows more slowly than expected, large infrastructure obligations could weigh on cash flow. If demand continues to rise rapidly, access to computing power could become a competitive advantage.Also Read : Anthropic IPO: What should investors consider when valuing the AI company? Aswath Damodaran explainsValuation will determine investor returnsBoth companies are seeking valuations that reflect expectations of enormous future growth.Anthropic has been valued by some investors at around $1.5 trillion in recent discussions, below expectations of about $2 trillion reported earlier. OpenAI has also been linked to a potential valuation exceeding $1.4 trillion in recent fundraising talks, according to Reuters.These are reported private-market valuations and fundraising discussions, not necessarily the final prices at which either company’s shares will be offered to public investorA higher valuation does not automatically mean a company is better placed. Investors must assess how much future growth is already reflected in the price and whether the company can deliver the revenue and profits needed to justify it.Anthropic’s upcoming IPO could provide a useful benchmark for valuing AI businesses. OpenAI’s eventual listing, expected later, could give investors another opportunity to compare the companies using more detailed financial disclosures.Which business is better placed?Anthropic currently has a strong case based on its rapid revenue growth and position in business AI, particularly coding. Its latest disclosures also give investors a clearer view of its operating performance and infrastructure commitments.OpenAI has a broad consumer presence through ChatGPT, a growing enterprise business and significant financial and technology partnerships. Its scale gives it opportunities to sell AI products across a wide range of users and applications.
items.raw_description: Anthropic has seen significant revenue growth, reaching $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026. OpenAI continues to expand its business model while generating substantial revenues from its consumer and enterprise offerings. Both companies face financial pressures as they invest heavily in infrastructure and computing power. The competition between Anthropic and OpenAI is primarily driven by their customer acquisition strategies and operational efficiencies.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２６日　ロイター] - エジプト議会は２６日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃を受けているサウジアラビアの自衛を支援するため、シシ大統領に「あらゆる必要な措置」を講じる権限を認めた。これにより、サウジとフーシ派の紛争にエジプトが直接的に関与する可能性が高まった。

シシ大統領は、サウジから支援要請があった場合にエジプト軍による支援を認めるよう議会に求めていた。ロイターが議会関係者から入手した議会声明によると、出席議員の少なくとも３分の２以上が賛成した。

サウジはエジプトにとって主要な政治・財政支援国で、これまでに数十億ドル規模の支援やエネルギー供給などを実施。エジプトはこれまでも、イランやイランが支援する勢力による湾岸諸国への攻撃をたびたび非難してきた。ただ、サウジ、トルコ、パキスタンの８月に締結した相互防衛協定「メッカ共同防衛協定」には参加しておらず、直接的な軍事行動にも公には加わっていない。

メッカ共同防衛協定を締結したサウジア、トルコ、パキスタンの高官はこの日、イランの首都テヘランでイラン指導部との会合を開いている。

items.title: Anthropic discloses month-long training pause, AI security breaches in IPO filing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic paused training of its next-generation flagship AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four of its AI agents accessed live external computer systems during testing, its initial public offering filing showed on Monday.
items.body:
Anthropic paused training of its next-generation flagship AI model for more than a month over security concerns, while four of its AI agents accessed live external computer systems during testing, its [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"initial public offering filing"] showed on Monday.
The Claude maker said in the filing's risk factors section that it had delayed pre-training of a new "frontier" base model to strengthen safeguards against the theft of model weights and intellectual property.
The disclosure highlights the safety challenges facing developers of increasingly powerful AI models, some of whose creators have warned the technology could eventually escape human control. Rival OpenAI also paused some training earlier this year over safety concerns after its models hacked Hugging Face.
The incidents illustrate how unexpected safety failures could disrupt development and deployment of models central to Anthropic's growth as it prepares for a widely anticipated stock market debut.
Anthropic warned that training pauses could delay revenue and leave it trailing competitors. The company devoted about 94 pages to risk factors, more than in its confidential filing seen by Reuters.
SANDBOX ESCAPE The filing also detailed previously undisclosed [USN:L1N45S0TG TEXT:"safety evaluation"] failures in which four AI models escaped their testing environments and accessed real-world computer systems, with sessions lasting between 10 and 34 hours.
Anthropic said an error during cybersecurity tests with a third-party partner left the testing environment connected to the internet despite instructions that web access be disabled.
In one instance, an early version of the model continued pursuing an impossible evaluation task, discovered a stored password and used it to gain administrator access to a third party's system. It then obtained additional credentials, changed system settings and accessed an individual's personal data. The filing did not identify the external parties involved.
Anthropic said it notified all affected parties and found no evidence that the models had sought to evade human oversight or coordinate with each other. It subsequently suspended certain pre-release cybersecurity evaluations and paused higher-risk reinforcement learning environments.
Separately, the company said on Sunday that Claude had [USN:L2N46B085 TEXT:"bypassed a paywall"] and accessed publicly available aggregate voter counts from the US state of Georgia without human authorization.

FAST

Oct 26 : Microsoft said on Monday it is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, or more than a quarter of its global workforce, as the technology giant looks to contain costs and help fund its massive AI investments.
Staffers across the Windows maker would be eligible for the offers, including those working in AI experiences, Copilot, finance, human resources, Xbox and Windows + Devices, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters, requesting anonymity as the matter was private. Units such as marketing, commercial business and security will be excluded, the source added.
"This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support. It also gives participating organizations another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs," Chief People Officer Amy Coleman said in a staff memo.
Like other tech giants, Microsoft is spending hundreds of billions of dollars on AI data centers and chips, drawing scrutiny from investors over whether the returns will justify the staggering cost. The company, slated to report first-quarter results after markets close on Wednesday, has forecast $175 billion in capital expenditures for the 2026 calendar year.

Microsoft had 223,000 full-time employees globally as of June 30, 2026, according to its annual filing.
Shares of Microsoft, which had risen about 10 per cent this year, were up about 1 per cent on Monday. The development was first reported by Business Insider.
The company earlier this year offered voluntary buyouts to about 7 per cent of its US workforce, or about 9,000 employees.
In July, Microsoft announced it would cut 4,800 jobs, or about 2.1 per cent of its global workforce, overhauling its Xbox gaming business and divesting up to five studios as it looks to boost returns after years of heavy investment in the division.
"This offer will be available to eligible employees in participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States at level 70 and below," Microsoft said on Monday.
The company said it was a time-limited, voluntary program and built on insights gained from a previous voluntary retirement program. The eligible employees will receive details within the next few hours, it added.

Oct 26 (Reuters) – Slovakia will continue to pursue its national interests and develop cooperation with Russia in areas not affected by sanctions, Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanar said on Monday after talks in Moscow with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov.

Blanar was in Moscow as Slovakia aimed to discuss Russian energy supplies while resuming a cooperation process suspended after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

• The restart of consultations follows repeated trips to Moscow by Prime Minister Robert Fico, whose views stand out in the 27-member EU since the defeat of pro-Russian Hungarian leader Viktor Orban in an April election

Show Full Article

• Energy was a main topic of the renewed intergovernmental commission that held talks on Monday, the Slovak Foreign Ministry said, adding that Blanar was informed that Russia remained ready to fulfil agreed contracts

• Slovakia buys Russian oil and gas but is meant to stop the gas purchases by late 2027 under an EU plan to deprive Russia of financial resources that fund its war in Ukraine

• “The Russian Federation is difficult to replace for the stability of energy supplies not only for Slovakia, but also for global energy trade, which is evident now amid the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz,” Blanar said

• “Slovakia is a member of the European Union and NATO and we respect the rules that bind us, but within those we seek opportunities for cooperation in the interest of Slovakia’s national interests,” he added

(Reporting by Jason Hovet in Prague; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria)

items.title: Colombia lanza bonos globales en dólares por 5.200 millones de dólares: IFR
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes bonos en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años por un total de 5.200 millones de dólares, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG.
items.body:
El Gobierno de Colombia lanzó el lunes bonos en dólares a cinco, 10 y 30 años por un total de 5.200 millones de dólares, según un reporte de IFR, un servicio de información financiera de LSEG.
Las emisiones tienen como propósito financiar el presupuesto de gastos del país sudamericano, pero no se informó inmediatamente si se usarán para cubrir necesidades de este año o para 2027.
La oferta considera un bono al 2032 por 2.200 millones de dólares, uno al 2037 por 2.000 millones y otro al 2056 por 1.000 millones, agregó el artículo.
IFR reportó que los bonos a 5 años se ofrecieron con una tasa de 7,05%, los a 10 años con un 7,65% y los a 30 años entre un 8,15%, todos en el extremo inferior de las guías iniciales.
Los agentes colocadores de la operación son BBVA, Itaú y JP Morgan.
Colombia ya había finalizado sus necesidades de financiamiento de este año vía bonos internacionales, pero la semana pasada anunció un recorte de 13,8 billones de pesos (4.326 millones de dólares) en el presupuesto, inferior a los 21,9 billones de pesos que pretendía bajar, lo que supondría necesidad de más recursos.
El presupuesto de 2027 propone colocaciones de deuda pública interna por 150,9 billones de pesos y endeudamiento externo por unos 26.101 millones de dólares vía emisiones en el mercado internacional de capitales y préstamos con los bancos de desarrollo multilaterales y bilaterales.
El presidente Abelardo de La Espriella anunció que en los próximos días enviará al Congreso la denominada “Ley de Rescate Económico”, una iniciativa con la que el Gobierno busca enfrentar los desequilibrios fiscales del próximo año.

items.title: Merck drug extends survival in endometrial cancer trial, wins US priority review
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US health regulator has accepted Merck's experimental targeted drug for a priority review based on data from a late-stage trial where it extended survival in women with an advanced form of endometrial cancer.
items.body:
The US health regulator has accepted Merck's (MRK.N) experimental targeted drug for a priority review based on data from a late-stage trial where it extended survival in women with an advanced form of endometrial cancer.
The drug, sacituzumab tirumotecan, also known as sac-TMT, delivers a cancer-killing payload to cells that carry a protein called TROP2, which is common in endometrial tumors.
The trial enrolled 776 patients whose cancer had returned or progressed after earlier treatment. Patients were randomly assigned to sac-TMT or to a chemotherapy their doctor chose, either doxorubicin or paclitaxel.
Results showed sac-TMT reduced the risk of death by 32%, with patients living a median of 19 months compared with 12.1 months on standard chemotherapy.
The treatment also reduced the risk of cancer progression or death by 41%, with patients remaining progression-free for a median of 7.2 months compared with 3.9 months on chemotherapy. In addition, about 35% of sac-TMT patients saw their tumors shrink, compared with 17% on chemotherapy.
A regulatory decision is expected by June 2027, Merck said. The trial data was presented at the ESMO medical congress.
"Based on discussions with the FDA, the company is hopeful for an approval before the PDUFA date to bring sac-TMT to patients as quickly as possible," said Dean Y. Li, president, Merck Research Laboratories.
Severe treatment-related side effects were more frequent with sac-TMT, affecting about 54% of patients compared with 41% on chemotherapy. About 3% of patients stopped treatment due to side effects.
About 68,000 cases of endometrial cancer are expected to be diagnosed in the United States in 2026, with over 14,000 deaths, according to the American Cancer Society.
Jefferies analysts project peak sales of roughly $900 million in endometrial cancer for the drug and $9 billion across all potential indications.
Merck is developing the drug with Chinese biotech firm Kelun-Biotech (6990.HK) , which discovered the therapy.

Oct 26 : AI-linked stocks rose on Monday after Anthropic revealed the paperwork for its initial public offering, against the backdrop of growing investor unease over debt-fueled spending on infrastructure for the new technology.
Shares of Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, added nearly 3 per cent. Microsoft and Amazon gained nearly 1 per cent each.
A successful flotation by a pure-play AI giant such as Anthropic could reshape how markets value parts of the booming industry, including chipmakers and related infrastructure companies, analysts have said.
It could also divert capital from some tech heavyweights as investors make room in their portfolios for a new way to bet on the technology.

The industry's web of relationships adds another wrinkle, as some of the biggest technology companies are investors in both Anthropic and its chief rival, OpenAI.
Among other AI stocks, battered shares of neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius Group rose 5.7 per cent and 2.3 per cent, respectively, after the filing, reversing earlier losses following SpaceX CEO Elon Musk's comments.
Data center operators Applied Digital and IREN gained 1 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively.
Memory chipmaker Micron rose 3 per cent, and data-storage firms Sandisk, Western Digital and Seagate added about 2.5 per cent each.
AMD and Broadcom gained 2.5 per cent and 3 per cent, respectively. Zoom Communications, an early investor in Anthropic, rose 1.5 per cent.
The broader Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up over 3 per cent.
Focus now shifts to a potential IPO from OpenAI. But while the stakes are high, the long-term impact of the IPOs on the AI trade remains uncertain.
"Ultimately, investing in AI today involves searching for opportunity beyond the headline names," said Michael Smith, head of the growth equity team at Allspring Global Investments.
"Today, attractive investment opportunities in AI may be in small and medium-sized firms that can efficiently and quickly solve growing infrastructure concerns."

items.title: Rendimiento de bonos Tesoro EEUU a 10 años cotiza estable, a la espera de la Fed
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés.
items.body:
El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años cotizó estable el lunes, mientras el mercado espera los resultados de las principales empresas de inteligencia artificial (IA) esta semana y antes de la reunión de la Reserva Federal, que se prevé que haga una pausa en sus alzas de las tasas de interés.
La presentación el lunes por parte de la empresa de IA Anthropic de la documentación para su oferta pública inicial (OPI) impulsó las acciones, y la IA seguirá siendo el centro de atención con las publicaciones de resultados de Microsoft
(MSFT.O) , Alphabet (GOOGL.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) durante la semana.
Los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años se mantuvo en menos del 5%. El jueves pasado, el bono de referencia había anotado su mayor caída diaria de casi cuatro años, en un contexto de desplome las bolsas provocada por el temor sobre la sostenibilidad de la demanda de IA.
"La semana pasada hubo mucha volatilidad", dijo Jim Barnes, director de renta fija de Bryn Mawr Trust.
Los inversores quieren escuchar lo que digan esta semana las empresas relacionadas con la IA para hacerse una idea del gasto futuro, pero también de las perspectivas económicas generales, añadió.
"Esto está empezando a influir en las expectativas de los inversores respecto a los rendimientos de los bonos en el futuro", añadió.
Los inversores también estarán pendientes de la Fed, de la que se espera que mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios cuando anuncie su decisión de política monetaria el miércoles.
Las expectativas del mercado de un alza de tasas han bajado recientemente, en la medida en que los rendimientos se han moderado y los datos económicos han sido dispares. Los futuros sobre tasas de interés descontaban el lunes una probabilidad del 90% de que se mantengan las tasas sin cambios en la reunión de la Fed de esta semana, según CME FedWatch.
El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro a 10 años de referencia cotizaba casi sin cambios en 4,988%, mientras que el de 30 años perdía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 5,3%.
El retorno a dos años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Fed, caía 1,5 puntos básicos, al 4,714%.
Una parte de la curva de rendimientos que mide la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 2 y a 10 años , y que se considera un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 27,2 puntos básicos positivos. El diferencial se redujo a un mínimo de casi un mes.

items.title: アウディＣＥＯの米選挙集会参加に批判、社内規範違反と労組反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン　２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Rachel More　Christina Amann

[ベルリン　２６日　ロイター] - ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）傘下のアウディのデルナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が１１月３日に控える米中間選挙の激戦州である南部ジョージア州で開かれた集会にトランプ米大統領と共に参加したことを受け、労働組合のトップは２６日、社内規範に違反しているとして批判した。

２４日の集会では、アウディによる４０億ドル規模の工場建設計画が発表された。自動車関税措置の影響を避けるため、年間２０万台のスポーツタイプ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）を生産する予定。これに対し、ドイツ最大の産業別労働組合ＩＧメタル会長でＶＷ監査役会に属するベンナー氏は「選挙期間中の政治的中立を求める自社規則に著しく違反している」と指摘した。計画には労働者代表を含むＶＷ監査役会の承認が必要となる。

関係者によると、アウディの経営陣は行動規範に対する例外を承認しており、別の労働組合関係者は反対しなかったものの懸念を表明したという。

トランプ氏はこれまでに極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」への支持を表明。ドイツの政財界の間では懸念が広がっている。ＶＷの第２の株主であるニーダーザクセン州のリース首相は、「選挙集会はこれほどの投資を発表するのにふさわしい場所ではない」とし、デルナー氏が政治的なショーの一環となったことは不適切だとの見方を示した。ＶＷグループのドイツ内の生産拠点は、コスト削減圧力を受け、人員削減などを進めている。

デルナー氏を「ミニ・イーロン・マスク」と称し、政治的言動で物議を醸した米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラのＣＥＯになぞらえる指摘もある。

items.summary: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, mientras que los activos brasileños se hundieron tras la reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva, en el inicio de una semana marcada por la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
items.body:
La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, mientras que los activos brasileños se hundieron tras la reelección del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva, en el inicio de una semana marcada por la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
* Lula logró el domingo un cuarto mandato, algo sin precedentes en Brasil, en un resultado que supuso la primera vez que un candidato que quedó por detrás en la primera vuelta se proclamó vencedor en el balotaje.
* El real brasileño se depreció un 8,36%, a 5,4066 unidades por dólar, tras hundirse más temprano poco más de un 12%, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo se desplomó un 13,43%, su mayor caída diaria desde marzo de 2020.
* La bolsa brasileña detuvo sus operaciones durante 30 minutos después de que el Bovespa cayera un 10% respecto a su cierre anterior, lo que activó el mecanismo de seguridad del mercado, informó en un comunicado B3, el operador bursátil.
* Los mercados prevén que la Fed dejará sin cambios las tasas de interés tras su reunión de política monetaria que concluirá el miércoles, pero ven como altamente probable un incremento en diciembre.
* El índice dólar , que compara a la divisa ante una canasta de seis importantes monedas, avanzaba poco más de un 0,3%.
* El peso mexicano cotizaba al cierre en 18,5588 unidades por dólar, con un alza del 0,49% tras revertir pérdidas de primera hora.
* La posibilidad de que las principales economías suban las tasas reduciría la ventaja de los rendimientos que ofrece México frente al exterior, restando atractivo a las operaciones de carry trade que durante años han canalizado flujos hacia activos locales y respaldaron al peso.
* El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, caía un 0,58%, a 69.475,67 puntos, en contraste con los avances de Wall Street, mientras los inversionistas seguían atentos a la temporada de resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* En Argentina, el peso mayorista se depreció un 0,75% a 1.541 por dólar, tras tocar un mínimo histórico intradiario de 1.542 unidades para la venta, y los bonos en la ronda extrabursátil retrocedieron en promedio un 0,6%.
* El banco central (BCRA) no contabilizó intervención cambiaria, como se preveía, ante reservas provisorias en 50.481 millones de dólares.
* El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) cayó un 2,91% al cierre, luego de derrumbarse más del 6% en los primeros compases de la rueda, contagiado por la bolsa de Brasil.
* El peso chileno , subió un ligero 0,07%, a 992,90/993,20 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , retrocedió un 1,59%, a 10.575,59 unidades.
* El peso colombiano borró pérdidas iniciales y terminó con alza de un 0,48% a 3.130 unidades por dólar, en su tercera sesión de ganancias, mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) caía un 1,87% a 2.492,27 puntos cerca del cierre a la espera de la reunión de política monetaria del banco central de Colombia.
* Según un sondeo de Reuters, el Banco Central colombiano incrementaría su tasa de interés de referencia en su reunión del viernes, en 25 puntos base a un 12,50%, para atajar las crecientes expectativas inflacionarias.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,17% a3,4420/3,4430 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) operaba estable en 1.513,28 puntos.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 26 : Unconventional AI, the US hardware startup that launched less than a year ago with a $4.5 billion valuation, said on Monday that it is buying Israeli chip startup NeuReality for an undisclosed sum in a cash-and-stock deal.
Unconventional AI raised $475 million in December and is led by Naveen Rao, who previously sold chip startup Nervana to Intel for more than $400 million and AI software startup MosaicML to Databricks for $1.3 billion. It is backed by prominent Silicon Valley venture firms Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia, along with Amazon.com founder Jeff Bezos, among others.
Mountain View, California-based Unconventional AI's goal is to develop AI chips that are 1,000 times more energy efficient than current offerings by using concepts from biological systems. The company is focusing on what Rao calls a "dynamical systems" approach, in which simple computing elements interact with simple rules and evolve over time to reach a result, rather than following programmed step-by-step logic as conventional computing chips do.
In an interview, Rao said that when Unconventional AI raised its $475 million war chest of cash, the company expected to take three years in research and development and take five years to develop a product.

But by using AI tools to speed its work, Unconventional AI already has developed its first test chip and is nearing completion of its second, prompting the company to look for an engineering team with experience delivering finished products, Rao said.
Founded in 2019 by Moshe Tanach, formerly of Marvell Technology and Intel, Tzvika Shmueli and Yossi Kasus, NeuReality had already developed several advanced AI chips.
"Things have gone a lot faster than anticipated," Rao told Reuters. "We need people who can go execute and build products and scale them. We built up the research bones and now we've got to build up the production bones." 
Rao, who served on NeuReality's board, said about 40 people will join Unconventional AI as part of the deal, and that Unconventional AI will maintain a presence in Israel.

Source: Reuters

JERUSALEM: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu boasted of his endorsement from Donald Trump on the eve of Israel's election, suggesting the two leaders could restart their war against Iran if he wins, after Trump said they should "finish the job".
"US President Donald Trump has come with a friendship that has never existed before between an Israeli prime minister and an American president. And it is doubtful we will ever have such a friendly president again," Netanyahu said in a televised appearance late on Sunday (Oct 25) night. "He has another two years, and he says he is calling on you to vote for me."
In his own social media post on Sunday, Trump, who launched the Iran war jointly with Netanyahu in February, said: "Vote for Bibi Netanyahu for Prime Minister, we have to finish the job that we started!"
Netanyahu said Trump was willing to take action "that would finally, finally, remove the Iranian threat", but only as long as Netanyahu himself remains in power.

"And I have already instructed the Mossad and the IDF to bring down this regime, to bring down this regime because that is the only way to put an end to this threat," Netanyahu said, referring to Israel's main intelligence service and military.
Asked for comment on Netanyahu 's remarks, White House Deputy Press Secretary Anna Kelly said: “As President Trump stated, Iran is in very bad condition, both economically and militarily, and the blockade will remain in full force and effect, with oil flowing in record numbers of barrels through the Hormuz Strait."
"The United States will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the midterm elections," Kelly added via email, referring to the Nov 3 vote in the US.
Netanyahu's leading opponent, centrist former military Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot, posted his own comments on social media, praising Trump as "a true friend of Israel".
"I value his efforts and his commitment to Israel’s security, and I am confident that he will work in full cooperation with any leader chosen by the people."

Also read:

Billionaire Trump backer says Ben-Gvir, Smotrich should not serve in next Israeli government

Netanyahu says 'toppling' Iran government only way to end threat

EISENKOT ACCUSES NETANYAHU OF FEAR-MONGERING Tuesday's vote, Israel's first since the Oct 7, 2023, Hamas attacks, is the first chance for voters to deliver a verdict on the worst security failure in generations and the wars on multiple fronts that followed.
With Netanyahu already at the helm of the most right-wing government in Israeli history, politics have shifted even further to the right. Nearly all Jewish-led parties, including that of the hawkish Eisenkot, now oppose the "two-state solution" that underpinned decades of peace negotiations with the Palestinians.
But many voters say the divisive politics of Israel's longest-serving leader make the country weaker. Polls suggest Netanyahu's Likud Party will lose seats, potentially depriving his coalition of right-wing, far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties of its narrow majority.
Eisenkot and an array of opposition parties ranging from the rump of the centre-left to the right, also have no clear path to unseat him.
Netanyahu, 77, is an unrivalled master of political survival: the only time since 2009 that opponents managed to wrest him briefly from the premiership, it took four inconclusive elections within two years to get him out. He was back 18 months later.
Neither side planned major public events for Monday. But both posted on social media, drumming on the election's major themes — for Netanyahu, that he is the only leader with the mettle to face down Israel's enemies; for his opponents, that his divisive politics have weakened the country.
Netanyahu shared an AI-generated video on Monday of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, whose father Ali Khamenei was killed on the first night of US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February. Lying in a hospital bed, the younger Khamenei says his own vote would be "definitely not Bibi. Another term like this and I will be meeting my father sooner than expected".
On Sunday, Netanyahu posted a computer-generated photo of a mushroom cloud over Tel Aviv, saying Israel was in existential danger from Iran.
Eisenkot responded by accusing him of "relying on a campaign of fear-mongering, lies, and threats — including images of nuclear bombs in the heart of Tel Aviv. This time, it won’t work for him."
Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu carries its own political risks a week before a legislative election in which his own Republicans are seeking to hold onto power.
The Iran war is deeply unpopular in the United States, blamed for a surge in prices, especially for fuel. Major fighting has been suspended for months after ceasefire negotiations held without Israeli participation.

Source: Reuters/fh

items.title: ネオクラウド関連株下落、マスク氏が業界の「再編・破綻」予測
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - ２６日の米国株式市場で、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスに特化した「ネオクラウド」企業の株価が下落した。宇宙企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が、同業界は大幅な再編や倒産に直面する可能性があると発言したことを受け、ＡＩインフラ投資と収益創出の間に広がる格差への懸念が強まった。

午前の取引で一時、ネオクラウド企業のコアウィーブは１．６％下落。ネビウス・グループは４％、アプライド・デジタルは２％、それぞれ下落した。 

マスク氏は２５日、債務市場では「ＡＩデータセンター以外から多額の収入を得ていない企業は、資金調達の道をほぼ完全に閉ざされている」と指摘。このため、「ネオクラウド」企業の間で大規模な再編や経営破綻が起きると予測した上で、スペースＸがネオクラウド企業を買収することはないとし、「無意味だ」と述べた。

グレートヒル・キャピタル会長のトーマス・ヘイズ氏は「マスク氏は正しい。これらのプロジェクトを今後進めるための資金を賄うには、別の収益・利益源が必要になるだろう。資本コストが高すぎて魅力的なリターンを得ることは難しい」と語った。

コアウィーブの広報担当者はロイターへの電子メールで、同社は「差別化された技術」といった強みに支えられ、成長資金を調達する機会を引き続き見いだしていると述べた。

items.title: Wall Street cierra en alza ya que solicitud de OPI de Anthropic impulsa acciones de IA
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA).
items.body:
Wall Street avanzó el lunes, y tanto el S&P 500 como el Nasdaq se recuperaron tras anotar caídas semanales consecutivas, ya que la solicitud de una oferta pública inicial (OPI) de Anthropic impulsó el optimismo en torno a las acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial (IA).
Anthropic reveló pérdidas considerables y un crecimiento vertiginoso de los ingresos en su solicitud de salida a bolsa en Estados Unidos, en la que expuso su ambición de crear sistemas de inteligencia artificial capaces de transformar la economía mundial a pesar de los altos costos que conlleva el desarrollo de la tecnología.
El laboratorio de IA sigue adelante con sus planes de salida a bolsa a pesar de que el calendario de ofertas, que en otoño boreal solía estar repleto, se ha reducido, ya que la volatilidad del mercado ha llevado a las empresas a retrasar sus ofertas.
La presentación de Anthropic se produce en un momento en que los inversores analizan con mayor detenimiento el posible retorno de las inversiones masivas en IA, justo al inicio de una semana intensa. Entre los eventos clave destacan el comunicado de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal el miércoles, los datos sobre crecimiento económico e inflación el jueves, y una serie de informes de resultados corporativos.
Más de un tercio de las empresas que integran el índice S&P 500 tienen previsto presentar sus resultados esta semana, incluidas las grandes compañías tecnológicas Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) . Sus cifras serán examinadas minuciosamente en busca de señales que indiquen si las cuantiosas inversiones en IA se están traduciendo efectivamente en crecimiento.
Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 53,35 puntos, O un 0,70%, a 7.677,03 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 214,02 puntos, o un 0,83%, a 26.169,38 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 146,60 puntos, o un 0,28%, a 52.361,76 unidades.
Las firmas de semiconductores y chips, consideradas por muchos como algunas de las grandes beneficiadas del auge de la IA, contribuyeron a impulsar las subidas. El índice general de chips de Filadelfia (.SOX) escaló cera de un 3% en la sesión, aunque acumula una baja del 12% en el mes.
Meta anunció el lunes que tiene previsto conseguir 95.000 millones de dólares de capital para financiar centros de datos, capacidad de computación en la nube y otras infraestructuras.

items.title: Jefa del árbitro electoral de México renuncia en medio de investigaciones por corrupción
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La presidenta del árbitro electoral de México, Guadalupe Taddei, presentó el lunes su renuncia al cargo en medio de investigaciones por presunta corrupción, una decisión respaldada por la mandataria, Claudia Sheinbaum, quien descartó que el organismo atraviese una crisis de cara a las elecciones intermedias del próximo año.
items.body:
La presidenta del árbitro electoral de México, Guadalupe Taddei, presentó el lunes su renuncia al cargo en medio de investigaciones por presunta corrupción, una decisión respaldada por la mandataria, Claudia Sheinbaum, quien descartó que el organismo atraviese una crisis de cara a las elecciones intermedias del próximo año.
Taddei, quien asumió el cargo en abril de 2023, anunció su decisión de separarse del cargo asegurando que respondía a la necesidad de proteger la estabilidad, la credibilidad y la independencia del Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE).
Su salida es la más significativa por un caso ligado a corrupción durante la gestión de Sheinbaum, iniciada en octubre de 2024. Además, plantea dudas sobre la credibilidad y el liderazgo de la autoridad electoral, luego de que los legisladores rechazaran a principios del año el intento más amplio de Sheinbaum de [USN:L1N3ZZ1D0 TEXT:"reformar el sistema electoral"]. Posteriormente, el Congreso, de mayoría oficialista, respaldó un paquete de cambios electorales más limitado.
"No podía haber esta sombra de conflicto de interés, qué bueno que ella tomó esta decisión de separarse", dijo la mandataria el lunes en su habitual rueda de prensa matutina, y pidió esperar al resultado de las investigaciones sobre el caso. También desmintió que la renuncia implique una crisis política, al ser cuestionada por un reportero por el hecho de que sea la primera vez que la persona al frente del INE dimite en medio de un proceso electoral.
México celebrará en junio de 2027 elecciones para renovar la Cámara de Diputados y más de la mitad de gubernaturas, en una contienda que servirá como prueba clave de la fuerza del partido oficialista Morena y la oposición, y que podría redefinir el equilibrio político rumbo a la sucesión presidencial de 2030. Además, son los primeros comicios bajo el mandato de Sheinbaum.
CREDIBILIDAD DEL INE, BAJO ESCRUTINIO Según varios reportes publicados en medios de comunicación en las últimas semanas, Taddei habría favorecido con contratos millonarios a un proveedor del INE con el que tiene una relación personal. Además, las autoridades investigan por presunto fraude varios convenios firmados por otros funcionarios del instituto electoral en los que habría habido conflicto de interés.
"Con la convicción de que el Instituto (INE) y sus responsabilidades constitucionales deben prevalecer por encima de cualquier interés personal, presento ante la Cámara de Diputados mi renuncia, con efectos a partir del día de hoy", escribió Taddei en una misiva enviada la tarde del lunes a la cámara baja. "Me retiro con serenidad, con la satisfacción del deber cumplido", agregó.
Varios miembros de su familia han ocupado u ocupan puestos de distinta responsabilidad en gobiernos de la Cuarta Transformación, como se denomina al movimiento político al que pertenecen Sheinbaum y el expresidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador, quien durante su gestión impulsó la aprobación de una reforma constitucional para tipificar casos de corrupción como el de Taddei -señalada de ejercicio abusivo de funciones- como delito grave en el código penal, lo que puede implicar prisión preventiva para la funcionaria.
"Se espera que las elecciones de 2027 sean muy disputadas y la credibilidad de INE es fundamental para evitar conflictos. Por eso, la salida de Taddei es una corrección necesaria y oportuna", opinó Antonio Ocaranza, consultor y exvocero el presidente Ernesto Zedillo (1994-2000).
"Ya son muchos casos de familias políticas cercanas a Morena acusadas de corrupción y el Gobierno ha dado pocas deseos de investigarlos y castigarlos. Este será otro reto de credibilidad para el gobierno de la presidenta Sheinbaum", agregó.
Tras recibir la renuncia de Taddei, la Cámara de Diputados inició la tarde del lunes el proceso para nombrar a su sucesor, un procedimiento que suele durar entre cuatro y cinco semanas y durante el cual el organismo será encabezado de manera provisional por uno de los consejeros del instituto.
El lunes, la oposición aseguró que la sucesora de Taddei debería ser mujer y no estar ligada a Morena.
"No puede utilizarse esta crisis para imponer a otro perfil cercano al gobierno de Morena, ni siquiera en la designación de quien asuma la Presidencia de manera provisional", dijo Alejandro Moreno, presidente del partido opositor PRI. "México no puede llegar a las elecciones de 2027 con un árbitro electoral cuya imparcialidad esté seriamente cuestionada", agregó.

items.body:
[東京 ２６日 ロイター] - 日本の外務省は２６日、ロシアに拘束された北海道新聞記者に在ロシア日本大使館の職員が領事面会したと発表した。健康状態に問題はないという。

領事面会は、在外公館の領事官が外国で拘束された自国民と直接面会して状態を確認すること。

北海道新聞の記者は１３日にユジノサハリンスクで拘束され、その後にモスクワへ移送された。日本側は外務省の中村仁威欧州局長がロシアを訪れるなどして領事面会を働きかけたが、実現していなかった。

items.title: Mercados argentinos se derrumban tras resultado electoral en Brasil
items.author: Hernan Nessi, Jorge Otaola
items.creator: Hernan Nessi, Jorge Otaola
items.summary: La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado triunfo del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo.
items.body:
La plaza financiera argentina se desplomó de manera generalizada el lunes acompañando el retroceso en los mercados de su principal socio económico, Brasil, luego de que se confirmara el inesperado [USN:L2N46C00P TEXT:"triunfo"] del socialista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones presidenciales del domingo.
La mayoría de los analistas y operadores de Argentina daban por descontada una victoria del libertario Flávio Bolsonaro, afín ideológicamente al mandatario argentino Javier Milei.
El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa porteña cayó un fuerte 2,91% al cierre, luego de derrumbarse más del 6% en la primera parte operativa, mientras que su par brasileño Bovespa (.BVSP) llegó a hundirme [USN:L2N46C0JZ TEXT:"más de un 17%."]
La devaluación del real, moneda de Brasil, tiende a complicar la competitividad de la propia economía argentina.
"El sorprendente resultado electoral no solo es una mala noticia para el mercado brasileño. El efecto contagio también afecta al Merval y bonos soberanos argentinos", expresó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.
"Por el lado macro, un real más débil pone presión al dólar al apreciar el tipo de cambio real multilateral", agregó.
Al respecto, el peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,75% a 1.541 por dólar, tras tocar un mínimo histórico intradiario de 1.542 unidades para la venta, y los bonos en la ronda extrabursátil retrocedieron en promedio un 0,6%.
El banco central (BCRA) no contabilizó intervención cambiaria, como se preveía, ante reservas provisorias en 50.481 millones de dólares.
El riesgo país argentino saltaba a los 755 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), un nivel similar al registrado a fines de octubre del 2025.
"Brasil se encamina a una dura jornada financiera (... con) marcada debilidad en la renta fija y una fuerte depreciación del real. Los mercados deberán desarmar las expectativas generadas por un posible triunfo de Bolsonaro y absorber un nuevo 'cisne negro': un hecho poco probable, pero de gran impacto", dijo el economista Gustavo Ber.
"El contagio de dicho malhumor sobre los activos argentinos parece irreversible y que podría ser también importante (...) en un mundo que afrontará sucesivas elecciones relevantes en los próximos meses -entre ellas, en Israel, Estados Unidos y Francia-, la lección para los inversores vuelve a ser que todo pronóstico puede fallar", agregó.
Argentina celebrará comicios presidenciales en 2027, donde Milei buscará su reelección.

items.body:
Steven Scheer　Emily Rose

[エルサレム ２６日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は、総選挙を翌日に控え、トランプ米大統領からの支持を誇示した。また、トランプ氏が両首脳で「任務を完遂」すべきだと発言したことを受け、自身が勝利すればイランに対する戦争を再開する可能性があることを示唆した。

ネタニヤフ氏は２５日に出演したテレビ番組で「トランプ大統領は、イスラエルの首相と米大統領の間でかつてないほどの友好関係を築いてくれた。これほど友好的な大統領が再び現れることはまずないだろう」とし、トランプ大統領には「あと２年の任期があり、私に投票するよう皆さんに呼びかけている」と語った。

ネタニヤフ氏は、トランプ氏が「イランの脅威をついに排除する」ための行動を取る用意があると述べたが、それはネタニヤフ氏自身が権力の座にとどまる場合に限ると指摘。「私はすでに（イスラエル情報機関 ）モサドと（イスラエル国防軍）ＩＤＦに対し、この政権を打倒するよう指示を出している。それがこの脅威に終止符を打つ唯一の方法だからだ」と述べた。

ネタニヤフ氏の発言についてコメントを求められたホワイトハウスのケリー副報道官は電子メールで、「トランプ大統領が述べた通り、イランは経済的にも軍事的にも非常に厳しい状況にあり、ホルムズ海峡の封鎖は引き続き全面的に効力をもつ」と指摘。その上で、米国が１１月３日の中間選挙前に「イランを攻撃することはない」と述べた。

トランプ氏は１０月１８日にネタニヤフ氏を支持すると述べ、２５日には自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で改めて支持を表明した。２６日に記者団から、ネタニヤフ氏が２度目の支持表明を要請したのかと問われたトランプ氏は、「私はそれについて話したことは一度もない」と回答。「２度の支持表明は私が自ら出したものだ。ネタニヤフ氏は非常に困難な状況下で首相として非常によくやってきたと思う」と述べた。

ネタニヤフ氏の最有力の対抗馬である中道派で元軍制服組トップのガディ・アイゼンコット氏もＳＮＳへの投稿で、トランプ氏を「イスラエルの真の友人」と称賛。「私は（トランプ氏の）努力とイスラエルの安全保障に対する献身を評価している。トランプ氏が国民によって選ばれたいかなる指導者とも全面的に協力して取り組むと確信している」と述べた。

２７日に実施されるイスラエル総選挙は、２０２３年１０月７日のイスラム組織ハマスによる攻撃以降初となり、有権者が数世代にわたる安全保障上の失敗と、それに続く複数の戦線での戦争について審判を下す最初の機会となる。

items.title: Anthropic IPO: Rising costs, risks, rapid growth mark AI frontrunner
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Anthropic, established by ex OpenAI researchers, is gearing up for an anticipated entry into the stock market in the United States. The organization has impressively generated $16.29 billion in revenue during the first half of 2026. Yet, significant operational losses due to soaring computing costs pose a challenge, along with over $500 billion in cloud computing commitments. Competing against OpenAI and Google, they must adeptly maneuver through a tough economic environment.
items.body: Anthropic’s US IPO filing puts a fresh spotlight on the high cost of staying ahead in artificial intelligence, with the Claude maker showing explosive revenue growth while taking on enormous spending commitments and widening losses, according to Reuters.The company unveiled its IPO paperwork on Monday after confidentially filing in June.Revenue surges, but losses remain steepFounded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers Dario and Daniela Amodei, Anthropic has built a strong position in the AI race through its Claude models, particularly in coding and enterprise applications.The company's revenue surged to $4.59 billion in 2025 from $386 million in 2024 and $41 million in 2023. It then more than tripled to $16.29 billion in the first six months of 2026. But the rapid expansion is proving expensive. Anthropic recorded an operating loss of $693 million in the first half of 2026, after losing $8.06 billion in 2025, compared with $2.98 billion a year earlier, Reuters reported.Compute race comes with billion dollar commitmentsComputing power is at the heart of Anthropic’s cost structure, with the company spending on cloud services, data centres, equipment leases and energy.It has committed more than $500 billion with six partners over a decade, including at least $110 billion with Amazon, about $114.5 billion with Google and $44.9 billion with Microsoft for cloud computing over the next seven to 10 years.That spending also reflects the increasingly interconnected nature of AI financing. Amazon and Google are among Anthropic’s biggest backers. Amazon has invested at least $13 billion and agreed to invest up to another $20 billion, while Google has committed up to $40 billion.Anthropic will retain a governance structure that gives its founders significant control after the listing. As a public benefit corporation, it is also required to balance investor interests with its broader mission of developing AI for the benefit of humanity.Competition is intensifying as OpenAI, Google and Elon Musk’s SpaceX pour billions into models, data centres and specialised chips. Ramp data showed Anthropic accounted for 60.1% of AI token spending in the week ended October 11, highlighting the momentum behind Claude as the IPO brings its spending model under greater investor scrutiny, Reuters reported.

items.title: Anthropic's top investors include Amazon, Google, Fidelity Management
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic is preparing for its initial public offering, supported by significant investments from Amazon and Google. The company's valuation has increased significantly through numerous funding rounds over recent periods. Key investors like ICONIQ Capital and Coatue Management have also expressed confidence in its potential. Anthropic's partnerships with technology leaders enhance its resources for advancing AI development.
items.body: Anthropic is gearing up for its initial public offering, showcasing robust support from heavyweight investors like Amazon and Google. The company’s valuation has surged through various funding rounds, signaling considerable confidence from the investment community. Collaborations with technology leaders provide vital resources essential for advancing AI development and infrastructure. Notable financial participants include ICONIQ Capital, Coatue Management, and Eric Schmidt, among several others.Only a few startups have attracted as much investor conviction as Anthropic. Backed by some of the biggest names in technology and finance, the AI company has seen its valuation soar through successive funding rounds. Its initial public offering now offers a closely watched test of whether investors beyond Silicon Valley share that enthusiasm for the leaders of the AI boom.Here's a look at the key investors backing the Claude maker: Amazon Amazon has invested at least $13 billion in Anthropic and in April agreed to invest up to an additional $20 billion. Anthropic also committed to spend more than $100 billion on the e-commerce giant's cloud services over 10 years.Alphabet's Google Google has committed up to $40 billion to Anthropic, including an initial $10 billion investment announced in April.The partnership provides Anthropic with cloud infrastructure and access to Google's AI chips, which are used to train and run Claude models.Spark Capital Spark Capital led Anthropic's $450 million Series C round in May 2023 and gained board representation through general partner Yasmin Razavi.Lightspeed Venture Lightspeed led the $3.5 billion Series Partners E round in March 2025 and later co-led the $13 billion Series F round at a $183 billion valuation in September that year.Fidelity Management Fidelity participated in Series E and & Research co-led the $13 billion Series F financing at a $183 billion valuation.The firm's other investments include Databricks and CoreWeave.Salesforce Ventures Salesforce Ventures participated in the $450 million Series C round and the $3.5 billion Series E financing. The software firm's venture arm has also invested in firms such as Cohere and Chainguard.ICONIQ Capital ICONIQ led the $13 billion Series F round at a $183 billion valuation and later co-led the $30 billion Series G financing.The venture capital firm's investments include OpenAI and smart ring maker Oura.GIC SingaporeGIC Singapore's sovereign wealth fund led the $30 billion Series G round at a $380 billion valuation. GIC has also invested in AI voice generation startup ElevenLabs.Coatue Management Coatue led the $30 billion Series G financing and later co-led the $65 billion Series H round.The investment firm has also financed companies such as Canva and CoreWeave.D1 Capital Partners D1 Capital invested across multiple large financings including Series E, Series F, Series G and Series H. The firm has holdings in Cognition AI and SpaceX.Sequoia Capital Sequoia was a significant investor in Series G and became one of the lead investors in the $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion valuation. Altimeter Capital Altimeter invested in the September 2025 $13 billion fundraise and was a lead investor in the $65 billion Series H financing at a $965 billion valuation.Jaan Tallinn Skype co-founder Tallinn led Anthropic's first institutional financing, a $124 million Series A round in 2021.The angel investor has also funded open-source AI startup Zyphra and Rain AI.Eric Schmidt The former Google chief executive has backed Anthropic personally and is among the company's best-known individual investors. Schmidt has also funded Yann LeCun's Advanced Machine Intelligence Menlo Ventures Menlo participated in major late-stage financings, including the $3.5 billion Series E round at a $61.5 billion valuation.

items.title: 米メタ、最大950億ドル調達へ　ＡＩ投資で過去最大級
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jaspreet Singh

[２６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Jaspreet Singh

[２６日　ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは２６日、ＡＩ（人工知能）向けデータセンターやクラウドコンピューティングの拡充などに伴う巨額の費用を賄うため、最大９５０億ドルの資本調達を実施する計画を発表した。

普通株と優先株による約３５０億ドルの公募を開始した。これとは別に、最大６００億ドル規模の株式売却プログラムを導入する計画も明らかにした。

同プログラムの実施時期や条件は未定だが、無議決権のクラスＣ株の取引開始後に実施する見通し。

メタはすでに、２０２７年１月に議決権のない新たなクラスＣ普通株を発行することを発表している。

今回の計画は、ＡＩ企業による調達としても最大級となる。エヌビディア、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）、ブロードコムが、クラスＡ株を合計で最大５０億ドル購入することに関心を示している。

メタはオープンＡＩやアンソロピックとの競争力を高めるため、半導体やデータセンターに巨額の資金を投じている。

ウィリアム・ブレアのアナリストらはリポートで「投資家は今回の資金調達と、今後さらに資本調達を行う可能性について引き続き疑問を抱くだろう」と指摘。「総じて今回の資金調達は、ＡＩ投資の長期的な収益に対するメタの自信と、その機会を追求するために必要な資本がますます膨らんでいることの両方を改めて示していると考える」と記した。

今回の資金調達は、大手テクノロジー企業がＡＩインフラを拡充するため、従来の手元資金に頼った投資から、債券市場での調達や株式発行を活用する方向へ一段と転換していることを浮き彫りにした。

＜ＡＩ投資で資金流出＞

メタは将来の支出として約８２５０億ドルを計画している。主にデータセンターやＡＩ関連インフラ、クラウドコンピューティング能力への投資拡大に伴うものだ。

ただ、積極的な事業拡大によって、従来は潤沢だったフリーキャッシュフローが圧迫されている。

第３・四半期は２１億２０００万ドルの資金流出となり、フリーキャッシュフローは１０年以上ぶりにマイナスに転じた。前年同期は１０６億３０００万ドルのプラスだった。

それでも、消費者向けＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」が早期に人気を集めたことや、競争力のある新たなＡＩモデル群を公開したことは、メタの積極投資をある程度正当化する材料となっている。

ウィリアム・ブレアのアナリストらは「メタは最終的に収益性の高いＡＩ事業を構築し、その長期的な収益が事業の多角化に寄与すると考える。ただし、そこに至る道のりは一本道ではないかもしれない」と指摘した。

items.title: スペースＸ、ＡＩ半導体でアポロ関連会社とリース契約　約400億ドル規模
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２６日 ロイター] - 米宇宙関連企業スペースＸは２６日、資産運用会社アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントの関連会社が人工知能（ＡＩ）向け半導体とサーバー機器を購入し、同社にリースする契約を締結したと明らかにした。同取引の元本総額は約４００億ドルに上る。

規制当局への提出書類によると、各リース契約は機器が到着した日から５年強の期間となる。

今回の契約は、月や火星などへの飛行を目指す野心的な計画の資金を賄うために、急増する計算能力への需要の取り込みを図るスペースＸの巨額の支出を浮き彫りにしている。

同社は年内の契約締結を目指しており、リースは半導体が納入され次第、２０２７年上期に開始される見通しだ。

同社のイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、Ｘへの投稿で、画像処理装置（ＧＰＵ）の購入に向けた４００億ドルの債務による資金調達を完了したと説明。これは主に（２７年）第１・四半期および第２・四半期に納入されるＧＰＵの購入に向けた早期償還可能な債務であり、この四半期（２６年第４・四半期）に大きな影響を与えるものではないと述べていた。

items.title: US stocks today: US stocks rise as Anthropic IPO puts AI spending under scrutiny
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Wall Street's main indexes experienced gains as technology stocks led the rise amid AI investment discussions. Investors are preparing for a busy week of corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's decision on interest rates. Anthropic's IPO filing highlights both the demand for AI and associated development costs, creating investor caution. Chip stocks, benefiting from the AI boom, showed strong performance overall.
items.body: Wall Street's main indexes rose on Monday as investors weighed Anthropic's plans for a US listing against growing questions over whether massive AI investments can deliver sustainable returns. Technology stocks led the gains, while investors also looked ahead to a busy week of corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, Reuters reported.The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.45%, the S&P 500 gained 0.57% and the Nasdaq Composite advanced 0.46% in early trading.Anthropic filing puts AI spending back in focusAnthropic disclosed steep losses alongside rapid revenue growth in its IPO filing, highlighting both the scale of demand for AI and the heavy costs involved in developing the technology, according to Reuters.The filing comes as investors are becoming more selective about AI spending. About a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings this week, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon. Their results are expected to provide clues on whether large investments in AI are translating into stronger growth, Reuters reported. It's a challenging environment, to say the least exactly when this IPO will take place, but there's a lot riding on not only the company, but the AI industry, said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth in Fairfield.The concerns have already weighed on some AI linked companies. Neocloud firms CoreWeave and Nebius fell after Elon Musk said markets have almost entirely shut off access to money for companies without substantial revenue independent of AI data centers, and predicted consolidation in the sector, Reuters reported.Tesla jumps while Fed decision loomsChip stocks, among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, were among the strongest performers, with the Philadelphia semiconductor index rising about 1%, Reuters reported.Tesla gained 5.9% to a more than three month high after Barclays upgraded the stock to overweight from equal weight .Investors are also positioning for the Fed's policy decision on Wednesday, with a pause widely expected following its September rate hike. Attention will then turn to September's Personal Consumption Expenditures inflation data and third quarter GDP, both due Thursday, according to Reuters.Crude oil prices eased after reaching a near six month high last week, while investors continued to monitor efforts to de escalate regional tensions. (Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

FAST

Oct 26 : Anthropic unveiled its US initial public offering paperwork on Monday, setting up for a blockbuster market debut that would test investors' willingness to fund the AI juggernaut's bills amid growing worries over the massive debt-fueled spending.
The company had submitted a confidential filing in June. In the recent weeks, exclusive reporting from Reuters highlighted its sweeping AI ambitions, mounting costs and concerns about the "existential risks to humanity" that advanced AI poses.
Here are a few details on Anthropic's financials, business structure, and where it stands in the global AI race:
BACKGROUND AND FINANCES
